<script>
    var whatsapp_flag = false
    

    var showing_iframe = false;
    function load_iframe(url){
        $('#tokko_iframe').attr('src', url);
        $('#tokko_iframe').show();
        setTimeout(function(){showing_iframe = true}, 400)
        $('#tokko_iframe').focus();
    }

    $(document).keydown(function(ev) {
        if (showing_iframe){
            if(ev.keyCode == 27) { //escape key
                if ( $('#tokko_iframe').hasClass('tl_preview') ) {
                    $('#tokko_iframe').removeClass('tl_preview');
                    $('.bg-overlay').hide();
                }
                $('#tokko_iframe').hide();
                showing_iframe=false;
                return false;
            }
        }else{
            if(ev.keyCode == 27) { //escape key
                if($('#fullview').is(":visible")){
                    close_property_display();
                }
                 if($('#dev_fullview').is(":visible")){
                    dev_close_property_display()
                }

            }
        }
    });

    function close_iframe(){
        if (showing_iframe){
            if ( $('#tokko_iframe').hasClass('tl_preview') ) {
                $('#tokko_iframe').removeClass('tl_preview');
                $('.bg-overlay').hide();
            }
            $('#tokko_iframe').hide();
            showing_iframe=false;
        }
    }


    $(function(){
        $(document).bind('click', function() {
            if (showing_iframe){
                close_iframe()
            }
        });

       $('#tokko_iframe').on('click', function(e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
       });
    });


</script>

        fetch(`/api3/tokko_chat/whatsapp/slots/${slotId}`)
            .then(response => {
                // If response is 404, slot is not available
                if (response.status === 404) {
                    showToast("Este espacio ya no está disponible", {variant: 'error'});
                    return Promise.reject('Slot not found');
                }
                return response.json();

                    showToast("Este espacio ya no está disponible", {variant: 'error'});

function calDateAgo(dString=null){

    let ago = " ago"
    var d1 = new Date(dString);
    var d2 = new Date();
    var t2 = d2.getTime();
    var t1 = d1.getTime();
    var d1Y = d1.getFullYear();
    var d2Y = d2.getFullYear();
    var d1M = d1.getMonth();
    var d2M = d2.getMonth();

    var time_obj = {};
    time_obj.año = d2.getFullYear()-d1.getFullYear();
    time_obj.mes = (d2M+12*d2Y)-(d1M+12*d1Y);
    time_obj.semana = parseInt((t2-t1)/(24*3600*1000*7));
    time_obj.dia = parseInt((t2-t1)/(24*3600*1000));
    time_obj.hora = parseInt((t2-t1)/(3600*1000));
    time_obj.minuto = parseInt((t2-t1)/(60*1000));
    time_obj.segundo = parseInt((t2-t1)/(1000));

    for (const obj_key in time_obj) {
        if(time_obj[obj_key] == 0){
            delete time_obj[obj_key];
        }
    }
    var ago_text = "recién";

    if(typeof Object.keys(time_obj)[0] != 'undefined'){
        var time_key = Object.keys(time_obj)[0];
        var time_val = time_obj[Object.keys(time_obj)[0]];
        time_key += (time_val > 1) ? 's' : '';
        // ago_text = time_val+' '+time_key+ ago;
        ago_text = `Hace ${time_val} ${time_key}`;
    }

    return ago_text;
}

<script>
$(document).ready(function () {
    $(".menu-item").each(function () {
        const id = $(this).attr("id");
        const tooltip = $(`#toolTip_${id}`);

        $(this).hover(
            function () {
                // Haz algo cuando se hace hover sobre este elemento
                const position = this.getBoundingClientRect();
                const tooltipHeight = tooltip.outerHeight();
                const tooltipWidth = tooltip.outerWidth();
                const windowWidth = $(window).width();
                const windowHeight = $(window).height();

                let top = position.top + 2;
                let left = position.left + 70;

                // Verificar si el tooltip excede el borde inferior del viewport
                if (top + tooltipHeight > windowHeight) {
                    top = windowHeight - tooltipHeight - 10;
                }

                $('.bridge').css({height: `${tooltipHeight}px`})
                tooltip.css({
                    zIndex: 9999,
                    maxWidth: "208px",
                    position: "fixed",
                    top: `${top}px`,
                    left: `${left}px`,
                });

                tooltip.show();
            },
            function () {
                // Haz algo cuando se deja de hacer hover sobre este elemento
                // Comprobar si el cursor aún está dentro del tooltip
                if (!tooltip.is(":hover")) {
                    tooltip.hide();
                }
            }
        );

        // Agregar evento hover al tooltip
        tooltip.hover(
            function () {
                // Haz algo cuando se hace hover sobre el tooltip
                tooltip.show();
            },
            function () {
                // Haz algo cuando se deja de hacer hover sobre el tooltip
                tooltip.hide();
            }
        );
    });
});

</script>

<script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
        function normalize_path(pathname) {
            if (!pathname) {
                return "/";
            }
            if (pathname.charAt(0) !== "/") {
                pathname = "/" + pathname;
            }
            if (pathname.charAt(pathname.length - 1) !== "/") {
                pathname = pathname + "/";
            }
            return pathname;
        }

        function is_absolute_url(href) {
            return href.indexOf("://") !== -1 || href.indexOf("//") === 0;
        }

        function get_pathname_from_href(href) {
            if (!href) {
                return null;
            }
            if (href.indexOf("javascript:") === 0 || href === "#") {
                return null;
            }
            if (is_absolute_url(href)) {
                var absolute_parser = document.createElement("a");
                absolute_parser.href = href;
                if (absolute_parser.host && absolute_parser.host !== window.location.host) {
                    return null;
                }
            }
            var parser = document.createElement("a");
            parser.href = href;
            return parser.pathname;
        }

        function get_parent_li(element) {
            var current = element;
            while (current) {
                if (current.tagName && current.tagName.toLowerCase() === "li") {
                    return current;
                }
                current = current.parentNode;
            }
            return null;
        }

        var current_path = normalize_path(window.location.pathname);
        var menu_links = document.querySelectorAll("#menu a[href]");
        var exact_matches = [];
        Array.prototype.forEach.call(menu_links, function (link) {
            var link_pathname = get_pathname_from_href(link.getAttribute("href"));
            if (!link_pathname) {
                return;
            }
            if (normalize_path(link_pathname) !== current_path) {
                return;
            }
            exact_matches.push(link);
        });

        function apply_selected_state(link) {
            if (link.classList.contains("submenu-item-a-elements")) {
                link.classList.add("item_active");
            }
            var parent_li = get_parent_li(link);
            if (parent_li) {
                parent_li.classList.add("selected");
            }
        }

        if (exact_matches.length) {
            Array.prototype.forEach.call(exact_matches, function (link) {
                apply_selected_state(link);
            });
            return;
        }

        var best_match = null;
        var best_match_length = 0;
        Array.prototype.forEach.call(menu_links, function (link) {
            var link_pathname = get_pathname_from_href(link.getAttribute("href"));
            if (!link_pathname) {
                return;
            }
            var normalized_link_path = normalize_path(link_pathname);
            if (normalized_link_path === "/" || normalized_link_path.length < 2) {
                return;
            }
            if (current_path.indexOf(normalized_link_path) !== 0) {
                return;
            }
            if (normalized_link_path.length <= best_match_length) {
                return;
            }
            best_match = link;
            best_match_length = normalized_link_path.length;
        });

        if (best_match) {
            apply_selected_state(best_match);
        }
    });
</script>

<script>
  function showUnreadsTip(count) {
    const $menuItemChat = $("#menu-item-chat");
    const $tooltip = $("#toolTipTokkoChat");
    const $header = $("#tipChatHeaderText");
    const text = `Tenés ${count} mensajes pendientes de colegas de la Red Tokko Broker`;

    // Se desahabilita el modal hasta nuevo aviso
    return null

    function updateTooltipPosition() {
      if ($menuItemChat.length && $tooltip) {
        const position = $menuItemChat[0].getBoundingClientRect();
        const top = position.top + window.scrollY - 32;

        $tooltip.css({
          top: `${top}px`,
          display: "flex",
        });
      }
    }

    if ($menuItemChat.length && $tooltip.length) {
      $header.html(text);
      updateTooltipPosition();

      $(window).on("scroll", updateTooltipPosition);
    }
  }

  function closeTip() {
    $("#toolTipTokkoChat").remove();
  }

  let reactChatReady = false;
  let channelId = null;
  let pendingMessage = null;
  let pendingProperty = null;

  function activeChatFrame() {
    closeTip();
    $("#modal-chat").removeClass("nec_none");
    $("body").addClass("nec_overflow");
  }

  document.defaultView.addEventListener("message", function (event) {
    if (
      event.origin.includes("https://app.tokkobroker.com") &&
      event.data === "reactChatReady" &&
      !reactChatReady
    ) {
      $(".fakeModalChat").addClass("fakeModalClose");
      $(".tokkoChat_iframe").show();
      $("#modal-chat").css("background-color", "transparent");
      $(".tokkoChat_iframe").addClass("iframeOpen");

      reactChatReady = true;

      if ($("#modal-chat").is(":visible")) {
        showTokkoChat();
      }
    }
  });

  async function requestMicPermission() {
    try {
      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
      console.log("Permiso concedido para el micrófono.");

      stream.getTracks().forEach(track => track.stop());
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Permiso denegado o error al intentar acceder al micrófono:", error);
    }
  }

  function showTokkoChat() {
    const iframe = $(".tokkoChat_iframe");
    document.getElementById("pending_unread_messenger").style.display = "none";
    stopInterval();
    closeTip();

    document.defaultView.addEventListener("message", listenChatActions);

    iframe[0].contentWindow.postMessage(
      {
        action: "openChatModal",
        url: window.location.href,
        CID: channelId,
        message: pendingMessage,
        property: pendingProperty
      },
      "https://app.tokkobroker.com"
    );
    pendingMessage = null;
    pendingProperty = null;
  }

  function openTokkochat(CID) {
    channelId = CID;

    if (reactChatReady) {
      $("#modal-chat").removeClass("nec_none");
      $("body").addClass("nec_overflow");
      showTokkoChat();
    } else {
      activeChatFrame();
    }
  }

  function openTokkochatWithContext(CID, message, property) {
    channelId = CID;
    pendingMessage = message || null;
    pendingProperty = property || null;

    if (reactChatReady) {
      $("#modal-chat").removeClass("nec_none");
      $("body").addClass("nec_overflow");
      showTokkoChat();
    } else {
      activeChatFrame();
    }
  }
  
  function get_unread_messenger() {
    $.ajax({
      url: "https://messenger.tokkobroker.com/users/me/unreads?can_manage_webcontacts=True",
      method: "GET",
      dataType: "json",
      headers: {"AUTHORIZATION": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..aer1-6m6REmGfkl-zH5feMexM_82ggnqQH5w77dgvLY"},
      success: function (result) {
        if (result.unread_amount === 0) {
          $("#pending_unread_messenger").css("display", "none");
        } else if (result.unread_amount !== 0) {
          $("#pending_unread_messenger").html(
            result.unread_amount >= 99 ? "+99" : result.unread_amount
          );
          $("#pending_unread_messenger").css("display", "grid");
        }

        if (result.colleagues >= 1) {
          showUnreadsTip(result.colleagues);
        }
      },
      error: function (jqXHR, textStatus, errorThrown) {
        stopInterval()
        console.error("Error en la solicitud: " + textStatus, errorThrown);
      },
    });
  }

  // Iniciar el intervalo
  let intervalId;
  $(document).ready(function () {
    startInterval();
  });

  // Función para detener el intervalo
  function stopInterval() {
    clearInterval(intervalId);
  }

  // Función para reiniciar el intervalo
  function startInterval() {
    get_unread_messenger();
    intervalId = setInterval(get_unread_messenger, 120000);
  }

  function closeChat() {
    $("#modal-chat").addClass("nec_none");
    $("body").removeClass("nec_overflow");
    startInterval();
    document.defaultView.removeEventListener("message", listenChatActions);
  }

  const chatActions = {
    closeTokkoChat: function () {
      closeChat();
    },

    updateLeads: function () {
      get_data_for_table()
    },

    removeWebContactElement: function (web_contact_id) {
      removeWebcontactItem(web_contact_id)
    },

    actionRequestMic: function() {
      requestMicPermission()
    }
  };

  function listenChatActions() {
    if (Object.keys(chatActions).some((a) => a === event.data.msg)) {
      chatActions[event.data.msg](event.data.data);
    }
  }
</script>

<script>
function save_window_pdf(name, value){
    if (name == 'image_count'){
        $('#pdf-window-preview-content-img1-box').hide()
        $('#pdf-window-preview-content-img2-box').hide()
        $('#pdf-window-preview-content-img3-box').hide()

        for (i = 0; i < parseInt(value); i++) {
            $('#pdf-window-preview-content-img'+(i+1)+'-box').show()
        }
        if (parseInt(value) == 1){ $('#pdf-window-preview-content-img1-box').addClass('pdf-preview-one-image');}else{$('#pdf-window-preview-content-img1-box').removeClass('pdf-preview-one-image');}

    }
    $(window).bind('beforeunload', function(){
        return 'Estás saliendo sin guardar los cambios.';
    });
    if (messagebox){
       messagebox.floatingMessage("destroy")
    }    messagebox = $.floatingMessage("<div id='messagebox' class='new'><div class='loader'></div> Guardando...</div>",{
        width:160,
        position: 'left-bottom'
    });
    data = {'name': name, 'value': value}

    var jqxhr = $.ajax('/property/8002445/window_pdf_preview' , {'type':'POST', 'data': data} )
        .done(function(result) {
            $(window).unbind('beforeunload');
            messagebox.floatingMessage("destroy");
        })
        .fail(function() {
            messagebox.floatingMessage("destroy");
            $.floatingMessage("<div id='messagebox' class='new'>Hubo un error al guardar... Por favor intentá nuevamente en unos minutos.</div>",{time:2000, width:600, position:'left-bottom'});
         })
}

function save_window_pdf_color(){
    color = $("#color-picker").val()
    $('.pdf-window-preview-content-fillcolor').css('background-color', color);
    save_window_pdf('background_color', color)
    color = hexToRgb(color);
    setfillcolor([color.r, color.g, color.b]);
}

function save_window_pdf_color2(){
    color = $("#color-picker2").val()
    $('.pdf-window-preview-content-fillcolor2').css('background-color', color);
    save_window_pdf('second_color', color)
    color = hexToRgb(color);
    setfillcolor2([color.r, color.g, color.b]);
}

function save_window_pdf_color3(){
    color = $("#color-picker3").val()
    $('.pdf-window-preview-content-fillcolor3').css('background-color', color);
    save_window_pdf('band_color', color)
    color = hexToRgb(color);
    setfillcolor3([color.r, color.g, color.b]);
}

function color_steal(){
    var colorThief = new ColorThief();
    color = colorThief.getColor(document.getElementById("palette_picker"), 1);
    $('.pdf-window-preview-content-fillcolor').css('background-color', "rgb("+color[0]+","+color[1]+","+color[2]+")")
    $('.pdf-window-preview-content-fillcolor2').css('background-color', "rgb("+color[0]+","+color[1]+","+color[2]+")")
    $('.pdf-window-preview-content-fillcolor3').css('background-color', "rgb("+color[0]+","+color[1]+","+color[2]+")")

    setfillcolor(color);
    setfillcolor2(color);
    setfillcolor3(color);

    $("#color-picker").val(rgb2hex("rgb("+color[0]+","+color[1]+","+color[2]+")"))
    $("#color-picker2").val(rgb2hex("rgb("+color[0]+","+color[1]+","+color[2]+")"))
    $("#color-picker3").val(rgb2hex("rgb("+color[0]+","+color[1]+","+color[2]+")"))

    save_window_pdf_color();
    save_window_pdf_color2();
    save_window_pdf_color3();

}

function setfillcolor(color){
    if (((color[0]*299)+(color[1]*587)+(color[2]*114))/1000 < 128){
        opposite = "#FFFFFF"
    }else{
        opposite = "#000000"
    }
    $('.pdf-window-preview-content-fillcolor').css('color', opposite)
}

function setfillcolor2(color){
    if (((color[0]*299)+(color[1]*587)+(color[2]*114))/1000 < 128){
        opposite = "#FFFFFF"
    }else{
        opposite = "#000000"
    }
    $('.pdf-window-preview-content-fillcolor2').css('color', opposite)
}

function setfillcolor3(color){
    if (((color[0]*299)+(color[1]*587)+(color[2]*114))/1000 < 128){
        opposite = "#FFFFFF"
    }else{
        opposite = "#000000"
    }
    $('.pdf-window-preview-content-fillcolor3').css('color', opposite)
}

function rgb2hex(rgb) {
     if (rgb.search("rgb") == -1 ) {
          return rgb;
     } else {
          rgb = rgb.match(/^rgba?\((\d+),\s*(\d+),\s*(\d+)(?:,\s*(\d+))?\)$/);
          function hex(x) {
               return ("0" + parseInt(x).toString(16)).slice(-2);
          }
          return "#" + hex(rgb[1]) + hex(rgb[2]) + hex(rgb[3]);
     }
}

function hexToRgb(hex) {
    var result = /^#?([a-f\d]{2})([a-f\d]{2})([a-f\d]{2})$/i.exec(hex);
    return result ? {
        r: parseInt(result[1], 16),
        g: parseInt(result[2], 16),
        b: parseInt(result[3], 16)
    } : null;
}

        $('#pdf-window-preview-content-price').html(result.price)
        $('#pdf-window-preview-content-logo').attr('src', result.logo);

        $('#pdf-window-preview-desc_font_size').val(result.desc_font_size);

        $('#pdf-window-preview-content-description').css('line-height', (result.desc_font_size+4)+'px')
        $('#pdf-window-preview-content-img1-box').hide()
        $('#pdf-window-preview-content-img2-box').hide()
        $('#pdf-window-preview-content-img3-box').hide()

        for (i = 0; i < result.images.length; i++) {
                $('#pdf-window-preview-content-img'+(i+1)).attr('src', result.images[i]);
            if (i < result.image_count){
                $('#pdf-window-preview-content-img'+(i+1)+'-box').show();
            }
        }
        if (result.image_count == 1){ $('#pdf-window-preview-content-img1-box').addClass('pdf-preview-one-image');}else{$('#pdf-window-preview-content-img1-box').removeClass('pdf-preview-one-image');}

        $('.pdf-window-editable').editable(function(value, settings) {
             save_window_pdf($(this).attr('name'), value)
             if ($(this).attr('name') == 'band_title') { $('.ribbon').html(value);}
             return value
         }, {
            tooltip   : 'Hacé click para editar',
            select : true,
            placeholder   : 'Editar...',
            onblur : 'submit'
        });

        $(".pdf-window-editable-big").editable(function(value, settings) {
                  save_window_pdf($(this).attr('name'), value)
                  return value;
              }, {
              type   : 'textarea',
              data: function(value, settings) {
                    var regex = new RegExp("(</.*?>)", "gi");
                    var retval = value.replace(regex, "\n");
                    var is_html = isHTML(retval)
                    if(is_html){
                        return $(retval).html(retval).text().replace(/<br\s*[\/]?>/gi, "\n").replace(/<\/?[^>]+(>|$)/g, "").trim()
                    }else{
                        return retval.replace(/ /gi,'')
                    }
                    },
              select : true,
              height: '296px',
              onblur : 'ignore',
              tooltip   : 'Hacé click para editar',
              placeholder   : 'Hacé click para editar',
              submit : 'Guardar',
              cancel : 'Cancelar',
          });


        if (result.bgcolor == ''){
          $("#palette_picker").attr("src", "/property/get_img_url/0?real_url=https://static.tokkobroker.com/logos/15865/logo_azul_oficial.png")
        }else{
          $('.pdf-window-preview-content-fillcolor').css('background-color', result.bgcolor)
          $('.pdf-window-preview-content-fillcolor2').css('background-color', result.second_color)
          $('.pdf-window-preview-content-fillcolor3').css('background-color', result.band_color)

          $("#color-picker").val(result.bgcolor)
          $("#color-picker2").val(result.second_color)
          $("#color-picker3").val(result.band_color)

          color = hexToRgb(result.bgcolor)
          setfillcolor([color.r, color.g, color.b]);
          color = hexToRgb(result.second_color)
          setfillcolor2([color.r, color.g, color.b]);
          color = hexToRgb(result.band_color)
          setfillcolor3([color.r, color.g, color.b]);

        }
        $("#property-pdf-window-preview").removeClass('pdf-vertical').removeClass('pdf-horizontal').addClass('pdf-'+result.layout);
        $("#pdf-preview-layout-vertical").prop("checked", false)
        $("#pdf-preview-layout-horizontal").prop("checked", false)
        $("#pdf-preview-layout-"+result.layout).prop("checked", true)
        $('#prop_loading').hide();
        $('#property-pdf-window-preview').slideDown();
        $('#pdf-show_qr').attr('checked', result.show_qr)
        $('#pdf-show_band').attr('checked', result.show_band)

        $('.ribbon').html(result.band_title);
        if (result.show_qr){
            $('#pdf-window-preview-content-qr').show()
        }else{
            $('#pdf-window-preview-content-qr').hide()
        }
        if (result.show_band){
            $('.ribbon-wrapper').show()
        }else{
            $('.ribbon-wrapper').hide()
        }

        $('.qtip.ui-tooltip').qtip('hide');

    }).fail(function(){})
}

function close_window_pdf_preview(){
    if($('#property-pdf-window-preview').is(":visible")){
        $('#property-pdf-window-preview').hide('clip');
    }
}

    function fillCurrencies(preselect=false){
        return new Promise(function(resolve, reject) {
            var jqxhr = $.ajax(`/property/${prop_id}/available_operations`)
                .done(function(result){
                    rsv_operations = {};

                    // currencies
                    document.querySelectorAll('#rsv-currency-list .select-list-element')[0].dataset["value"] = result.currencies.primary;
                    document.querySelectorAll('#rsv-currency-list .select-list-element')[0].textContent = result.currencies.primary;
                    document.querySelectorAll('#rsv-currency-list .select-list-element')[1].dataset["value"] = result.currencies.secondary;
                    document.querySelectorAll('#rsv-currency-list .select-list-element')[1].textContent = result.currencies.secondary;

                    // operations
                    result.operations.forEach(op => {
                        rsv_operations[`${op.type}`] = {};
                        if(op.type != 3 ||
                        (op.type == 3 && op.prices.length == 1) ||
                        (op.type == 3 && op.prices.length == 2 && op.prices[0].currency != op.prices[1].currency)){
                            op.prices.forEach(price => {
                                rsv_operations[`${op.type}`][price.currency] = price.raw_value
                            })
                        }
                    })
                    if(preselect && Object.keys(rsv_operations).length == 1){
                        document.querySelector(`#rsv-op-list .select-list-element[data-value="${Object.keys(rsv_operations)[0]}"]`).click();
                        resolve(Object.keys(rsv_operations)[0])
                    }
                    resolve("1")
            });
        });
    }


    function fillRsvModalFromEndpoint(flow){
        //flow = EDIT (reservation) or CONCRETE (stands for confirm reservation)

        var jqxhr = $.ajax('/properties/reservation/get_reservation?id=' + rsv_id)
            .done(function(result){

                saved_rsv_data = result;

                //add contact
                createAndAppendContactElement(result.contact)

                //add agents
                for (let i = 0; i < result.agents.length; i++){
                    createAndAppendAgentElement(result.agents[i])
                }

                //add managers
                if(flow == 'edit'){
                    for (var i = 0; i < result.managers.length; i++){
                        createAndAppendManagerElement(result.managers[i])
                    }
                }

                document.querySelector(`#rsv-op-list [data-value="${result.operation_type}"]`).click();
                document.querySelectorAll(`#rsv-currency-list .select-list-element`).forEach(el => {
                    if(el.textContent == result.reservation_amount_currency) el.click();
                })
                //reservation_amount is used for the operation value in the DB
                document.getElementById('rsv-total').value = result.reservation_amount
                document.getElementById('rsv-period-input').value = result.reservation_duration;
                document.querySelectorAll('#rsv-period-container .unset').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('unset'))
                //operation_amount is used for the reservation value in the DB
                document.getElementById('rsv-partial').value = result.operation_amount;
                let rsv_date = result.estimated_date.split('.')
                document.getElementById('rsv-date').valueAsDate = new Date(rsv_date[2], rsv_date[1] -1, rsv_date[0])
                document.getElementById('rsv-date').classList.remove("unset");
                document.getElementById('rsv-comments').value = (result.comment != undefined) ? result.comment : '';

                for(index in result.files){
                    let file = result.files[index]
                    rsv_filelist[file_index] = file;
                    addFileElement(file.id, file.name, file.url, file_index)

                    file_index++;
                }

                if(flow == 'edit'){
                    showElement('#rsv-reminder');
                    document.getElementById('rsv-reminder').classList.add('display-grid')
                    showRsvModifyButtons()
                }else{
                    // When Confirming a Reservation, the modal size is different if it's a Sell or a Rent
                    // (because differents inputs are used)
                    setDinamicDisplay(result.operation_type)
                    showRsvConcreteButtons();
                }

                showRsvModal();
        });
    }

{
    function debounce(callback, wait) {
        let timeout;
        return (...args) => {
            const context = this;
            clearTimeout(timeout);
            timeout = setTimeout(() => callback.apply(context, args), wait);
        };
    }

    function positionResults(element, relativeTo){
        let relativeRect = document.querySelector(relativeTo).getBoundingClientRect()
        document.querySelector(element).style.top = `${relativeRect.y + relativeRect.height}px`;
        showElement(element)
    }

    function hideElement(selector){
        document.querySelectorAll(selector).forEach( el => el.classList.add('display-none'))
    }

    function showElement(selector){
        document.querySelectorAll(selector).forEach(el => el.classList.remove('display-none'))
    }

    function toggleElement(selector){
        document.querySelectorAll(selector).forEach(el => el.classList.toggle('display-none'))
    }

        }else if(pattern.length > 2){
            $.ajax({
                url: CONTACTS_QUICKSEARCH + '?q=' + pattern + '&json_format=True'
            }).done(function (response) {
                document.getElementById('search-contact-list').innerHTML = "";

                for(let i = 0; i < response.length; i++){
                    let el = response[i];
                    let new_li = document.createElement('LI')
                    new_li.dataset.id = el.id;
                    new_li.dataset.fullname = el.fullname;

                                </div>
                            ` : "" }
                            ${el.phone ? `
                                <div class="mb-5 trim-long-words">
                                    <i class="size-20 icon icon-telefono color-grey-3" style="padding: 0px;"></i>
                                    <span class="body-1 color-grey-3" style="vertical-align: top; margin-left: 3px;">${el.phone}</span>

                            ` : ""}
                            ${el.cellphone ? `

                                    <span class="body-1 color-grey-3" style="vertical-align: top; margin-left: 3px;">${el.cellphone}</span>
                                </div>
                            ` : ""}
                        `;
                    new_li.dataset.phone = el.phone;
                    new_li.dataset.cellphone = el.cellphone;
                    new_li.dataset.mail = el.email;
                    new_li.dataset.is_company = el.is_company;

                positionResults('#search-contact-list', '#rsv-contact-container .input-search')

        for(let i = 0; i < e.currentTarget.files.length; i++){
            let file = e.currentTarget.files[i]
            if(file.name.length > 70 || file.size > 1024*1024*50 || extensions.includes(file.name.split('.').pop()) ){

    function checkDataChanged(flow){
        // flow == edit: Editing a Reservation
        // flow == concrete: Confirming an operation (from a Reservation, a Concreted Operation is created)
        // flow == modify_concreted: Editing a Concreted Operation

        if(document.getElementById('rsv-contact')){
            if( document.getElementById('rsv-contact').dataset.id != saved_rsv_data.contact.id){
                return true;
            }
        }else{
            return true;
        }

        if(rsv_agents_ids.size == saved_rsv_data.agents.length){
            for (let i = 0; i < rsv_agents_ids.size; i++){
                if(! rsv_agents_ids.has(saved_rsv_data.agents[i].id)){
                    return true
                }
            }
        }else{
            return true;
        }

        if(flow == "edit"){
            // there are no managers in concreted operationra
            if(rsv_managers_ids.size == saved_rsv_data.managers.length){
                for (let i = 0; i < rsv_managers_ids.size; i++){
                    if(! rsv_managers_ids.has(saved_rsv_data.managers[i].id)){
                        return true
                    }
                }
            }else{
                return true;
            }
        }

        if(document.getElementById('rsv-op-selected').dataset.selectedValue != saved_rsv_data.operation_type){
            return true;
        }

        if(flow != "modify-concreted"){
            if(saved_rsv_data.reservation_amount_currency != document.querySelector('#rsv-currency-selected').dataset.selectedValue ){
                return true;
            }

            // for reservations, the model uses reservation_amount to save the total (instead of operation_amount).
            if(document.getElementById('rsv-total').value != saved_rsv_data.reservation_amount){
                return true;
            }

            if(flow == "edit"){
                if (document.getElementById('rsv-date').value.split('-').reverse().join('.') != saved_rsv_data.estimated_date){
                    return true;
                }
                if(document.getElementById('rsv-partial').value != saved_rsv_data.operation_amount){
                    return true;
                }
                if(document.getElementById('rsv-period-input').value != saved_rsv_data.reservation_duration){
                    return true
                }
            }

            if(flow == "concrete"){
                if(document.getElementById('rsv-concrete-rent-date').value != ''){
                    return true
                }
                if (document.getElementById('rsv-rent-period-input').value != '0'){
                    return true
                }
            }
        }else{
            if(saved_rsv_data.operation_amount_currency != document.querySelector('#rsv-currency-selected').dataset.selectedValue ){
                return true;
            }
            //When modifying an alredy concreted operation, the model uses (correctly) operation amount
            if(document.getElementById('rsv-total').value != saved_rsv_data.operation_amount){
                return true;
            }

            if(saved_rsv_data.operation_type != "1"){
                if(saved_rsv_data.contract_start_date == undefined){
                    if(document.getElementById('rsv-concrete-rent-date').value != ''){
                        return true
                    }
                }else{
                    if (document.getElementById('rsv-concrete-rent-date').value.split('-').reverse().join('.') != saved_rsv_data.contract_start_date){
                        return true;
                    }
                }

                if(saved_rsv_data.rent_duration == undefined){
                    if (document.getElementById('rsv-rent-period-input').value != '0'){
                        return true
                    }
                }else{
                    if(document.getElementById('rsv-rent-period-input').value != saved_rsv_data.rent_duration){
                        return true
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        let total_files;
        if(flow == "modify-concreted"){
            total_files =[ ...saved_rsv_data.reservation_files, ...saved_rsv_data.concreted_operation_files]
        }else{
            total_files = saved_rsv_data.files
        }

        if(total_files.length != Object.keys(rsv_filelist).length){
                return true
        }else{
            //same amount, but some files were deleted and new ones uploaded (and therefore, are 'File' type)
            if(document.querySelectorAll('.attached-file-element').length > 0){
                for(let index in rsv_filelist){
                    if(rsv_filelist[index] instanceof File){
                        return true
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

            <input id="owner-report-statistics" type="checkbox" name="owner-report-statistics" checked=""> <label class="owner-report-secondary-text">Estadísticas de publicación en Zonaprop.</label>
        </label>

            <button id="owner-report-cancel" class="btn-primary-text btn-medium mt-8">Cancelar</button>

<script>

// Open modal
function owner_report_modal(){
    if(!$('#owner-report-statistics').length){
        $('.owner-report-buttons').css('margin-top', '78px')
    }
    $('#owner-report-modal').show();
}

// Close modal
$('#owner-report-cancel').click(function(){
    $('#owner-report-modal').hide();
});

// Generate owner report
var owner_report_url_base = '/a/download_report/8002445/';
$('#owner-report-generate').click(function(){
    owner_report_url = '';
    if($('#owner-report-active-pubs').prop('checked')){
        owner_report_url += 'active_pubs=true&';
    }
    if($('#owner-report-statistics').prop('checked')){
        owner_report_url += 'show_pub=true';
    }
    if(owner_report_url){
        owner_report_url = owner_report_url_base + '?' + owner_report_url;
    }else{
        owner_report_url = owner_report_url_base
    }
    $('#owner-report-modal').hide();
    window.open(owner_report_url, '_blank');
});

</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
	var monthList = ['Enero','Febrero','Marzo','Abril','Mayo','Junio','Julio','Agosto','Septiembre','Octubre','Noviembre','Diciembre',];
	var crumbleData = [],
		chartMonths = [],
		chartStarred = [],
		chartEmails = [],
		chartWhatsapps = [],
		tempChartEvents = [],
		tempChartStarred = [],
		tempChartEmails = [],
		tempChartWhatsapps = [],
		tempChartEvents = [],
		dateTooltipLabels = [],
		dataTotals = [],
		pie_charts = [],
		pieChart = [],
		datasetSize = 0;

	function openStatsModal(id){
		$("html, body").css({"position": "fixed"});
		$("#charts_modal_overlay").css("display","flex");

		$("#title_wrapper > p").html( $(".property-name-box .name#address").text()+"<span>"+$(".shortinfo #property_ref").text()+"</span>" );

		crumbleData = []
		chartMonths = []
		chartStarred = []
		chartEmails = []
		chartWhatsapps = []
		chartEvents = []
		dataTotals = []
		pie_charts = []
		pieChart = []
		dateTooltipLabels = []
		datasetSize = 0;

		const urlDelete = '/property/'+id+'/charts_stats';
		$.ajax({"type":"GET", "headers": {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, "url": urlDelete, success: function(response){
				//Remove loader
				$("#charts_modal_wrapper .loader").hide();
				$("#charts_modal_wrapper #wrapper_modal_body").show();
				$("#charts_modal_wrapper #pie_chart_subtitle").hide();

				dataTotals = response.totals;
				$("#wrapper_boxes .sent_emails").text(dataTotals['mails'][0]);
				$("#wrapper_boxes .sent_wapps").text(dataTotals['whatsapps'][0]);
				$("#wrapper_boxes .inq_rec").text(dataTotals['leads'][0]);
				$("#wrapper_boxes .events_held").text(dataTotals['events'][0]);

				can_export_contact_lists = response.can_export_contact_lists
				if(can_export_contact_lists){
					$('#title_wrapper button.link0').click(function () {
						window.location.href = dataTotals['all'][1];
					});
					$("#wrapper_boxes a.link1").attr("href", dataTotals['mails'][1]);
					$("#wrapper_boxes a.link2").attr("href", dataTotals['whatsapps'][1]);
					$("#wrapper_boxes a.link3").attr("href", dataTotals['leads'][1]);
					$("#wrapper_boxes a.link4").attr("href", dataTotals['events'][1]);
				}
				else{
					$('#title_wrapper button.link0').hide()
					$("#wrapper_boxes a.link1").hide()
					$("#wrapper_boxes a.link2").hide()
					$("#wrapper_boxes a.link3").hide()
					$("#wrapper_boxes a.link4").hide()
				}

				//Generate bar chart
				var data = response.data;
				for (var i=1; i<data.length; i++){
					var dateArray = data[i][0];
					var fullMonth = dateArray[1].toString().padStart(2, "0");
				    crumbleData.push({
						date: dateArray[0] + "." + fullMonth,
						tooltip: `${dateArray[1]}/${dateArray[0]}`,
						starred: data[i][1],
						emails: data[i][2],
						whatsapps: data[i][3],
						events: data[i][4]
						}
					);
				}

				datasetSize = crumbleData.length;
				$("#multi-range input").attr({min: 1, max: datasetSize});
				$("#multi-range input#lower").attr({ value: 1});
				$("#multi-range input#upper").attr({ value: datasetSize});

				crumbleData.sort((a, b) => a.date - b.date);
				for (var i=0; i < datasetSize; i++){
					var dateArray = (crumbleData[i].date).split(".");
					chartMonths.push(monthList[(parseInt(dateArray[1], 10))-1]);
					dateTooltipLabels.push(crumbleData[i].tooltip);
				    chartStarred.push(crumbleData[i].starred);
				    chartEmails.push(crumbleData[i].emails);
				    chartWhatsapps.push(crumbleData[i].whatsapps);
					chartEvents.push(crumbleData[i].events);
				}

				document.getElementById("lower-label").textContent = dateTooltipLabels[0]
				document.getElementById("upper-label").textContent = dateTooltipLabels[datasetSize - 1]

				generateMonthlyChart();

				//Generate pie charts
				pie_charts = response.pie_charts;

				if(pie_charts.length > 0){
					pie_charts.sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name==="Sin grupo"));
					$("#charts_modal_wrapper #pie_chart_subtitle").show();
					var structureWrapperCharts = '';
					for (var i=0; i<pie_charts.length; i++){
						structureWrapperCharts += `
							<div class="wrapper_pie_chart chart`+i+`">
								<div class="labels_wrapper">
									<ul></ul>
								</div>
								<p>`+pie_charts[i].name+`</p>
								<div class="wrapper_canvas_pie_chart">
									<canvas id="pieChart`+i+`"></canvas>
								</div>
							</div>
						`;
					}
					$("#charts_modal_wrapper .pie_charts_container").html(structureWrapperCharts);
				}


				for (var i=0; i<pie_charts.length; i++){
					var objPieChart = JSON.parse(pie_charts[i].data);
					var labelsChart = [], datasetChart = [];
					var randomColors = ["#E6F0FF", "#6A88F2", "#1A4958", "#FD4E34", "#DF1E02", "#CAE3EB", "#FFF2F0", "#EA6200", "#B21702"];
					var structureLabels = '';
					for (var e=1; e<objPieChart.length; e++){
						labelsChart.push(objPieChart[e][0]);
						datasetChart.push(objPieChart[e][1]);
						if (objPieChart.length > 8) {
							var randomColor = Math.floor(Math.random()*16777215).toString(16);
							randomColors.splice(e+8, 0, "#"+randomColor);
						}
						structureLabels += `
							<li onclick="toggleData(this, `+i+`, `+(e-1)+`)">
								<span class="color_box" style="background-color:`+randomColors[e-1]+`"></span>
								<span class="label_name" title="`+objPieChart[e][0]+`">`+objPieChart[e][0]+`</span>
							</li>
						`;
					}

					$("#charts_modal_wrapper .wrapper_pie_chart.chart"+i+" .labels_wrapper ul").html(structureLabels);

					var ctx2 = document.getElementById('pieChart'+i);
					if (pieChart[i]) {
						pieChart[i].destroy();
					}
					pieChart[i] = new Chart(ctx2, {
					    type: 'doughnut',
					    data: {
						  labels: labelsChart,
						  datasets: [
						    {
						      data: datasetChart,
						      backgroundColor: randomColors,
						    }
						  ]
						},
					    options: {
					    	responsive: true,
					    	maintainAspectRatio:false,
					        plugins: {
				              legend: {
				                display: false
				              }
				            }
					    }
					});
				}
			}
		});
	}

	function closeStatsModal(){
		$("html, body").css({"position": ""});
		$("#charts_modal_overlay").css("display","none");
	}

	function toggleData(thisElement, whichPieChart, value){
		if ($(thisElement).hasClass("not_visible")) {
			pieChart[whichPieChart].getDatasetMeta(0).data[value].hidden = false;
		}else{
			pieChart[whichPieChart].getDatasetMeta(0).data[value].hidden = true;
		}
		$(thisElement).toggleClass("not_visible");
		pieChart[whichPieChart].update();
	}

	$(document).click(function(event){
		if (!$(event.target).closest("#charts_modal, li#stats_li, a.close-charts").length){
			closeStatsModal();
		}
	});
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
	/* MULTI RANGE TOOLTIP BEHAVIOR*/
	//Follow anchor element, so the tooltip moves with the ranges
	$("#multi-range [data-toggle='tooltip']").tooltip({
        container: "#anchor"
    });

	// Change position and displayed value
	$("#lower").on('mousemove', function(){
		let val = parseInt(document.querySelector('#lower').value)
		let leftPos = (((val - 1) / (datasetSize - 1)) * ((120 - 6) - 6)) + 6 ;

		document.getElementById("anchor").style.left = `${leftPos}px`;
		document.getElementById('lower-tooltip-text').textContent =  dateTooltipLabels[val -1]
	});

	$("#upper").on('mousemove', function(){
		let val = parseInt(document.querySelector('#upper').value)
		let leftPos = (((val - 1) / (datasetSize - 1)) * ((120 - 6) - 6)) + 15 ;

		document.getElementById("anchor").style.left = `${leftPos}px`;
		document.getElementById('upper-tooltip-text').textContent =  dateTooltipLabels[val -1]
	});


	/*MONTHLY BAR CHART */
	let monthlyChart;
	function generateMonthlyChart(){
		var ctx = document.getElementById('monthlyChart');
		if (monthlyChart) {
			monthlyChart.destroy();
		}
		monthlyChart = new Chart(ctx, {
		    type: 'bar',
		    data: {
			  labels: chartMonths,
			  datasets: [
			    {
			      label: 'Destacada',
			      data: chartStarred,
			      borderColor: ['rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)'],
			      backgroundColor: ['rgba(253, 78, 52, .8)'],
			    },
			    {
			      label: 'Email',
			      data: chartEmails,
			      borderColor: ['rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)'],
			      backgroundColor: ['rgba(106, 136, 242, .8)'],
			    },
			    {
			      label: 'Whatsapp',
			      data: chartWhatsapps,
			      borderColor: ['rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)'],
			      backgroundColor: ['rgba(26, 73, 88, .8)'],
			    },
			    {
			      label: 'Eventos',
			      data: chartEvents,
			      borderColor: ['rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)'],
			      backgroundColor: ['rgba(202, 227, 235, 1)'],
			    }
			  ]
			},
		    options: {
		    	responsive: true,
		    	maintainAspectRatio:false,
		        scales: {
		            y: {
		                beginAtZero: true
		            }
		        }
		    }
		});
	}

	let lowerSlider = document.querySelector('#lower'),
		upperSlider = document.querySelector('#upper');
	let lowerVal;
	let upperVal;

	function sliceDatasetsAndUpdateChart(){
		var rangeValue = chartMonths.slice(lowerVal-1, upperVal);

		tempChartStarred = chartStarred.slice(lowerVal-1, upperVal)
		tempChartEmails = chartEmails.slice(lowerVal-1, upperVal)
		tempChartWhatsapps = chartWhatsapps.slice(lowerVal-1, upperVal)
		tempChartEvents = chartEvents.slice(lowerVal-1, upperVal)

		monthlyChart.config.data.labels = rangeValue;
		monthlyChart.config.data.datasets[0].data = tempChartStarred
		monthlyChart.config.data.datasets[1].data = tempChartEmails
		monthlyChart.config.data.datasets[2].data = tempChartWhatsapps
		monthlyChart.config.data.datasets[3].data = tempChartEvents
		monthlyChart.update();
	}

	function changeRangeLower(){
		lowerVal = parseInt(lowerSlider.value);
		upperVal = parseInt(upperSlider.value);

		document.getElementById("lower-label").textContent = dateTooltipLabels[lowerVal -1]

		// when the two sliders touch, let the lower "push" the upper:
		if (lowerVal > upperVal ) {
			upperSlider.value = lowerVal ;
			upperVal = lowerVal;
			document.getElementById("upper-label").textContent = dateTooltipLabels[upperVal-1]
		}

		sliceDatasetsAndUpdateChart();
	};

	function changeRangeUpper(){
		lowerVal = parseInt(lowerSlider.value);
		upperVal = parseInt(upperSlider.value);

		document.getElementById("upper-label").textContent = dateTooltipLabels[upperVal -1]

		// when the two sliders touch, let the upper "push" the lower:
		if (upperVal < lowerVal ) {
			lowerSlider.value = upperVal;
			lowerVal = upperVal;
			document.getElementById("lower-label").textContent = dateTooltipLabels[lowerVal -1]
		}

		sliceDatasetsAndUpdateChart();
	};



</script>

<script>
  let shouldDisableVisitCalendar = false
  let shouldCancelAllUpcomingVisits = false
  let callbackAfterConfirm = null

  function resetCancelVisitsModalData() {
    shouldDisableVisitCalendar = false
    shouldCancelAllUpcomingVisits = false
    callbackAfterConfirm = null
  }

  function openPropertyCancelVisitsModal(callback = null) {
    resetCancelVisitsModalData()

    $('#cancel_existing_visits_checkbox').prop('checked', shouldCancelAllUpcomingVisits);
    const checkboxContainer = $('#cancel_existing_visits_container');

    if (typeof numberOfUpcomingVisits !== 'undefined' && numberOfUpcomingVisits > 0) {
      checkboxContainer.show();
    } else {
      checkboxContainer.hide();
    }
    
    $('#property_cancel_visits_modal')[0].showModal();
    callbackAfterConfirm = callback
  }

  function closePropertyCancelVisitsModal() {
    resetCancelVisitsModalData()
    restart_reservation_forms()
    $('#property_cancel_visits_modal')[0].close();
  }
  
  function confirmPropertCancelVisitModal() {
    shouldDisableVisitCalendar = true
    const checkboxContainer = $('#cancel_existing_visits_checkbox');
    if ($('#cancel_existing_visits_checkbox').is(":checked")) {
      shouldCancelAllUpcomingVisits = true
    }
    $('#property_cancel_visits_modal')[0].close();
    
    if (callbackAfterConfirm) {
      callbackAfterConfirm()
    }
  }

  async function handleDisableVisitCalendar() {
    if (shouldDisableVisitCalendar) {
      const propertyId = 8002445
      const url = `/api3/booking/calendar_status`
      const payload = {
        property_id: propertyId,
        status: 0
      }

      if (shouldCancelAllUpcomingVisits) {
        payload.cancel_upcoming_events = true
      }

      return fetch(url, {
        method: 'PUT',
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload),
      })
    }
  }
</script>

function showAddresModal(){
  $('#modal_address_inputs_container').fadeIn();

function hideAddressModal(){
  $('#modal_address_inputs_container').hide();

function applyAddressFormValues() {
 const inputs = $('#modal_address_inputs_container input');
  inputs.each(function() {
    let initValue = $(this).data('init');
    if (initValue && typeof initValue === 'string') {
      initValue = initValue
        .replace(/\\u([0-9a-fA-F]{4})/g, function(match, code) {
          return String.fromCharCode(parseInt(code, 16));
        })
        .replace(/\\([0-9]{3})/g, function(match, code) {
          return String.fromCharCode(parseInt(code, 8));
        })
        .replace(/\\x([0-9a-fA-F]{2})/g, function(match, code) {
          return String.fromCharCode(parseInt(code, 16));
        });
    }
    $(this).val(initValue);
    $(this).data('manual-change', false);
  });
  $('#reset_full_address_btn').addClass('disabled');
  $('#reset_publishing_address_btn').addClass('disabled');
  $('#reset_full_address_en_btn').addClass('disabled');
  $('#reset_publishing_address_en_btn').addClass('disabled');
}

const updateDisplayValue = (elementId, value, placeholder) => {
  if (value && value.trim() !== '') {
    $(elementId).text(value);
  } else {
    $(elementId).text(placeholder);
  }
};

async function submitAddressForm(btnSubmit) {
  $(btnSubmit).addClass('disabled');
  const propertyId = 8002445;
  const url = `/api3/properties/${propertyId}/address/`;
  const input = $('#modal_address_inputs_container input');
  const formData = {};

  input.each(function() {
    const dBKey = $(this).attr('name');
    formData[dBKey] = $(this).val().trim();
  });


  try {
    const response = await fetch(url, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'X-CSRFToken': $('[name=csrfmiddlewaretoken]').val()
      },
      body: JSON.stringify(formData)
    });

    const data = await response.json();

    if (data.error) {
      throw new Error(data.error);
    }
    if (typeof needUpdateQACompScore === 'function') {
        needUpdateQACompScore();
    }
    if (typeof needUpdateQAPriceReport === 'function') {
        needUpdateQAPriceReport();
    }
    input.each(function() {
      const dBKey = $(this).attr('name');
      const newValue = formData[dBKey];
      $(this).data('init', newValue);
      if (dBKey === 'address') {
        updateDisplayValue('#address', newValue, 'Hacé click para editar');
      }
      if (dBKey === 'fake_address') {
        updateDisplayValue('#fake_address', newValue, 'Hacé click para editar');
      }
      if (dBKey === 'address_en') {
        updateDisplayValue('#address_en', newValue, 'Hacé click para editar');
      }
      if (dBKey === 'fake_address_en') {
        updateDisplayValue('#fake_address_en', newValue, 'Hacé click para editar');
      }
    });
  } catch (error) {
    showToast('Error al actualizar la dirección', { variant: 'error' })
    console.error('Error:', error);
  }
  hideAddressModal();
  $(btnSubmit).removeClass('disabled');
}

function buildFullAddress() {
    var components = [];
    const lang = $('#modal_address_inputs_container').attr('data-lang');
    const enLang = (lang === 'en');

    const inputsLabels = {
      'floor': enLang ? 'Floor' : 'Piso',
      'apartment_door': enLang ? 'Apartment' : 'Departamento',
      'section_number': enLang ? 'Section' : 'Sección',
      'block_number': enLang ? 'Block' : 'Bloque',
      'address_complement': enLang ? 'Complement' : 'Complemento',
      'lot_number': enLang ? 'Lot' : 'Lote',
      'building': enLang ? 'Building' : 'Edificio'
    };
    const inputsUpdater = $('#modal_address_inputs_container input[updater]');
    inputsUpdater.each(function() {
        const value = $(this).val()?.trim() || '';
        const label = inputsLabels[$(this).attr('name')] || '';
        if (value) {
            components.push((label ? label + ' ' : '') + value);
        }
    });
    return components.join(' ').slice(0, 1000);
}

function buildPublishingAddress() {
    var components = [];

    var street = $('#street').val().trim();
    var streetNumber = $('#street_number').val().trim();

    if (street) {
        components.push(street);
    }
    if (streetNumber) {
        var formattedNumber = formatStreetNumberForPublishing(streetNumber);
        if (formattedNumber) {
            components.push(formattedNumber);
        }
    }
    return components.join(' ').slice(0, 200);
}
function formatStreetNumberForPublishing(streetNumber) {
    if (!streetNumber || streetNumber === '') {
        return '';
    }

    var numericValue = streetNumber.replace(/\D/g, '');

    if (numericValue === '') {
        return '';
    }

    if (numericValue.length <= 2) {
        return 'al ' + numericValue;
    }

    var fakedNumber = Math.floor(numericValue / 100) * 100
    return 'al ' + fakedNumber
}

// Validation function to check if address fields are coupled or decoupled
function validateAddressCoupling() {
    const lang = $('#modal_address_inputs_container').attr('data-lang');
    const enLang = (lang === 'en');

    const addressInput = enLang ? $('#modal_full_address_en') : $('#modal_full_address');
    const publishingAddressInput = enLang ? $('#modal_publishing_address_en') : $('#modal_publishing_address');

    const expectedFullAddress = buildFullAddress();
    const expectedPublishingAddress = buildPublishingAddress();

    const currentFullAddress = addressInput.val().trim();
    const currentPublishingAddress = publishingAddressInput.val().trim();

    // Normalize strings for comparison (trim and handle null/undefined)
    const normalizeForComparison = (str) => (str || '').toString().trim();

    const isFullAddressCoupled = (normalizeForComparison(currentFullAddress) === normalizeForComparison(expectedFullAddress));

    const isPublishingAddressCoupled = (normalizeForComparison(currentPublishingAddress) === normalizeForComparison(expectedPublishingAddress));

    addressInput.data('manual-change', !isFullAddressCoupled);
    publishingAddressInput.data('manual-change', !isPublishingAddressCoupled);

    const resetAddressBtn = enLang ? $('#reset_full_address_en_btn') : $('#reset_full_address_btn');
    const resetPublishingBtn = enLang ? $('#reset_publishing_address_en_btn') : $('#reset_publishing_address_btn');

    if (isFullAddressCoupled) {
        resetAddressBtn.addClass('disabled');
    } else {
        resetAddressBtn.removeClass('disabled');
    }

    if (isPublishingAddressCoupled) {
        resetPublishingBtn.addClass('disabled');
    } else {
        resetPublishingBtn.removeClass('disabled');
    }
}

<script>
const ZIPCODE_ENABLED = "False" === 'True' ? true : false;
const IS_FROM_MODAL = "True" === 'True' ? true : false;
const STORAGE_KEY = 'zipcodeSuggestedDivisions';
const ZIPCODE_AND_TEXT = "Y";
const ZIPCODE_MORE_TEXT = "más";

function formatZipCodesList(zipCodes) {
    if (!zipCodes || zipCodes.length === 0) {
        return '';
    }
    const displayedZipCodes = zipCodes.slice(0, 30);
    const zipCodesText = displayedZipCodes.join(', ');
    if (zipCodes.length > 30) {
        const remainingCount = zipCodes.length - 30;
        return zipCodesText + ' ' + ZIPCODE_AND_TEXT + ' ' + remainingCount + ' ' + ZIPCODE_MORE_TEXT;
    }
    return zipCodesText;
}

const SELECTORS = {

        INPUT: '#input-search-location',
        RESULTS_LIST: '#new_prop_search_locations_list',

        SELECT:'#new-prop-zipcode-select',
        SPAN_SELECTION: '#zipcode-selected',
        SPAN_LIST_SELECTION: '#new-prop-zipcode-selected',
        LIST: '#new-prop-zipcode-list',
        SUGGESTIONCARD: '#zipcode-suggestion-card',
        SUGGEESTION_MODAL:"#zipcodeSuggestionModal"

};
const callBackForTitle = typeof setPublicationTitle !== 'undefined' ? setPublicationTitle : ()=> {};

const UIState = {
    resetSearchState: () => {
        LocationUtils.DOMUtils.hide(SELECTORS.SEARCH.RESULTS_LIST);
        LocationUtils.DOMUtils.hide(SELECTORS.SEARCH.SPINNER);
        LocationUtils.DOMUtils.hide(SELECTORS.SEARCH.CLOSE_BUTTON);
    },
    showSearching: () => {
        LocationUtils.DOMUtils.show(SELECTORS.SEARCH.SPINNER);
        LocationUtils.DOMUtils.hide(SELECTORS.SEARCH.CLOSE_BUTTON);
    },
    showResults: () => {
        LocationUtils.DOMUtils.hide(SELECTORS.SEARCH.SPINNER);
        LocationUtils.DOMUtils.show(SELECTORS.SEARCH.CLOSE_BUTTON);
        LocationUtils.DOMUtils.show(SELECTORS.SEARCH.RESULTS_LIST);
    },
    resetDivisionSelection: () => {
        location_levels.forEach(level => {
            const selectedElem = document.querySelector(`#new-prop-${level}-selected`);
            selectedElem.dataset.selectedValue = "0";
            selectedElem.innerHTML = "";
            document.querySelector(`#li${level}cont`).classList.add(LocationUtils.CLASSES.CLOSE);
        });
        LocationUtils.DOMUtils.hide(SELECTORS.LOCATION.SELECTED_CONTAINER);
    },
    showZipCodeContainer: () => {
        LocationUtils.DOMUtils.show(SELECTORS.ZIPCODE.CONTAINER);
    },
    hideZipCodeContainer: () => {
        LocationUtils.DOMUtils.hide(SELECTORS.ZIPCODE.CONTAINER);
    },
    resetZipcodeState: () => {
        const zipList = LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement(SELECTORS.ZIPCODE.LIST);
        if (zipList) {
            zipList.innerHTML = '';
            zipList.dataset.allZipCodes = JSON.stringify([]);
            zipList.dataset.manualZipcodes = JSON.stringify([]);
        }
        const zipSelectedSpan = LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement(SELECTORS.ZIPCODE.SPAN_SELECTION);
        if (zipSelectedSpan) {
            zipSelectedSpan.textContent = '';
            zipSelectedSpan.dataset.selectedValue = '0';
            zipSelectedSpan.dataset.allZipCodes = '[]';
        }
        const zipListSelected = LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement(SELECTORS.ZIPCODE.SPAN_LIST_SELECTION);
        if (zipListSelected) {
            zipListSelected.textContent = '';
            zipListSelected.dataset.selectedValue = '0';
        }
        const zipcodeSearchInput = document.getElementById('search-input-zipcode-type');
        if (zipcodeSearchInput) {
            zipcodeSearchInput.value = '';
        }
        if (typeof initialZipcode !== 'undefined') {
            initialZipcode = '0';
        }
    }
};

const location_levels = ['country', 'region', 'zone', 'subzone', 'subsubzone', 'subsubzone2', 'subsubzone3']
const locations_urls = {'country': "/locations/regions_json?country=",
                        'region': "/locations/divisions_json?state=",
                        'zone': "/locations/divisions_json?division=",
                        'subzone': "/locations/divisions_json?division=",
                        'subsubzone': "/locations/divisions_json?division=",
                        'subsubzone2': "/locations/divisions_json?division=",
                        'subsubzone3': "/locations/divisions_json?division=",
                    }

let currentLocationRequest = null;


function showCountrySelect(){
    let country_code = "1";
    let trySelect = () => {
        let country_elem = document.querySelector(`#new-prop-country-list [data-value='${country_code}']`);
        if (country_elem) {
            country_elem.click();
            LocationUtils.DOMUtils.open('#licountrycont');
            document.getElementById('new-prop-country-select').focus();
            LocationUtils.DOMUtils.close(SELECTORS.LOCATION.MANUAL_BUTTON);
        } else {
            setTimeout(trySelect, 100);
        }
    }
    trySelect();
}

function loadLocation(dom_elem, level_index, location_array) {
    const level = location_levels[level_index];
    const next_level = location_levels[level_index + 1];
    const prev_level = location_levels[level_index - 1];
    const selected_elem = `#new-prop-${level}-select`;
    const select_elem = `#new-prop-${level}-selected`;
    const locationSelectedSpan = LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement(SELECTORS.LOCATION.SELECTED_SPAN);
    const hideZipcodeBlock = level_index < 2  && !location_array;
    const isLastPreloadLevel = location_array && location_array.length === level_index + 1;

    DropdownUtils.setSelectedValue(dom_elem, select_elem, selected_elem);
    
    LocationUtils.hideNextLevels(level_index);        

    if (dom_elem.dataset.value == 0) {
        if(level_index == 0) {
            locationSelectedSpan.dataset.location_id = '';
            locationSelectedSpan.innerHTML = "";
        } else {
            cleanQuicksearch();
            const prev_level_span = document.querySelector(`#new-prop-${prev_level}-selected`);
            locationSelectedSpan.dataset.location_id = prev_level_span.dataset.selectedValue;
            locationSelectedSpan.innerHTML = prev_level_span.innerHTML;
        }
        callBackForTitle();

        if(level_index + 1 < 3) document.getElementById(`new-prop-${next_level}-select`).classList.add('is-empty');
    } else {
        const searchInput = document.querySelector(SELECTORS.SEARCH.INPUT);

        if( hideZipcodeBlock) {
            UIState.hideZipCodeContainer();
            LocationUtils.DOMUtils.hide(SELECTORS.ZIPCODE.SUGGESTIONCARD);
        }
        
        document.querySelector(`#new-prop-${level}-select`).classList.remove('is-empty', 'blue-border');
        searchInput.classList.remove('is-empty', 'blue-border');
        DropdownUtils.hideBlueAlert();

        if (location_array == null) {
            if(level_index == 0) {
                locationSelectedSpan.innerHTML = `${dom_elem.textContent}`;
            } else {
                locationSelectedSpan.innerHTML =
                        `${dom_elem.textContent}, ${document.getElementById(`new-prop-${prev_level}-selected`).innerHTML}`;
                locationSelectedSpan.dataset.location_id = dom_elem.dataset.value;            
            }
            callBackForTitle();
        }

        DropdownUtils.showElement(SELECTORS.LOCATION.EDIT_BUTTON);

        const isLevelValid = level_index >= 2;
        const hasValidDivisionValue = dom_elem.dataset.value != 0;
        const shouldFetchZipcode = !location_array || searchInput.dataset.zipcode_entry === 'false';

        const needsZipcodeFetch = isLevelValid && hasValidDivisionValue && shouldFetchZipcode;
        if (needsZipcodeFetch && ZIPCODE_ENABLED) { 
            const zipContainer = LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement(SELECTORS.ZIPCODE.CONTAINER);
            const isZipcodeVisible = !zipContainer.classList.contains('close');

            if (isZipcodeVisible) {
                showZipcodeLoading();
            }
            
            $.ajax({
                url: "/api3/locations/get_zipcode_division?id=" + dom_elem.dataset.value,
                type: 'GET',
                success: function(result) {

                    if(isLastPreloadLevel && typeof loadingSpanID !== 'undefined' && loadingSpanID){
                        const loadingSpan = document.querySelector(loadingSpanID);
                        if (loadingSpan) {
                            LocationUtils.DOMUtils.hide(loadingSpan);
                        }
                    }
                    
                    if (isZipcodeVisible) {
                        hideZipcodeLoading();
                    }
                    const zipCodes = result && result.zip_codes ? result.zip_codes : [];
                    const zipList = LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement(SELECTORS.ZIPCODE.LIST);
                    if (zipCodes && zipCodes.length > 0) {
                        updateZipCodeDisplay(zipCodes, true);
                    } else {
                        if (zipList) {
                            zipList.dataset.allZipCodes = JSON.stringify([]);
                        }
                        updateZipCodeDisplay([], true);
                        LocationUtils.DOMUtils.show(SELECTORS.ZIPCODE.SUGGESTIONCARD)
                        if (isZipcodeVisible) {
                            hideZipcodeLoading();

                        }
                    }},
                    error: function() {
                        if (isZipcodeVisible) {
                            hideZipcodeLoading();
                            const zipList = LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement(SELECTORS.ZIPCODE.LIST);
                            if (zipList) {
                                zipList.dataset.allZipCodes = JSON.stringify([]);
                            }
                            updateZipCodeDisplay([], true);
                        }

                    }
                });
        }

        if(level_index < 7 && (location_array == null || location_array.length > level_index + 1)) {
            if (currentLocationRequest) {   
                currentLocationRequest.abort();
                currentLocationRequest = null;
            }
            
            const fetch_locations = locations_urls[level];
            const url = `${fetch_locations}${dom_elem.dataset.value}`;
            
            currentLocationRequest = $.ajax(url)
                .done(function(result) {
                    currentLocationRequest = null;
                    
                    eval('var data = ' + result);
                    let json_data = data;
                    
                    const nextLevelList = document.querySelector(`#new-prop-${next_level}-list`);
                    const nextLevelCont = document.querySelector(`#li${next_level}cont`);
                    nextLevelList.innerHTML = `
                        <div class="container-input-search">
                            <i class="icon icon-buscar"></i>
                            <input type="text" id="search-input-${next_level}-type" class="body-small" name="${next_level}" autocomplete="off" placeholder="Buscar" onkeyup="DropdownUtils.searchList('search-input-${next_level}-type', 'new-prop-${next_level}-list', 'select-list-element')">
                        </div>
                    `;

                    let hasValidOptions = false;
                    for (let index in json_data) {
                        if (index != 'selected' && index != 0) {
                            hasValidOptions = true;
                            let new_option = document.createElement('DIV');
                            new_option.classList = "select-list-element";
                            new_option.dataset.value = index;
                            new_option.addEventListener('click', () => loadLocation(new_option, level_index + 1, null));
                            new_option.innerHTML = json_data[index];
                            nextLevelList.append(new_option);
                        }
                                        }
                    
                    if (hasValidOptions || (location_array && location_array.length > level_index + 1)) {
                        nextLevelCont.classList.remove('close');
                        const nextSelectContainer = document.querySelector(`#new-prop-${next_level}-select`);
                        if (nextSelectContainer) {
                        nextSelectContainer.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
                        nextSelectContainer.setAttribute('data-index', String(level_index + 1));
                        nextSelectContainer.focus();
                        }
                        if (location_array && location_array.length > level_index + 1) {
                            let selected_location = document.querySelector(`#new-prop-${next_level}-list [data-value="${location_array[level_index + 1]}"]`);
                            if (selected_location) {
                                loadLocation(selected_location, level_index + 1, location_array);
                            }
                        } else {
                            document.querySelector(`#new-prop-${next_level}-selected`).innerHTML = json_data[0];
                            if(level_index + 1 < 3) {
                                document.querySelector(`#new-prop-${next_level}-select`).classList.add('is-empty');
                            }
                        }
                    }
                })
                .fail(function(xhr, status, error) {
                    currentLocationRequest = null;
                    const nextLevelCont = document.querySelector(`#li${next_level}cont`)
                    if (status !== 'abort') {
                        if(level_index < 6) nextLevelCont.classList.add('close');
                    }
                });
        }
    }
}

function setLocation(elem){
    const displayText = elem.dataset.originalText || elem.textContent.trim();
    const selectedSpan = LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement(SELECTORS.LOCATION.SELECTED_SPAN);
    const locationInput = LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement(SELECTORS.SEARCH.INPUT);
    
    selectedSpan.dataset.location_id = elem.dataset.location_id;
    
    selectedSpan.innerHTML = displayText;
    DropdownUtils.hideElement(SELECTORS.SEARCH.CONTAINER);
    document.querySelector(SELECTORS.LOCATION.SELECTED_CONTAINER).classList.remove('display-none');
    
    DropdownUtils.hideElement(SELECTORS.SEARCH.RESULTS_LIST);
    locationInput.value = "";
    locationInput.classList.remove('is-empty', 'blue-border');
    DropdownUtils.hideBlueAlert();

    var jqxhr = $.ajax("/locations/get_location_array?type=division&id="+elem.dataset.location_id)
    .done(function(result) {
        if (result == 'None'){
            showSearchLocation();
            return;
        }
        eval("var location_array = [" + result + "]");
        
        document.querySelectorAll('.manual-search').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('close'));
        
        location_levels.forEach((level, index) => {
            document.querySelector(`#li${level}cont`).classList.add('close');
            const selectedElem = document.querySelector(`#new-prop-${level}-selected`);
            selectedElem.dataset.selectedValue = "0";
            selectedElem.innerHTML = "";
        });

        document.querySelector('#licountrycont').classList.remove('close');
        let country_elem = document.querySelector(`#new-prop-country-list [data-value="${location_array[0]}"]`);
        if (country_elem) {
            loadLocation(country_elem, 0, location_array);
        }
        
        callBackForTitle();
    })
    .fail(function(err) {
        showSearchLocation();
    });
}

function setPreLocation(locactionArray,initialDivisionId){
    const locationInput = LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement(SELECTORS.SEARCH.INPUT);
    const selectedSpan = LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement(SELECTORS.LOCATION.SELECTED_SPAN);
    selectedSpan.dataset.location_id = initialDivisionId;
    
    DropdownUtils.hideElement(SELECTORS.SEARCH.RESULTS_LIST);
    locationInput.value = "";
    locationInput.classList.remove('is-empty', 'blue-border');
    DropdownUtils.hideBlueAlert();

    document.querySelectorAll('.manual-search').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('close'));
        
    location_levels.forEach((level, index) => {
        document.querySelector(`#li${level}cont`).classList.add('close');
        const selectedElem = document.querySelector(`#new-prop-${level}-selected`);
        selectedElem.dataset.selectedValue = "0";
        selectedElem.innerHTML = "";
    });

    document.querySelector('#licountrycont').classList.remove('close');
    waitForCountryAndLoad(locactionArray);
}

function showSearchLocation(){  
    selectedLocationIndex = -1;
    
    const locationSelected = LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement(SELECTORS.LOCATION.SELECTED_SPAN);
    const searchInput = LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement(SELECTORS.SEARCH.INPUT);
    
    if (locationSelected.textContent) {
        const displayText = locationSelected.textContent.replace(/\s*\([^)]*\)\s*$/, '').trim();
        searchInput.value = displayText;
        searchLocation(displayText);
        
        LocationUtils.DOMUtils.hide(SELECTORS.LOCATION.SELECTED_CONTAINER);
        LocationUtils.DOMUtils.show(SELECTORS.SEARCH.CONTAINER);
        searchInput.focus();
    } else {
        UIState.resetSearchState();
        searchInput.value = '';
        
        LocationUtils.DOMUtils.hide(SELECTORS.LOCATION.SELECTED_CONTAINER);
        LocationUtils.DOMUtils.setText(SELECTORS.LOCATION.SELECTED_SPAN, '');
        LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement(`${SELECTORS.LOCATION.SELECTED_CONTAINER} span`).dataset.location_id = '';
        
        document.querySelectorAll('.manual-search').forEach(el => el.classList.add(LocationUtils.CLASSES.CLOSE));
        LocationUtils.DOMUtils.open(SELECTORS.LOCATION.MANUAL_BUTTON);
        
        LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement(SELECTORS.SEARCH.INPUT).classList.add(LocationUtils.CLASSES.IS_EMPTY);
        LocationUtils.DOMUtils.show(SELECTORS.SEARCH.CONTAINER);
    }
}

function showZipcodeLoading() {
  const spinner = document.getElementById('zipcode-spinner');
  const zipSpan = document.getElementById('zipcode-selected');
  const wrongCodeBtn = document.getElementById('wrong-code-btn');

  if (spinner) spinner.style.display = 'inline';
  if (wrongCodeBtn) LocationUtils.DOMUtils.hide(wrongCodeBtn);
}

function hideZipcodeLoading() {
  const spinner = document.getElementById('zipcode-spinner');
  if (spinner) spinner.style.display = 'none';
}

function getPropertyZipcodeIfAvailable() {
    if (IS_FROM_MODAL && typeof initialZipcode !== 'undefined' && initialZipcode && initialZipcode !== '0') {
        return initialZipcode;
    }
    return null;
}

function getZipcodesWithPropertyZipcode(zipCodes) {
    const propertyZipcode = getPropertyZipcodeIfAvailable();
    if (!propertyZipcode) {
        return zipCodes.slice();
    }
    
    const normalizedPropertyZip = normalizeSearchText(propertyZipcode);
    const isInList = zipCodes.some(function(zip) {
        return normalizeSearchText(zip) === normalizedPropertyZip;
    });
    
    if (!isInList) {
        return zipCodes.slice().concat([propertyZipcode]);
    }
    return zipCodes.slice();
}

function selectPropertyZipcodeIfAvailable() {
    const propertyZipcode = getPropertyZipcodeIfAvailable();
    if (!propertyZipcode) {
        return;
    }
    
    setTimeout(function() {
        const zipList = LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement(SELECTORS.ZIPCODE.LIST);
        const normalizedPropertyZip = normalizeSearchText(propertyZipcode);
        const zipcodeElements = zipList.querySelectorAll('.select-list-element');
        
        for (let i = 0; i < zipcodeElements.length; i++) {
            const element = zipcodeElements[i];
            if (element.classList.contains('unmatched-zipcode')) {
                continue;
            }
            const elementZip = element.dataset.value;
            if (normalizeSearchText(elementZip) === normalizedPropertyZip) {
                selectZipcodeOption(element);
                break;
            }
        }
    }, 100);
}

function uploadZipcodeList(zipcodeList, zipListElem, suggestionSent = false, manualZipcodes = []) {
    let shouldSelectFirstOption;
    const initialZip = IS_FROM_MODAL ? initialZipcode : false
    if(IS_FROM_MODAL && initialZip && initialZip === '0'){
        shouldSelectFirstOption = suggestionSent
    }
    if(!IS_FROM_MODAL ){
        shouldSelectFirstOption = suggestionSent
    }

    zipcodeList.forEach((code,index) => {
        const div = document.createElement('div');
        div.classList.add('select-list-element');
        div.dataset.value = code;
        div.textContent = code;
        div.onclick = () => selectZipcodeOption(div);
        
        if (shouldSelectFirstOption && index === 0) {
            selectZipcodeOption(div)
        }
        else if (initialZip && initialZip === code) {
            selectZipcodeOption(div); 
        }
        zipListElem.appendChild(div);
    });
    
    updateResetButton(zipListElem, manualZipcodes);
}

    const existingResetBtn = zipSelectContainer.querySelector('.reset-zipcode-btn');
