function removeManualZipcode(zipList) {
    const allZipcodes = zipList.dataset.allZipCodes ? JSON.parse(zipList.dataset.allZipCodes) : [];
    const manualZipcodes = zipList.dataset.manualZipcodes ? JSON.parse(zipList.dataset.manualZipcodes) : [];
    const division_id = LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement(SELECTORS.LOCATION.SELECTED_SPAN).dataset.location_id;
    const hasSuggestion = hasZipcodeSuggestion(division_id);
    
    const updatedZipcodes = allZipcodes.filter(code => !manualZipcodes.includes(code));
    zipList.dataset.allZipCodes = JSON.stringify(updatedZipcodes);
    zipList.dataset.manualZipcodes = JSON.stringify([]);
    
    const zipListSelected = LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement(SELECTORS.ZIPCODE.SPAN_LIST_SELECTION);
    const enteredZipCode = LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement(SELECTORS.ZIPCODE.SPAN_SELECTION);
    const singleZipContainer = document.getElementById('new-prop-zipcode-onlyone');
    const zipSelectContainer = document.getElementById('new-prop-zipcode-select');
    
    if (updatedZipcodes.length === 0) {
        changesCallback("0");
        UIState.hideZipCodeContainer();
        enteredZipCode.textContent = '';
        enteredZipCode.dataset.selectedValue = '0';
        zipListSelected.dataset.selectedValue = '0';
        enteredZipCode.dataset.allZipCodes = '[]';
    } else if (updatedZipcodes.length === 1) {
        LocationUtils.DOMUtils.hide(zipSelectContainer);
        enteredZipCode.textContent = updatedZipcodes[0];
        enteredZipCode.dataset.selectedValue = updatedZipcodes[0];
        enteredZipCode.dataset.allZipCodes = JSON.stringify(updatedZipcodes);
        zipListSelected.dataset.selectedValue = 0;
        LocationUtils.DOMUtils.show(singleZipContainer);
        changesCallback(updatedZipcodes[0]);
    } else {
        zipList.querySelectorAll('.select-list-element').forEach(el => el.remove());
        
        uploadZipcodeList(updatedZipcodes, zipList, false, []);
        
        if (!hasSuggestion) {
            const wrongCodeListElement = document.createElement('div');
            wrongCodeListElement.classList.add('select-list-element', 'unmatched-zipcode');
            wrongCodeListElement.textContent = "¿Ningún código postal coincide con la ubicación?";
            wrongCodeListElement.addEventListener('click', function() {
                handleModalSuggestion(true, true);
            });
            wrongCodeListElement.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
            zipList.appendChild(wrongCodeListElement);
        }
        
        if (hasSuggestion) {
            const existingEditManually = zipList.querySelector('.edit-manually-zipcode');
            if (!existingEditManually) {
                const editManuallyElement = document.createElement('div');
                editManuallyElement.classList.add('select-list-element', 'edit-manually-zipcode');
                editManuallyElement.textContent = "Editar manualmente";
                editManuallyElement.addEventListener('click', function() {
                    handleEditManuallyClick();
                });
                editManuallyElement.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
                zipList.appendChild(editManuallyElement);
            }
        }
        
        zipListSelected.textContent = zipListSelected.dataset.placeholder;
        zipListSelected.dataset.selectedValue = '0';
        enteredZipCode.dataset.selectedValue = '0';
    }
}

function switchZipcodeTab(tab, disableSuggestTab = false) {
    const suggestTab = document.getElementById('suggestNewCodeTab');
    const manualTab = document.getElementById('enterManuallyTab');
    const suggestContent = document.getElementById('suggestNewCodeContent');
    const manualContent = document.getElementById('enterManuallyContent');
    const division_id = LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement(SELECTORS.LOCATION.SELECTED_SPAN).dataset.location_id;
    const hasSuggestion = hasZipcodeSuggestion(division_id);
    
    const shouldDisableSuggest = disableSuggestTab || (tab === 'manual' && hasSuggestion);
    
    if (tab === 'suggest') {
        suggestTab.classList.add('active');
        manualTab.classList.remove('active');
        if (shouldDisableSuggest) {
            suggestTab.classList.add('disabled');
            suggestTab.disabled = true;
        } else {
            suggestTab.classList.remove('disabled');
            suggestTab.disabled = false;
        }
        LocationUtils.DOMUtils.show(suggestContent);
        LocationUtils.DOMUtils.hide(manualContent);
    } else {
        suggestTab.classList.remove('active');
        manualTab.classList.add('active');
        if (shouldDisableSuggest) {
            suggestTab.classList.add('disabled');
            suggestTab.disabled = true;
        } else {
            suggestTab.classList.remove('disabled');
            suggestTab.disabled = false;
        }
        LocationUtils.DOMUtils.hide(suggestContent);
        LocationUtils.DOMUtils.show(manualContent);
        
        const zipList = LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement(SELECTORS.ZIPCODE.LIST);
        const enterManuallyZipcodesSpan = LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement("#enterManually_modal_zipcodes");
        const enterManuallyZipcodesContainer = LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement("#enterManuallyCurrentZipcodes");
        const zipCodes = zipList.dataset.allZipCodes ? JSON.parse(zipList.dataset.allZipCodes) : [];
        if (zipCodes && zipCodes.length > 0) {
            enterManuallyZipcodesSpan.textContent = formatZipCodesList(zipCodes);
            LocationUtils.DOMUtils.show(enterManuallyZipcodesContainer);
        } else {
            LocationUtils.DOMUtils.hide(enterManuallyZipcodesContainer);
        }
    }
    
    const inputId = tab === 'suggest' ? 'suggestionZipcodeInput' : 'manualZipcodeInput';
    const input = document.getElementById(inputId);
    if (input) {
        verifyCodeJoined(input.value, tab);
    }
}

function handleEditManuallyClick() {
    const zipList = LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement(SELECTORS.ZIPCODE.LIST);
    const suggestionCard = LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement(SELECTORS.ZIPCODE.SUGGESTIONCARD);
    const isSuggestionCardVisible = suggestionCard && !suggestionCard.classList.contains('display-none');
    
    let zipcodesToChange = [];
    if (!isSuggestionCardVisible && zipList && zipList.dataset.allZipCodes) {
        try {
            const parsedZipcodes = JSON.parse(zipList.dataset.allZipCodes);
            if (Array.isArray(parsedZipcodes) && parsedZipcodes.length > 0) {
                zipcodesToChange = parsedZipcodes;
            }
        } catch (e) {
            zipcodesToChange = [];
        }
    }
    
    const zipCodeContainer = LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement(".modal_suggestion_zipcodes_content");
    const modalZipCodesSpan = LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement("#suggestion_modal_zipcodes");
    const enterManuallyZipcodesSpan = LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement("#enterManually_modal_zipcodes");
    const enterManuallyZipcodesContainer = LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement("#enterManuallyCurrentZipcodes");
    
    if (zipcodesToChange && zipcodesToChange.length > 0) {
        const formattedText = formatZipCodesList(zipcodesToChange);
        modalZipCodesSpan.textContent = formattedText;
        enterManuallyZipcodesSpan.textContent = formattedText;
        LocationUtils.DOMUtils.show(zipCodeContainer);
        LocationUtils.DOMUtils.show(enterManuallyZipcodesContainer);
    } else {
        modalZipCodesSpan.textContent = '';
        enterManuallyZipcodesSpan.textContent = '';
        LocationUtils.DOMUtils.hide(zipCodeContainer);
        LocationUtils.DOMUtils.hide(enterManuallyZipcodesContainer);
    }
    
    applyLocationInModal();
    switchZipcodeTab('manual', true);
    LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement("#confirmSuggestionBtn").classList.add('disabled');
    LocationUtils.DOMUtils.show(SELECTORS.ZIPCODE.SUGGEESTION_MODAL);
}

function handleModalSuggestion(open, withZipCode=false) {
    const locationModal = LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement("#locationSelectionModal");

    if (!ZIPCODE_ENABLED) return;
    LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement("#suggestionZipcodeInput").value = '';
    LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement("#manualZipcodeInput").value = '';
    const zipCodeContainer = LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement(".modal_suggestion_zipcodes_content");
    if (!open) {
        LocationUtils.DOMUtils.hide(SELECTORS.ZIPCODE.SUGGEESTION_MODAL);
        if (IS_FROM_MODAL && locationModal) LocationUtils.DOMUtils.show(locationModal);
        const suggestTab = document.getElementById('suggestNewCodeTab');
        if (suggestTab) {
            suggestTab.classList.remove('disabled');
            suggestTab.disabled = false;
        }
        return;
    }
    if (IS_FROM_MODAL && locationModal) LocationUtils.DOMUtils.hide(locationModal);

    switchZipcodeTab('suggest', false);
    
    if (withZipCode) {
        const zipList = LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement(SELECTORS.ZIPCODE.LIST);
        const modalZipCodesSpan = LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement("#suggestion_modal_zipcodes");
        const zipCodes = zipList.dataset.allZipCodes ? JSON.parse(zipList.dataset.allZipCodes) : [];
        if (zipCodes && zipCodes.length > 0) {
            modalZipCodesSpan.textContent = formatZipCodesList(zipCodes);
        } 
        LocationUtils.DOMUtils.show(zipCodeContainer);
    }else{
        LocationUtils.DOMUtils.hide(zipCodeContainer);
    }
    applyLocationInModal();
    LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement("#confirmSuggestionBtn").classList.add('disabled');
    LocationUtils.DOMUtils.show(SELECTORS.ZIPCODE.SUGGEESTION_MODAL);
}

function handleEnterManuallySubmit() {
    const manualZipcodeInput = LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement("#manualZipcodeInput");
    const zipList = LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement(SELECTORS.ZIPCODE.LIST);
    const zipcodesToChange = zipList.dataset.allZipCodes ? JSON.parse(zipList.dataset.allZipCodes) : [];
    const manualZipcodeValue = manualZipcodeInput.value.trim();
    
    if (!manualZipcodeValue) {
        return;
    }
    
    const singleZipContainer = document.getElementById('new-prop-zipcode-onlyone');
    const zipSelectContainer = document.getElementById('new-prop-zipcode-select');
    const enteredZipCode = LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement(SELECTORS.ZIPCODE.SPAN_SELECTION);
    const zipListSelected = LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement(SELECTORS.ZIPCODE.SPAN_LIST_SELECTION);
    
    const existingZipcodes = zipcodesToChange.length > 0 ? zipcodesToChange : [];
    const allZipcodes = existingZipcodes.includes(manualZipcodeValue) 
        ? existingZipcodes 
        : [...existingZipcodes, manualZipcodeValue];
    
    const manualZipcodes = zipList.dataset.manualZipcodes ? JSON.parse(zipList.dataset.manualZipcodes) : [];
    if (!manualZipcodes.includes(manualZipcodeValue)) {
        manualZipcodes.push(manualZipcodeValue);
        zipList.dataset.manualZipcodes = JSON.stringify(manualZipcodes);
    }
    
    if (allZipcodes.length === 1) {
        LocationUtils.DOMUtils.hide(zipSelectContainer);
        enteredZipCode.textContent = allZipcodes[0];
        enteredZipCode.dataset.selectedValue = allZipcodes[0];
        enteredZipCode.dataset.allZipCodes = JSON.stringify(allZipcodes);
        zipListSelected.dataset.selectedValue = 0;
        LocationUtils.DOMUtils.show(singleZipContainer);
        changesCallback(allZipcodes[0]);
    } else {
        LocationUtils.DOMUtils.hide(singleZipContainer);
        LocationUtils.DOMUtils.show(zipSelectContainer);
        enteredZipCode.dataset.selectedValue = '0';
        zipListSelected.textContent = zipListSelected.dataset.placeholder;
        zipListSelected.dataset.selectedValue = '0';
        
        zipList.dataset.allZipCodes = JSON.stringify(allZipcodes);
        zipList.querySelectorAll('.select-list-element').forEach(el => el.remove());
        
        const unmatchedElement = zipList.querySelector('.unmatched-zipcode');
        if (unmatchedElement) {
            unmatchedElement.remove();
        }
        
        uploadZipcodeList(allZipcodes, zipList, false, manualZipcodes);
        
        const manualElement = zipList.querySelector(`[data-value="${manualZipcodeValue}"]`);
        if (manualElement) {
            selectZipcodeOption(manualElement);
        }
    }
    
    LocationUtils.DOMUtils.open(SELECTORS.ZIPCODE.CONTAINER);
    UIState.showZipCodeContainer();
    handleModalSuggestion(false);
}

    const suggestionSuccess = LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement(".zipcode-suggestion-success");

function isZipCode(value) {
    return /^(\d{4,8}|\d{5}-\d{3})$/.test(value.trim());
}   

function handleEdit (){
    UIState.resetDivisionSelection();
    LocationUtils.DOMUtils.close(SELECTORS.ZIPCODE.CONTAINER);
    showSearchLocation()
}

function normalizeSearchText(text) {
    let normalized = text.trim();
    normalized = normalized.replace(/-/g, '');
    normalized = normalized.replace(/\s+/g, '');
    return normalized;
}

function searchLocation(value){
    let originalText = value.trim();
    let normalizedText = normalizeSearchText(value);
    let zipCodeEntry = ZIPCODE_ENABLED && isZipCode(normalizedText);
    let searchText = zipCodeEntry ? normalizedText : originalText;

    if (searchText.length > 0) {
        LocationUtils.DOMUtils.close(SELECTORS.ZIPCODE.CONTAINER);
        LocationUtils.DOMUtils.hide(SELECTORS.ZIPCODE.SUGGESTIONCARD);
    }

    if (!document.querySelector("#licountrycont").classList.contains('close') && searchText.length == 0){
        return;
    }
    else if (searchText.length == 0)
    {
        LocationUtils.DOMUtils.open(SELECTORS.LOCATION.MANUAL_BUTTON)
        UIState.resetSearchState();
    }
    else if(searchText.length <= 2){
        UIState.resetSearchState();
    }else if(!zipCodeEntry && searchText.length > 2 || (zipCodeEntry && searchText.length > 3)) {
        if (event.keyCode == 38 || event.keyCode == 40 || event.keyCode == 13) {
            const ul = document.getElementById('new_prop_search_locations_results');
            const lis = ul.querySelectorAll('div');
            switch (event.key) {
                case 'ArrowUp':
                    if (selectedLocationIndex > 0) {
                        selectedLocationIndex--;
                        DropdownUtils.highlightSelected(lis,selectedLocationIndex);
                    }
                    break;
                case 'ArrowDown':
                    if (selectedLocationIndex < lis.length - 1) {
                        selectedLocationIndex++;
                        DropdownUtils.highlightSelected(lis,selectedLocationIndex);
                    }
                    break;
                case 'Enter':
                    const currentLocation = lis[selectedLocationIndex];
                    if (currentLocation && currentLocation.getAttribute('data-location_id') !== '0') {
                        const zipCodeEntry = currentLocation.dataset.zipCode || '';
                        if (zipCodeEntry) {
                            renderZipcodeInfo(zipCodeEntry);
                        } else {
                            renderZipcodeInfo(null);
                        }
                        setLocation(currentLocation);
                        LocationUtils.DOMUtils.close(SELECTORS.LOCATION.MANUAL_BUTTON);
                    }
                    

                    break;
            }
        }
        else if (event.keyCode == 37 || event.keyCode == 39 || event.keyCode == 16 || event.keyCode == 17 || event.keyCode == 9) {
            event.preventDefault();
        }
        else if(event.key == 'Escape'){
            DropdownUtils.hideElement(SELECTORS.SEARCH.RESULTS_LIST);
            document.getElementById('input-search-location').value = ''
            selectedLocationIndex = -1
            document.getElementById('input-search-location').focus();
        }
        else{
            DropdownUtils.showElement(SELECTORS.SEARCH.SPINNER)
            DropdownUtils.hideElement(SELECTORS.SEARCH.CLOSE_BUTTON)
            DropdownUtils.hideElement(SELECTORS.LOCATION.EDIT_BUTTON)
            UIState.resetDivisionSelection();
            UIState.resetZipcodeState();

            if (zipCodeEntry) {
                const noZipCodeResult = `0|No pudimos encontrar la ubicación`
                $.ajax("/api3/locations/search_by_zipcode?zipcode="+ searchText + '&location_startwith=true')
                .done(function(result) {
                    let dataToHandle;
                    if (Array.isArray(result) && result.length > 0) {
                    dataToHandle = normalizedZipcodeResult(result);
                    handleSearchResults(dataToHandle, searchText, true, result);
                    } else {    
                    handleSearchResults(noZipCodeResult, searchText, true, null);
                    }
                })
                .fail(function() {
                    console.error("Error fetching location search results.");
                    handleSearchResults(noZipCodeResult, searchText, true, null);
                });
            } else {
                var jqxhr = $.ajax("/locations/locations_quicksearch" + '?q=' + searchText + '&location_startwith=True')
                .done(function(result) {
                handleSearchResults(result, searchText, false, null);
        })
                .fail(function(err){
                handleSearchError(err);
        });
            }
        }
    }
}

function handleSearchResults(result, searchText, isZipCode, originalResultData) {
    if (result == 'None'){
        return false;
    }
    const searchInput = document.querySelector(SELECTORS.SEARCH.INPUT);
    const inputValue = isZipCode ? normalizeSearchText(searchInput.value) : searchInput.value.trim();
    if(searchText == inputValue){
        const resultsContainer = document.getElementById('new_prop_search_locations_results');
        resultsContainer.innerHTML = "";
        resultsList = result.split('\n');
        resultsList.forEach((row, index) => {
            let row_info = row.split('|');
            let new_option = document.createElement('DIV');
            new_option.classList = "floating-list-element color-grey-2 location-result";
            new_option.dataset.location_id = row_info[0];
            new_option.dataset.originalText = row_info[1];
            new_option.dataset.fullLocation = row_info[1];

            let realZipcode = null;
            let allZipcodes = null;
            if (isZipCode && row_info[0] !== '0') {
                if (originalResultData && originalResultData[index] && originalResultData[index].zipcodes && originalResultData[index].zipcodes.length > 0) {
                    allZipcodes = originalResultData[index].zipcodes;
                    realZipcode = allZipcodes[0];
                } else {
                    realZipcode = searchText;
                    allZipcodes = [searchText];
                }
                new_option.dataset.zipCode = realZipcode;
                if (allZipcodes) {
                    new_option.dataset.allZipCodes = JSON.stringify(allZipcodes);
                }
            }            

            new_option.addEventListener('click', () => {
                DropdownUtils.hideElement(SELECTORS.SEARCH.RESULTS_LIST);
                LocationUtils.DOMUtils.close(SELECTORS.SEARCH.MANUAL_BUTTON);
                const selectedSpan = LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement(SELECTORS.LOCATION.SELECTED_SPAN);
                selectedSpan.innerHTML = new_option.dataset.originalText;
                
                if (isZipCode && window.locationQuickSearchResult) {
                    const quickSearchRow = window.locationQuickSearchResult.split('\n')[0];
                    if (quickSearchRow) {
                        const [quickId] = quickSearchRow.split('|');
                        selectedSpan.dataset.location_id = quickId;
                    } else {
                        selectedSpan.dataset.location_id = row_info[0];
                    }
                } else {
                    selectedSpan.dataset.location_id = row_info[0];
                }

                const zipCodeEntry = new_option.dataset.zipCode;
                const allZipCodesData = new_option.dataset.allZipCodes;
                if (zipCodeEntry) {
                    let allZipcodes = null;
                    if (allZipCodesData) {
                        try {
                            allZipcodes = JSON.parse(allZipCodesData);
                        } catch (e) {
                            allZipcodes = [zipCodeEntry];
                        }
                    } else {
                        allZipcodes = [zipCodeEntry];
                    }
                    renderZipcodeInfo(zipCodeEntry, allZipcodes);
                } else {
                    renderZipcodeInfo(null);
                }
                
                searchInput.value = new_option.dataset.originalText;
                searchInput.classList.remove('is-empty', 'blue-border');

                DropdownUtils.hideElement(SELECTORS.SEARCH.CONTAINER);
                document.querySelector(SELECTORS.LOCATION.SELECTED_CONTAINER).classList.remove('display-none');
                DropdownUtils.hideBlueAlert();
                
                DropdownUtils.showElement(SELECTORS.LOCATION.EDIT_BUTTON);
                LocationUtils.DOMUtils.close(SELECTORS.LOCATION.MANUAL_BUTTON);
                
                var jqxhr = $.ajax("/locations/get_location_array?type=division&id="+selectedSpan.dataset.location_id)
                .done(function(result) {
                    if (result == 'None'){
                        showSearchLocation();
                        return;
                    }

                    eval("var location_array = [" + result + "]");
                    
                    document.querySelectorAll('.manual-search').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('close'));
                    
                    location_levels.forEach((level, index) => {
                        const liContainer = document.querySelector(`#li${level}cont`);
                        liContainer.classList.add('close');
                        
                        const selectedElem = document.querySelector(`#new-prop-${level}-selected`);
                        selectedElem.dataset.selectedValue = "0";
                        selectedElem.innerHTML = "";
                    });

                    document.querySelector('#licountrycont').classList.remove('close');
                    let country_elem = document.querySelector(`#new-prop-country-list [data-value="${location_array[0]}"]`);
                    if (country_elem) {
                        loadLocation(country_elem, 0, location_array);
                    }
                    
                    callBackForTitle();
                })
                .fail(function(err) {
                    callBackForTitle();
                });
            });
            
            new_option.textContent = row_info[1].trim();
            
            resultsContainer.appendChild(new_option);
        });
        
        UIState.showResults();
        selectedLocationIndex = -1;
        document.getElementById("new_prop_search_locations_results").scrollTop = 0;
    } 
}

function normalizedZipcodeResult(structuredList) {
    const noZipCodeResult = "0|We couldn't find the location";

    try {
        if (!Array.isArray(structuredList) || structuredList.length === 0) {
            return noZipCodeResult;
        }

        return structuredList
            .map(item => {
                const id = item.id;
                const name = item.location_name;
                return `${id}|${name}`;
            })
            .join('\n');

    } catch (error) {
        console.error("Error normalizing zipcode result:", error);
        return noZipCodeResult;
    }
}

function renderZipcodeInfo(postalCode, allZipcodes = null) {
    if (!ZIPCODE_ENABLED) return;
    const wrongCodeBtn = document.querySelector('#wrong-code-btn');
    const inputSearch = LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement(SELECTORS.SEARCH.INPUT);
    inputSearch.dataset.zipcode_entry = postalCode !== null;

    if (postalCode) {
        const zipcodesToDisplay = allZipcodes && allZipcodes.length > 0 ? allZipcodes : [postalCode];
        updateZipCodeDisplay(zipcodesToDisplay, false); 
    } else {
        const zipSelectedSpan = LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement(SELECTORS.ZIPCODE.SPAN_SELECTION);
        
        zipSelectedSpan.textContent = '';
        zipSelectedSpan.dataset.selectedValue = '0';
        zipSelectedSpan.dataset.allZipCodes = '[]';
        zipSelectedSpan.title = '';
        
        if (wrongCodeBtn) {
            LocationUtils.DOMUtils.hide(wrongCodeBtn)
        }
    }
}

function selectZipcodeOption(element) {
  const selectedValue = element.dataset.value;
  const span = LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement(SELECTORS.ZIPCODE.SPAN_LIST_SELECTION);
  const singleZipcodeSpan = LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement(SELECTORS.ZIPCODE.SPAN_SELECTION);
  span.textContent = selectedValue;
  span.dataset.selectedValue = selectedValue;
  singleZipcodeSpan.dataset.selectedValue = 0;
  LocationUtils.DOMUtils.hide('#new-prop-zipcode-select #new-prop-zipcode-list')
  changesCallback(selectedValue);
  fetchStreetByZipcode(selectedValue);
}

function fetchStreetByZipcode(zipcode) {
    if (!zipcode) {
        return;
    }
    
    const streetInput = document.getElementById('new_prop_street');
    if (!streetInput) {
        return;
    }
    
    const existingValue = streetInput.value.trim();
    
    $.ajax({
        url: "/api3/locations/get_street_by_zipcode?zipcode=" + encodeURIComponent(zipcode),
        type: 'GET',
        success: function(result) {
            if (result && result.street) {
                streetInput.value = result.street;
                streetInput.classList.remove('is-empty');
            } else {
                if (existingValue) {
                    streetInput.value = existingValue;
                    streetInput.classList.remove('is-empty');
                } else {
                    streetInput.value = '';
                    streetInput.classList.add('is-empty');
                }
            }
        },
        error: function() {
        }
    });
}

    document.getElementById('new_prop_search_locations_results').innerHTML =

const texts = getFullLocationText()

        modalSuggestionLocationText.textContent = texts;
    }

}

function verifyCodeJoined(value, tab){
    const condition = value && value.length > 3 && value.length < 10;
    const selector = IS_FROM_MODAL ? "#suggestionZipcodeModalParent #confirmSuggestionBtn" : "#confirmSuggestionBtn";
    const suggestionBtn = LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement(selector);
    if (suggestionBtn) {
        suggestionBtn.classList.toggle('disabled', !condition);
    }
}

function getFullLocationText() {
const texts = location_levels.map(level => {
    const span = document.getElementById(`new-prop-${level}-selected`);
    if (!span) return null;

    const text = span.textContent.trim();
    const selectedValue = span.dataset.selectedValue;

    if (text !== '' && selectedValue !== '0') {
      return text;
    }
    return null;
  }).filter(text => text !== null);
  return texts.join(' | ');
}

function hasZipcodeSuggestion(divisionId) {
    if (!divisionId) return false;
    try {
        const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
        if (!raw) return false;
        const suggestions = JSON.parse(raw);
        return suggestions.includes(String(divisionId));
    } catch (e) {
        return false;
    }
}

function storeZipcodeSuggestion(divisionId) {
    if (!divisionId) return false;
    let suggestions = [];
    try {
        const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
        suggestions = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('Error leyendo localStorage, reinicializando...');
    }
    if (suggestions.includes(String(divisionId))) return;
    suggestions.push(String(divisionId));
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(suggestions));
}

function changesCallback(zipcode = null, disabled = false) {
    if(typeof onLocationChange === 'function') {
        const currentDivisionId = getDivisionID();
        onLocationChange(currentDivisionId, zipcode, disabled);
    }
}

function waitForCountryAndLoad(location_array, retries = 5) {
    const country_elem = document.querySelector(`#new-prop-country-list [data-value="${location_array[0]}"]`);
    if (country_elem) {
        loadLocation(country_elem, 0, location_array);
        LocationUtils.DOMUtils.close(SELECTORS.LOCATION.MANUAL_BUTTON);
    } else if (retries > 0) {
        setTimeout(() => waitForCountryAndLoad(location_array, retries - 1), 100);
    }
}


function getLocationZipCode () {
    const fromSingle = LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement(SELECTORS.ZIPCODE.SPAN_SELECTION);
    const fromMultiple = LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement(SELECTORS.ZIPCODE.SPAN_LIST_SELECTION);

    const valSingle = fromSingle?.dataset?.selectedValue;
    const valMultiple = fromMultiple?.dataset?.selectedValue;

    const isValid = (v) => v && v !== '0';
    if (isValid(valSingle)) return valSingle;
    if (isValid(valMultiple)) return valMultiple;
    return null;
}

function getDivisionID () {
    const locationSelectedSpan = LocationUtils.DOMUtils.getElement(SELECTORS.LOCATION.SELECTED_SPAN);
    const divisionId = locationSelectedSpan?.dataset?.location_id;

    if (divisionId && divisionId !== '0') {
        return divisionId;
    }

    return null;
}

<script>
function  initLocationInput () {
    return new Promise(function(resolve, reject) {
        var jqxhr = $.ajax("/locations/countries_json")
        .done(function(result) {
            eval ('var data = ' + result);
            json_countries = data;

            for(let index in json_countries){
                if(index != 'selected' && index != 0){
                    let new_option = document.createElement('DIV');
                    new_option.classList = "select-list-element";
                    new_option.dataset.value = index;
                    
                    new_option.addEventListener('click', () => {
                        loadLocation(new_option, 0, null);
                    });

                    new_option.innerHTML = json_countries[index];

                    document.getElementById('new-prop-country-list').append(new_option)
                }
            }
            resolve();
        })
        .fail(function() {
            reject();
        });
    });
}
if (!IS_FROM_MODAL) {
    initLocationInput();
}

document.addEventListener('click', function(event) {
    if (IS_FROM_MODAL && event.target.closest('#new-prop-zipcode-list') &&
        event.target.classList.contains('select-list-element')) {
        LocationUtils.DOMUtils.hide('#new-prop-zipcode-list');
    }

    if (event.target.closest('.select-container')) return;

    if (event.target.closest('.select-list')) return;

    document.querySelectorAll('#new-prop-country-list, #new-prop-region-list, #new-prop-zone-list, #new-prop-subzone-list, #new-prop-subsubzone-list, #new-prop-subsubzone2-list, #new-prop-subsubzone3-list, #new-prop-zipcode-list').forEach(list => {
        list.classList.add('display-none');
    });

    // Además, limpiamos cualquier highlight
    document.querySelectorAll('.select-list-element').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('element-op-selected'));
});


document.getElementById('input-location-list').addEventListener('click', function(event) {
    if (event.target.closest('.select-container')) return;

    this.querySelectorAll('.select-list').forEach(list => list.classList.add('display-none'));
    this.querySelectorAll('.select-list-element').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('element-op-selected'));
});

  $(function() {

  let denounces_dict = {};

  function createReportPropertyDataset(response){
    let motives_dict = {};
    let denounced_motives = new Set();
    let motives_corrected = new Set();

    for(let i = 0; i< response.motives.length; i++){
        let motive = response.motives[i]

        motives_dict[motive.id] = {'detail': motive.detail}
        if(Object.keys(motive.report).length > 0 && motive.report.is_denounced){
            motives_dict[motive.id]['report_id'] = motive.report.id
            denounced_motives.add(motive.id)
            if(motive.report.ready_to_validate){
                motives_corrected.add(motive.id)
            }
        }
    }

    denounces_dict["motives"] = motives_dict;
    denounces_dict["denounced_motives"] = denounced_motives
    denounces_dict["corrected_motives"] = motives_corrected
    console.log(denounces_dict)
  }

  function denouncesSetup(){
    let prop_id = 8002445;
    var settings = {
      "url": `/property/${prop_id}/network/contact_data_report/list/`,
      "method": "GET",
      "timeout": 0,
    };

    $.ajax(settings).done(function (response) {
        console.log(response)
        createReportPropertyDataset(response);
        openPopupMarkCorrectedDenounces()
    });
  }

  function checkInformDenouncedProp(){
    let property_id = 8002445;
    let is_denounced = false;

    if(is_denounced){
      let all_denonuces_data = {"motives": [{"report": {}, "id": 1, "keyword": "description", "detail": "Contact data in the description"}, {"report": {}, "id": 2, "keyword": "address", "detail": "Contact data in the address"}, {"report": {}, "id": 3, "keyword": "images", "detail": "Company logo in the images"}]}
      createReportPropertyDataset(all_denonuces_data)
      let denounced_motives = [...denounces_dict.denounced_motives];

      if(localStorage.getItem(property_id+"denouncedMtvs") == null){
        let all_corrected = is_denounced && true
        if(!all_corrected){
          localStorage.setItem(property_id+"denouncedMtvs", denounced_motives)
          showModalOnPageLoad();
        }
      }else{
        let ls_motives =  localStorage.getItem(property_id+"denouncedMtvs").split(',').map(e => Number(e))
        let same_size = (ls_motives.length == denounced_motives.length)
        let same_content = same_size && (denounced_motives.every(el => ls_motives.includes(el)))

        if(!same_content){
          if(ls_motives.length < denounced_motives.length ||
          !denounced_motives.every(el => ls_motives.includes(el))){
            showModalOnPageLoad();
          }
          localStorage.setItem(property_id+"denouncedMtvs", denounced_motives)
        }
      }
    }else{
      localStorage.removeItem(property_id+"denouncedMtvs")
    }
  }


  function openPopupMarkCorrectedDenounces(){

    let modal_on_page_load = document.getElementById('modal_on_page_load');

    let validateList = document.createDocumentFragment();

    denounces_dict.denounced_motives.forEach(m_id => {

        if(denounces_dict.corrected_motives.has(m_id)){
          let containerResolved = document.createElement('div');
              containerResolved.classList.add("container");

                <span class="checkmark"></span>`;
              validateList.appendChild(containerValidate);
        }

    motives_list.appendChild(resolvedList);

    delete validateList;
    delete resolvedList;

    $("#modal_on_page_load #denounced_motives_list .loader-wrapper").hide();

    wrapper_corrections.style.display = 'block';

  }

  // enable / disable Confirm button depending on # motives selected
  function enableDisableConfirmCorrectedMotiveButton(thisOption){

          $('#modal_corrections_container #buttons_wrapper .btn-primary').removeClass("disabled");

              $('#modal_corrections_container #buttons_wrapper .btn-primary').addClass("disabled");
              $('#modal_corrections_container #buttons_wrapper .btn-primary').attr('disabled', 'true');
          }
      }

    let prop_id = 8002445;
    let formData = new FormData();
    correctedMotives.forEach(report_id => formData.append('report_ids', report_id))
    formData.append('csrfmiddlewaretoken', 'DCH3hhl20acrpjyohtiE88QvcbeYPP8ZrO1vjw3S6OJxolY8uGxHDCztkwEjNpN3');

    $.ajax({
        url: `/property/${prop_id}/network/contact_data_report/fix/`,

    }).done(function(result) {
        if(denounces_dict["corrected_motives"].size > 0){
          correctedMotives.forEach(el => denounces_dict["corrected_motives"].add(el))
        }else{
          denounces_dict["corrected_motives"] = correctedMotives;
        }

        //change Tokko Network Box color and tag if all corrected
        if( denounces_dict.corrected_motives.size == denounces_dict.denounced_motives.size){
          let network_box = document.getElementById('tokko_network_box');
          network_box.classList.remove('denounced')

function remove_reservation_contact(id){

//CONCRETATION JAVASCRIPT

var property_data = {'division':0};

var messagebox = undefined;

function save(name, value, reload_on_finish, hide_loader=false){
    reload_on_finish = typeof reload_on_finish !== 'undefined' ? reload_on_finish : false;
    $(window).bind('beforeunload', function(){
        return 'Estás saliendo sin guardar los cambios.';
    });
    if (messagebox){
       messagebox.floatingMessage("destroy")
    }
    messagebox = $.floatingMessage("<div id='messagebox' class='new'><div class='loader'></div> Guardando...</div>",{
        width:160,
        position: 'left-bottom'
    });

    var data = {};
    method='POST';
    qs = "?" + name + "=:)"
    data = {'value': value}


    var jqxhr = $.ajax( qs, {'type':method, 'data': data})
        .done(function(result) {
            if (name == 'type') {
                location.reload();
            }
            if (name == 'division' || name == 'fake_address'){
                $("#location").html(result);
            }
            if (name == 'zipcode' && value){
               const content = $("#location").html() +` (CP ${value})`;
                $("#location").html(content);
            }
            else{
               if (result != ''){
                 reload_on_finish = false;
                 Alert(result, function(){});
               }
            }

            $(window).unbind('beforeunload');
            messagebox.floatingMessage("destroy");
            if (name == 'division'){
              const dialog = $('#dialog-location');

var contacts = {};
var contacts_used = [];

function removeContact(id){
    if (contacts_used.length == 1){
        Alert("No puede dejar una propiedad sin propietario.", function(){}, 'Advertencia');
        return false;
    }
    $("#contact_tag_"+ id).qtip("api").destroy();
    $("#contact_tag_"+ id).remove();
    for (elem in contacts_used){
        if (id == contacts_used[elem]) { break }
    }
    contacts_used.splice(elem, 1);
    var jqxhr2 = $.ajax("/property/8002445/remove_contact?contact_id=" + id);
}

var is_key_contact = false;

function create_contact(name, email, cellphone){
    if (name.length > 0){
        var jqxhr = $.ajax("/contact/add/?quickadd=true&name=" + name + "&email=" + email + "&cellphone=" + cellphone)
        .done(function(result) {
         if (is_key_contact){
            add_key_contact(result);
            is_key_contact = false;
          }else{
              get_contact_name_and_save(result);
          }
        });
    }else{
        Alert('El nombre del contacto es obligatorio', function(){}, 'Advertencia!');
    }
}


function get_contact_name_and_save(id, from_load){
    var jqxhr = $.ajax("/contacts/get_name?id=" + id)
    .done(function(result) {
        eval ("var res = " + result);
        contacts[id] = res;
        contacts_used.push(id);
        $('#contacts').append('<div class="tag" id="contact_tag_'+ id  +'">' + res.name +'</div>');
        $('#contact_tag_'+id).qtip(
        {
        position: {

        style: {

                classes: 'ui-tooltip-light ui-tooltip-shadow'

        });
        if (!from_load){
            var jqxhr2 = $.ajax("/property/8002445/add_contact?contact_id=" + id);
        }
    })
    .fail(function(){
        NewContact(id, create_contact);
    })

}

<script type="text/javascript">
var is_map_shown = false;

function savePosition(){
  var position = {
    'lat': marker.getPosition().lat(),
    'lng': marker.getPosition().lng()
  }

  var jqxhr = $.ajax("/property/8002445/save_geo_location?data="+ JSON.stringify(position))
   .done(function() {
    })
}

function invalidLat(){
  $('#invalidLat').fadeIn();

  setTimeout(function(){
    $('#invalidLat').fadeOut();
  }, 2000);
}

function invalidLng(){
  $('#invalidLng').fadeIn();

  setTimeout(function(){
    $('#invalidLng').fadeOut();
  }, 2000);
}

function emptyLatLng(){
  $('#emptyLatLng').fadeIn();

  setTimeout(function(){
    $('#emptyLatLng').fadeOut();
  }, 2000);
}

function showMap(){
    $('#dialog-map').slideToggle();
    if (!is_map_shown){
        is_map_shown = true;
        var lat = -34.505389;
 var lng = -58.9533391;

        var latLng = new google.maps.LatLng(lat, lng);

        var myOptions = {
          center: latLng,
          zoom: 16,
          mapTypeId: google.maps.MapTypeId.ROADMAP
        };

        var map = new google.maps.Map(document.getElementById("map_canvas"),
            myOptions);

        marker = new google.maps.Marker({
            position: latLng,
            title: 'Drag this pin to another location',
            animation: google.maps.Animation.DROP,
            map: map,
            draggable: true
        });

        
        function setLatLng(){
          var latToSet = marker.getPosition().lat();
          var lngToSet = marker.getPosition().lng();

          $('#map-lat-input').val(latToSet);
          $('#map-lng-input').val(lngToSet);
        } setLatLng();
        

        
        $('#manualLatLng').click(function(){

          var manualLat = $('#map-lat-input').val();
          var manualLng = $('#map-lng-input').val();

          validateLatLng();

          function validateLatLng() {
            if (manualLat < -90 || manualLat > 90){
              invalidLat();
            } else if (manualLng < -180 || manualLng > 180){
              invalidLng();
            } else if (manualLat === "" || manualLng === ""){
              emptyLatLng();
            }else{
              marker.setPosition( new google.maps.LatLng(manualLat, manualLng) );
              map.setCenter(new google.maps.LatLng(manualLat, manualLng));
              savePosition();
            }
          }


        });
        


        
        infoWindow = new google.maps.InfoWindow({
           content: "<div style='width: 200px; height:40px; font-size:13px;'>Arrástrame hasta el lugar correcto.</div>"
        });

        infoWindow.open(map, marker);
        

        
        google.maps.event.addListener(marker, 'dragend', function() {
            infoWindow.open(map, marker);

            map.panTo(marker.getPosition());

            function updateLatLng(){
              var newLat = marker.getPosition().lat();
              var newLng = marker.getPosition().lng();

              $('#map-lat-input').val(newLat);
              $('#map-lng-input').val(newLng);
            } updateLatLng()

            savePosition();
        });
        

        
        google.maps.event.addListener(marker, 'dragstart', function() {
            infoWindow.close(map, marker);
        });
        
    }
}
</script>

<script>
var data;

var expenses = 0
var only_one_operation = false
function open_property_guarantee_modal(id){
	$('#modal-overlay').show();
	$('#success').hide();
	$('#select_page').hide()
	$('#modal-loading').show()
	$('#guarantee_comment').val('');
    var jqxhr = $.ajax('/portals/zonaprop/guarantee/0'.replace('0', id))
    .done(function(result) {
		data = result
		$('#modal-overlay').show();
		$('#guarantee_img').attr("src", result.property_cover_picture);
		if (result.reservation_contact_name) {
			$('#guarantee_contact span').html(result.reservation_contact_name)
		}
		$('#guarantee_prop_info').html(result.property_reference_code + ' / ' + result.property_type + ' en ' + result.property_location);
		$('#guarantee_address').html(result.property_address);
		if (result.property_rent) {
			only_one_operation = true
			$('#guarantee_case_2').hide();
			$('#guarantee_case_1').show();
			$('#guarantee_rent').html(result.property_rent);
			if (result.property_expenses == '$ 0') {
				$('.expenses-container').hide();
			} else {
				$('.expenses-container').show();
				$('#expenses_case_2').hide();
				$('.guarantee_expenses').html(result.property_expenses);
				expenses = result.property_expenses.replace("$", "").trim()
			}
		} else {
			only_one_operation = false
			$('#guarantee_case_1').hide();
			$('#guarantee_case_2').show();
			$('#expenses_case_2').show();
			$('#guarantee_rent_1 div').html(result.property_rent_1);
			$('#guarantee_rent_1 input').val(result.property_rent_1);
			$('#guarantee_rent_2 div').html(result.property_rent_2);
			$('#guarantee_rent_2 input').val(result.property_rent_2);
			if (result.property_expenses == '$ 0') {
				$('.expenses-container').hide();
			} else {
				$('.expenses-container').show();
				$('.guarantee_expenses').html(result.property_expenses);
				expenses = result.property_expenses.replace("$", "").trim()
			}
		}
		if(result.is_commercial){
			$(".contrato-term-container").hide();
			$(".guarantee-commission").html(`
				<a href="https://hoggax.com/empresas" target=”_blank” style="color: #386DF4; text-decoration: underline;">¿Como funcionan las garantias corporativas/comerciales? </a>
			`)
		}else{
			$(".contrato-term-container").show();
			$(".guarantee-commission").html(`
				<div>¡20% DE DESCUENTO! </div>
				<div onclick="showCotization()" style="cursor:pointer; color: #386DF4; text-decoration: underline;" href="">Ver cotización</div>
			`)
		}
		$('#modal-loading').hide();
		$('#select_page').show()
    })
}

function send_property_guarantee_email(){

	data['comment'] = $('#guarantee_comment').val();
	data['term'] = $(".contrato-term-text input:checked").val()
	if ($('#guarantee_case_2').is(":visible")){
		if ($('input[name=rent]:checked').val() == "$") {
			data['selected_rent'] = data['property_rent_1']
		} else {
			data['selected_rent'] = data['property_rent_2']
		}
	}
	data['contact'] = ""
	if ("") {
		data['contact_email'] = ""
		data['contact_cellphone'] = ""
	} else {
		data['contact_email'] = ""
		data['contact_cellphone'] = ""
	}
	if(prop_rent_value_allowed_by_hoggax()){
		var jqxhr = $.ajax('/portals/zonaprop/guarantee_email/', {"type":"POST", "data":JSON.stringify(data)})
		.done(function(result) {
			console.log(result)
			if (result.status == 200) {
				$('#select_page').hide()
				$('#success').show();
				setTimeout(function(){ close_guarantee_modal(); }, 3000);
			}
		})
	}
}

function close_guarantee_modal() {
	$('#modal-overlay').hide();
}

var rent;
var currency;
function prop_rent_value_allowed_by_hoggax(){
	currency = false
	var min_value_allowed_by_hoggax = 80000;
	if (only_one_operation){
		rent = $("#guarantee_rent").text()
	}else{
		rent = $("#guarantee_case_2 input:checked").val()
	}
	if (rent.includes("USD")){
		currency = "usd"
	}
	rent = rent.replace("$ ", "").replace("USD", "").replace(".", "").trim()
	if (!currency && rent < min_value_allowed_by_hoggax){
		alert("El valor del alquiler debe ser superior a $80.000 para poder cotizarlo")
		return false
	}
	return true
}

function showCotization(){
	var term = $(".contrato-term-text input:checked").val()
	if (prop_rent_value_allowed_by_hoggax()){
		$("body").css("cursor", "progress");
		var jqxhr = $.ajax(`/portals/zonaprop/hoggax_cotization_url/?rent=${rent}&expenses=${expenses}&term=${term}${currency ? `&currency=${currency}` : ""}`)
			.done(function(result){
				window.open(result.url, "_blank");
			})
			.always(function(resutl){
				$("body").css("cursor", "default");
			});
			
	}
}

</script>

    function setCookie(name, value, hours) {
        const expires = new Date();
        expires.setTime(expires.getTime() + (hours * 60 * 60 * 1000));
        const valueToStore = typeof value === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(value) : value;
        document.cookie = name + '=' + encodeURIComponent(valueToStore) + ';expires=' + expires.toUTCString() + ';path=/';
    }
    
    function getCookie(name) {
        const nameEQ = name + '=';
        const ca = document.cookie.split(';');
        for (let i = 0; i < ca.length; i++) {
            let c = ca[i];
            while (c.charAt(0) === ' ') c = c.substring(1, c.length);
            if (c.indexOf(nameEQ) === 0) {
                const decoded = decodeURIComponent(c.substring(nameEQ.length, c.length));
                try {
                    return JSON.parse(decoded);
                } catch (e) {
                    return decoded;
                }
            }
        }
    return null;
}

function deleteCookie(name) {
    document.cookie = name + '=;expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 UTC;path=/;';
}

function getLayoutColumnCount(){
  const container = document.getElementById('property_info');
  if (!container) {
    return 2;
  }
  const width = container.offsetWidth;
  
  if (width < 1035) {
    return 2;
  } else if (width >= 1035 && width <= 1646) {
    return 3;
  } else {
    return 4;
  }
}
function getMaxVisibleItems(){
    return getLayoutColumnCount() * 3;
}


function reorder_ul(id, exclude){
    var mylist = $('#'+id);
    var listitems = mylist.children('li').not("li[name='"+exclude+"']").get();
    listitems.sort(function(a, b) {
       return $(a).text().toUpperCase().localeCompare($(b).text().toUpperCase());
    })
    $.each(listitems, function(idx, itm) { mylist.append(itm); });
}

      });

      if (fieldContainer && fieldContainer.classList) {
        fieldContainer.classList.remove("collapsed_file");
        fieldContainer.querySelector('.box_edition_btn')?.setAttribute('data-collapsed', 'false');
      }

      }

      var target = scrollToFirstElementWithClass(selected && selected.id);

      input.value = "";
      setClearIconVisibility();
    }

    function search(query) {
      var q = normalizeText(query);
      if (!q) {
        hideDropdown();
        return;
      }

      if (q.length < 3) {
        hideDropdown();
        return;
      }

      var matches = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
        var item = data[i];
        var name = normalizeText(item && item.attr_name);
        if (name.indexOf(q) !== -1) {
          matches.push(item);
        }
        if (matches.length >= 50) {
          break;
        }
      }

      if (matches.length > 0) {
        renderResults(matches);
      } else {
        renderNotFound();
      }
    }

    input.addEventListener("input", function () {
      setClearIconVisibility();
      search(input.value);
    });

    if (clearIcon) {
      clearIcon.addEventListener("mousedown", function (ev) {
        ev.preventDefault();
      });
      clearIcon.addEventListener("click", function () {
        input.value = "";
        setClearIconVisibility();
        hideDropdown();
        if (input.focus) {
          input.focus();
        }
      });
    }

    input.addEventListener("keydown", function (ev) {
      if (ev.key === "ArrowDown") {
        if (dropdown.style.display === "none") {
          search(input.value);
        }
        updateActiveResult(activeIndex + 1);
        ev.preventDefault();
        return;
      }
      if (ev.key === "ArrowUp") {
        updateActiveResult(activeIndex - 1);
        ev.preventDefault();
        return;
      }
      if (ev.key === "Enter") {
        if (activeIndex >= 0) {
          selectResult(activeIndex);
          ev.preventDefault();
        }
        return;
      }
      if (ev.key === "Escape") {
        hideDropdown();
        return;
      }
    });

    document.addEventListener("click", function (ev) {
      if (!root.contains(ev.target)) {
        hideDropdown();

    root.addEventListener("property-attribute-searcher:set", function (ev) {

      for (var i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
        if (isSameItem(data[i], item)) {
          input.value = item.attr_name || "";
          setClearIconVisibility();
          return;
        }
      }
    });

    setClearIconVisibility();
  })();

function animateHeight(container, toggleFn) {
  const start = container.getBoundingClientRect().height;

  container.style.height = start + 'px';
  container.style.overflow = 'hidden';
  container.style.transition = 'none';
  container.offsetHeight; // force reflow

  toggleFn();

  requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    container.style.height = 'auto';
    const end = container.getBoundingClientRect().height;

    const parent = container.closest('.new_file_box_container');
    if (parent) {
      let shouldBeZero = end <= 4;
      
      if (shouldBeZero && parent.classList.contains('collapsed_file')) {
        const operationBlocks = ['sale_operation_block', 'rent_operation_block', 'temporary_rent_operation_block'];
        const nonEmptySections = parent.querySelectorAll('.new_cotization_box_content .editFieldsSection:not(.is_empty)');
        
        let hasNonEmptySectionOutsideOperations = false;
        nonEmptySections.forEach(function(section) {
          const isInOperationBlock = operationBlocks.some(function(blockId) {
            return section.closest('#' + blockId) !== null;
          });
          if (!isInOperationBlock) {
            hasNonEmptySectionOutsideOperations = true;
          }
        });
        
        if (hasNonEmptySectionOutsideOperations) {
          shouldBeZero = false;
        }
      }
      
      parent.classList.toggle('body_is_zero', shouldBeZero);
    }

    container.style.height = start + 'px';
    container.offsetHeight; // reflow

    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      container.style.transition = 'height 1000ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1)';
      container.style.height = end + 'px';

      const onEnd = (e) => {
        if (e.propertyName !== 'height') return;
        container.style.height = '';
        container.style.overflow = '';
        container.style.transition = '';
        container.removeEventListener('transitionend', onEnd);
      };

      container.addEventListener('transitionend', onEnd);
    });
  });
}

    function setCollapsed(btn, container, collapsed) {
        if (!$("#property_info").hasClass('collapsed_mode') && container && !(container.id === 'custom_tags_container')) return;
        container.classList.toggle('collapsed_file', collapsed);
        btn.setAttribute('data-collapsed', String(collapsed));
    }

    document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        var editBtn = e.target.closest('.new_file_box_container .box_edition_btn');
        var collapseBtn = e.target.closest('.new_file_box_container .collapse_btn_container button');
        var boxCollapsed = e.target.closest('.new_file_box_container.collapsed_file');

        if (boxCollapsed && boxCollapsed.id === 'property_description') {
        boxCollapsed = null;
        }

        if (!editBtn && !collapseBtn && !boxCollapsed) return;

        e.preventDefault();

        var el = editBtn || collapseBtn /*|| boxCollapsed*/;

        if (collapseBtn) {
            toggleFileBoxFromElement(el, { forceCollapsed: true });
            return;
        }

        if (editBtn /*|| boxCollapsed*/) {
            toggleFileBoxFromElement(el, { collapseOthers: true });
            return;
        }

        toggleFileBoxFromElement(el);
    });

function toggleFileBoxContainer(container, opts) {
    opts = opts || {};
    var forceCollapsed = (typeof opts.forceCollapsed === 'boolean') ? opts.forceCollapsed : null;
    var collapseOthers = (typeof opts.collapseOthers === 'boolean') ? opts.collapseOthers : false;

    if (!container) return;

        updateEditSectionsEmptyState($(container));

    var iconBtn = container.querySelector('.box_edition_btn');
    var body = container.querySelector('.box_body');
    if (!iconBtn || !body) return;

    var nextCollapsed;
    if (forceCollapsed !== null) {
        nextCollapsed = forceCollapsed;
    } else {
        nextCollapsed = !container.classList.contains('collapsed_file');
    }

    if (nextCollapsed && container.id){
        if (container.id === "tags_box_container" && $("#unified_tags_search").val().trim() !== '') {
            $('#unified_tags_search').val('')
            if (typeof unifiedFilterTags === 'function') unifiedFilterTags('');
        }
    }

    if (collapseOthers && nextCollapsed === false) {
        var allContainers = document.querySelectorAll('.new_file_box_container');

        if (!(container.id === 'property_description')) {
            hideContainerIfOpen('property_description');
        }
        if (!(container.id === 'information_network')) {
            hideContainerIfOpen('information_network');
        }

        allContainers.forEach(function (other) {
            if (other === container) return;
            if (skipCollapsePropertyContactWhenExpandingOther && other.id === 'property_contact') return;

            var otherBtn = other.querySelector('.box_edition_btn');
            var otherBody = other.querySelector('.box_body');
            if (!otherBtn || !otherBody) return;

            if (!other.classList.contains('collapsed_file')) {
                animateHeight(otherBody, function () {
                    setCollapsed(otherBtn, other, true);
                });
            }
        });
    }
    
    var isTagsBoxContainer = container.id === 'tags_box_container';
    
    if (isTagsBoxContainer && typeof setTagContainerHeight === 'function' && !nextCollapsed) {
        setTagContainerHeight(false);
    }
    
    animateHeight(body, function () {
        setCollapsed(iconBtn, container, nextCollapsed);
        if (isTagsBoxContainer && typeof setTagContainerHeight === 'function' && nextCollapsed) {
            setTagContainerHeight(true);
        }
    });
}

function toggleFileBoxFromElement(el, opts) {
    var container = el && el.closest ? el.closest('.new_file_box_container') : null;
    toggleFileBoxContainer(container, opts);
}

function changeCollapseTab(tab){
    if (tab.hasClass('selected')) return;
    style_selector.find('span').removeClass('selected');
    tab.addClass('selected');
    if (tab.hasClass('collapsed')) {
        toggleCollapsedMode();
        toogleCollapsedContainers(true);
        post_payload_collapsed.user_config_value = "1";
    } else {
        toggleCollapsedMode();
        toogleCollapsedContainers(false);
        post_payload_collapsed.user_config_value = "0";
        
        const customTagsContainer = document.getElementById('custom_tags_container');
        if (customTagsContainer && !customTagsContainer.classList.contains('collapsed_file')) {
            const customTagsBtn = customTagsContainer.querySelector('.box_edition_btn');
            if (customTagsBtn) {
                toggleFileBoxFromElement(customTagsBtn, { forceCollapsed: true });
            }
        }
    }
    hideContainerIfOpen("property_description");
    hideContainerIfOpen("information_network");
    saveUserConfig(post_payload_collapsed);
}

function toggleIcon(btn, collapsed=null) {
    if (collapsed !== null) {
        btn.setAttribute('data-collapsed', String(collapsed));
        return;
    }
    const isCollapsed = btn.getAttribute('data-collapsed') === 'true';
    btn.setAttribute('data-collapsed', String(!isCollapsed));
}

function toggleCollapsedMode () {
    const propertyInfoContainer = $('#property_info');
    const isCollapsed = propertyInfoContainer.hasClass('collapsed_mode');
    propertyInfoContainer.toggleClass('collapsed_mode', !isCollapsed);
}

function toogleCollapsedContainers(collapsed) {
    const allContainers = document.querySelectorAll('.new_file_box_container');
    const allTagContainers = document.querySelectorAll('.new_property_tags_container, .operations_attr_container');

    allContainers.forEach(function (container) {
        const btn = container.querySelector('.box_edition_btn');
        const body = container.querySelector('.box_body');

        if (!btn || !body) return;

        animateHeight(body, function () {
        container.classList.toggle('collapsed_file', collapsed);
        btn.setAttribute('data-collapsed', String(collapsed));
        });
    });

    if (collapsed) {
        allTagContainers.forEach(function (container) {
            checkIfAllTagsUnchecked($(container));
        });
        allContainers.forEach(function (container) {
            updateEditSectionsEmptyState($(container));
        });
    }
    setTagContainerHeight(collapsed);
}

function hideContainerIfOpen(containerId){
    const container = $('#' + containerId);
    if (container.hasClass('collapsed_file')) {
        return
    }
    const btnCollapsed = container.find('button.box_edition_btn');
    if (btnCollapsed.length) {
        btnCollapsed[0].click();
    }
}

function hideEmptyFieldOnCollapse(editableField, value, extraRule) {
    const rules = ["", 0,, "0","---", null, undefined];
    if (extraRule !== undefined) {
        rules.push(extraRule);
    }

    const field = $(editableField);
    const fieldPlaceholder = field.attr('data-placeholder');
    const container = field.closest('.editFieldContainer');

    const valueField = value !== undefined ? value : $(field).text().trim();

    if (container.length === 0) {
        return;
    }
    if (rules.includes(valueField) || valueField === fieldPlaceholder) {
        container.addClass('is_empty');
    } else {
        container.removeClass('is_empty');
    }
}

function checkIfAllTagsUnchecked(container) {
    const allUnchecked = container.find('input[type="checkbox"]').filter(function() {
        return !$(this).prop('checked');
    }).length === container.find('input[type="checkbox"]').length;

    if (allUnchecked) {
        container.addClass('all_tags_not_checked');
    } else {
        container.removeClass('all_tags_not_checked');
    }
}

function updateEditSectionsEmptyState(container) {
    const editSections = container.find(".editFieldsSection");
    if (!editSections.length) return;

    editSections.each(function () {
        const $section = $(this);
        const sectionId = $section.attr('id');
        
        if (sectionId === 'sale_operation_block' || sectionId === 'rent_operation_block' || sectionId === 'temporary_rent_operation_block') {
            return;
        }
        
        const $fields = $section.find(".editFieldContainer");

        const isEmptySection =
        !$fields.length ||
        $fields.toArray().every(function (el) {
            const $el = $(el);
            return $el.hasClass("is_empty") || $el.hasClass("all_tags_not_checked");
        });

        $section.toggleClass("is_empty", isEmptySection);
    });
    }

function unifiedFilterCustomTags(value){
    var searchInput = $('#unified_custom_tags_search');
    var clearBtn = $('#clear_custom_tag_search_btn');
    clearTimeout(window.customTagFilterTimeout);
    
    if (value.trim() === '') {
        searchInput.removeClass('filtering');
        clearBtn.hide();
        restoreAllCustomTagsContainers();
    } else {
        searchInput.addClass('filtering');
        clearBtn.show();
        window.customTagFilterTimeout = setTimeout(function() {
            filterAllCustomTagContainers(value.trim());
        }, 300);
    }
}

function restoreAllCustomTagsContainers() {
  customTagscontainers.forEach(group => {
    const liCount = $(`#${group.ulId} > li`).length;
    const groupElement = $(`#${group.ulId}`);

    $(`ul#${group.ulId} > li`).show();

    groupElement.removeClass('filtered new_viewmore')

    if (liCount > getMaxVisibleItems()) {
        groupElement.css('height', '141px');
    }
    
    $(`#viewmore_custom_tags_${group.id}`).show();
    $(`#viewless_custom_tags_${group.id}`).hide();
    $(`#no_results_${group.id}`).remove();
  });
  
  checkViewMoreTagsBtns();
}

function filterAllCustomTagContainers(value) {
  const searchValue = value.toLowerCase();

  customTagscontainers.forEach(group => {
    $(`ul#${group.ulId} > li:not([name='li_filter_${group.id}'])`).hide();
    $(`ul#${group.ulId} > li[name*='${searchValue}']`).show();
    $(`#${group.ulId}`).addClass('filtered');
    adjustContainerHeight(group.ulId);
  });

  showNoResultsTagsMessage();
}

function showNoResultsTagsMessage() {
  customTagscontainers.forEach(group => {
    const visible = $(`ul#${group.ulId} > li:visible:not([name='li_filter_${group.id}'])`).length;
    const $noResults = $(`#no_results_${group.id}`);

    if (visible === 0) {
      if ($noResults.length === 0) {
        $(`#${group.ulId}`).after(
          `<div id="no_results_${group.id}" class="no_results_message">No hay etiquetas en este grupo</div>`
        );
      }
    } else {
      $noResults.remove();
    }
  });
}

function clearSearchCustomTags(){

function show_temprent_modal(event){

function update_temprent_min_price_label(updatedPeriod, updatedValue) {
    var periods = $('#property_temporary_rent_ul > li[data-period]');
    var minPrice = null;
    var minPeriodName = '';
    var minCurrency = '';
    var minPriceValue = Infinity;
    var periodCount = 0;
    
    periods.each(function() {
        var $li = $(this);
        var periodId = $li.attr('id').replace('li_temprent_', '');
        var priceText = '';
        
        if (updatedPeriod && periodId === updatedPeriod && updatedValue !== undefined) {
            priceText = updatedValue.toString();
        } else {
            var $priceField = $li.find('.property_data_value');
            if ($priceField.length) {
                priceText = $priceField.text().trim();
            }
        }
        
        if (priceText) {
            var priceValue = parseFloat(priceText.replace(/\./g, '').replace(/,/g, '').replace(/ /g, ''));
            if (!isNaN(priceValue) && priceValue > 0) {
                periodCount++;
                if (priceValue < minPriceValue) {
                    minPriceValue = priceValue;
                    var periodTitle = $li.find('.property_data').first().text().trim();
                    var currency = $li.attr('data-currency');
                    if (!currency) {
                        var titleMatch = $li.attr('title').match(/\(([^)]+)\)$/);
                        if (titleMatch) {
                            currency = titleMatch[1];
                        }
                    }
                    minCurrency = currency || '';
                    var periodNameMatch = periodTitle.match(/^([^(]+)/);
                    minPeriodName = periodNameMatch ? periodNameMatch[1].trim() : periodTitle;
                    
                    var formattedPrice = priceText;
                    if (priceValue >= 1000 && !formattedPrice.match(/[.,]/)) {
                        formattedPrice = priceValue.toLocaleString('es-AR');
                    }
                    minPrice = formattedPrice;
                }
            }
        }
    });
    
    var $label = $('#temprent_min_price_label');
    var $currencyDisplay = $('#temprent_currency_display');
    var $container = $('.temp_rent_price_field');
    
    if (minPrice && periodCount > 0) {
        var displayText;
        if (periodCount > 1) {
            displayText = 'Desde ' + minPrice;
        } else {
            displayText = minPeriodName + ' ' + minPrice;
        }
        $label.text(displayText).show();
        
        if (minCurrency && $currencyDisplay.length) {
            var $flag = $currencyDisplay.find('.country-flag');
            var flagSrc = '';
            
            var existingFlag = $('.country-flag[alt*="' + minCurrency + ' flag"]').first();
            if (existingFlag.length) {
                flagSrc = existingFlag.attr('src');
            } else {
                var primaryCurrency = 'USD';
                var secondaryCurrency = 'ARS';
                if (minCurrency === primaryCurrency) {
                    var $primaryFlag = $('.country-flag[alt*="' + primaryCurrency + ' flag"]').first();
                    if ($primaryFlag.length) {
                        flagSrc = $primaryFlag.attr('src');
                    }
                } else if (minCurrency === secondaryCurrency) {
                    var $secondaryFlag = $('.country-flag[alt*="' + secondaryCurrency + ' flag"]').first();
                    if ($secondaryFlag.length) {
                        flagSrc = $secondaryFlag.attr('src');
                    }
                }
            }
            
            if (!flagSrc) {
                flagSrc = '/static/img/flags-icons/' + minCurrency.toLowerCase() + '.png';
            }
            
            if ($flag.length) {
                $flag.attr('src', flagSrc).attr('alt', minCurrency + ' flag');
                var $currencyText = $flag.next();
                if ($currencyText.length && $currencyText.is('span, div')) {
                    $currencyText.text(minCurrency);
                } else {
                    $flag.after('<span>' + minCurrency + '</span>');
                }
            } else {
                $currencyDisplay.html('<img class="country-flag" src="' + flagSrc + '" alt="' + minCurrency + ' flag" /><span>' + minCurrency + '</span>');
            }
            $currencyDisplay.show();
        }
        
        $container.removeClass('is_empty');
    } else {
        $label.hide();
        $currencyDisplay.hide();
        $container.addClass('is_empty');
    }
}

function remove_temprent_operation(period){

function add_temprent_occupation(){

    return
}

date_from = $("#temprent_from").val();

    Alert('No selecciono una fecha desde', function(){}, "Advertencia!")
    return
}

    Alert('No selecciono una fecha hasta', function(){}, "Advertencia!")
    return
}

date_from_date = new Date(date_from_parts[2], date_from_parts[1],date_from_parts[0]);

date_to_parts = date_to.split('.');
date_to_date = new Date(date_to_parts[2], date_to_parts[1],date_to_parts[0]);

if (date_to_date < date_from_date){
    Alert('La fecha hasta no puede ser menor a la fecha desde.', function(){}, "Advertencia!")
    return
}

        $("#temprent_from").val('')
        $('#temprent_contact_id').val('')
        $('#temprent_contact').text('Buscar contacto')
        update_help_qtips();
        handle_cleaning_tax_visibility();
        })
}

        if ((skip_first == true) && (i==0)) continue;
        tmpAry[i-start_i] = new Array();
        tmpAry[i-start_i][0] = selElem.options[i].text;
        tmpAry[i-start_i][1] = selElem.options[i].value;
    }
    tmpAry.sort();

    while (selElem.options.length > 0) {
        selElem.options[0] = null;
    }

    if (skip_first == true){
        selElem.options[0] = first_option;
    }

    for (var i=0;i<tmpAry.length;i++) {
        var op = new Option(tmpAry[i][0], tmpAry[i][1]);
        selElem.options[i+start_i] = op;
    }
    return;
}
