function toogleEnabledOperation(event){
    if (!event || !event.target) return;
    
    const clickedInput = event.target;
    const operationId = clickedInput.id;
    const isChecked = clickedInput.checked;
    
    const hasPrice = checkOperationHasPrice(operationId);
    
    if (isChecked && !hasPrice) {
        clickedInput.checked = false;
        updateOperationState(operationId, false, false);
        return;
    }
    
    if (isChecked) {
        updateOperationState(operationId, true, false);
        save_operation(operationId, true);
        if (typeof window.updateOperationsStatesButtons === 'function') {
            setTimeout(function() {
                window.updateOperationsStatesButtons();
            }, 100);
        }
    } else {
        updateOperationState(operationId, false, true);
        save_operation(operationId, false);
        
        setTimeout(function() {
            var currentChecked = clickedInput.checked;
            if (currentChecked) {
                updateOperationState(operationId, true, false);
            }
            if (typeof window.updateOperationsStatesButtons === 'function') {
                window.updateOperationsStatesButtons();
            }
        }, 150);
    }
}

function checkOperationHasPrice(operationId) {
    const opMap = {
        'OP-1-ENA': {'primaryKey':'OP-1-primary', 'secondaryKey':'OP-1-secondary'},
        'OP-2-ENA': {'primaryKey':'OP-2-primary', 'secondaryKey':'OP-2-secondary'},
        'OP-3-ENA': {'hasPeriods': true}
    };

    if (opMap[operationId]) {
        if (operationId === 'OP-3-ENA') {
            return $('#property_temporary_rent_ul > li[data-period]').length > 0;
        }
        const primaryPrice = $('#' + opMap[operationId].primaryKey).text().trim().replace(/\./g,'').replace(/,/g,'').replace(/ /g, '');
        const secondaryPrice = $('#' + opMap[operationId].secondaryKey).text().trim().replace(/\./g,'').replace(/,/g,'').replace(/ /g, '');
        const primaryNum = parseInt(primaryPrice);
        const secondaryNum = parseInt(secondaryPrice);
        return (!isNaN(primaryNum) && primaryNum > 0) || (!isNaN(secondaryNum) && secondaryNum > 0);
    }
    return false;
}

function updateOperationState(operationId, isEnabled, isManualDisable) {
    const input = document.getElementById(operationId);
    if (!input) return;
    
    const switchLabel = input.closest('.switch');
    const statusText = document.getElementById(operationId + '_status_text');
    
    if (!switchLabel) return;
    
    if (operationId === 'OP-1-ENA' || operationId === 'OP-2-ENA' || operationId === 'OP-3-ENA') {
        const hasPrice = checkOperationHasPrice(operationId);
        let blockId, buttonId;
        if (operationId === 'OP-1-ENA') {
            blockId = 'sale_operation_block';
            buttonId = 'sale_button';
        } else if (operationId === 'OP-2-ENA') {
            blockId = 'rent_operation_block';
            buttonId = 'rent_button';
        } else {
            blockId = 'temporary_rent_operation_block';
            buttonId = 'temporary_rent_button';
        }
        const block = document.getElementById(blockId);
        const button = document.getElementById(buttonId);
        
        if (statusText) {
            statusText.classList.remove('operation-status-enabled', 'operation-status-disabled', 'operation-status-empty');
        }
        if (!hasPrice) {
            switchLabel.classList.add('switch-disabled');
            input.disabled = true;
            input.checked = false;
            if (statusText) {
                statusText.textContent = "Ingresá un precio";
                statusText.style.display = 'inline';
                statusText.classList.add('operation-status-empty');
            }
            if (block) {
                block.classList.add('is_empty');
            }
            if (button) {
                button.classList.remove('checked');
            }
        } else {
            switchLabel.classList.remove('switch-disabled');
            input.disabled = false;
            
            if (isEnabled) {
                if (statusText) {
                    statusText.textContent = "Operación habilitada";
                    statusText.style.display = 'inline';
                    statusText.classList.add('operation-status-enabled');
                }
                if (block) {
                    block.classList.remove('is_empty');
                }
                if (button) {
                    button.classList.add('checked');
                }

            } else if (isManualDisable) {
                input.checked = false;
                const $input = $(input);
                $input.prop('checked', false);
                $input.removeAttr('checked');
                if (statusText) {
                    statusText.textContent = "Operación deshabilitada";
                    statusText.style.display = 'inline';
                    statusText.classList.add('operation-status-disabled');
                }
                if (block) {
                    block.classList.add('is_empty');
                }
                if (button) {
                    button.classList.remove('checked');
                }
            } else {
                if (statusText) {
                    if (input.checked) {
                        statusText.textContent = "Operación habilitada";
                        statusText.style.display = 'inline';
                        statusText.classList.add('operation-status-enabled');
                    } else {
                        statusText.textContent = "Operación deshabilitada";
                        statusText.style.display = 'inline';
                        statusText.classList.add('operation-status-disabled');
                    }
                }
                if (block) {
                    if (input.checked) {
                        block.classList.remove('is_empty');
                    } else {
                        block.classList.add('is_empty');
                    }
                }
                if (button) {
                    if (input.checked) {
                        button.classList.add('checked');
                    } else {
                        button.classList.remove('checked');
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

function updateAllOperationsState() {
    ['OP-1-ENA', 'OP-2-ENA'].forEach(function(opId) {
        const input = document.getElementById(opId);
        if (input) {
            const hasPrice = checkOperationHasPrice(opId);
            if (hasPrice) {
                const isChecked = input.checked;
                const isManualDisable = hasPrice && !isChecked;
                updateOperationState(opId, isChecked, isManualDisable);
            } else {
                updateOperationState(opId, false, false);
            }
        }
    });
}

function updateTemporaryRentState() {
    const hasPeriods = $('#property_temporary_rent_ul > li[data-period]').length > 0;
    const tempRentInput = document.getElementById('OP-3-ENA');
    const tempRentStatusText = document.getElementById('OP-3-ENA_status_text');
    const tempRentBlock = document.getElementById('temporary_rent_operation_block');
    const tempRentButton = document.getElementById('temporary_rent_button');
    
    if (tempRentInput) {
        const isChecked = tempRentInput.checked;
        const switchLabel = tempRentInput.closest('.switch');
        
        if (switchLabel) {
            if (hasPeriods) {
                switchLabel.classList.remove('switch-disabled');
                tempRentInput.disabled = false;
            } else {
                switchLabel.classList.add('switch-disabled');
                tempRentInput.disabled = true;
                tempRentInput.checked = false;
            }
        }
        
        if (tempRentStatusText) {
            tempRentStatusText.classList.remove('operation-status-enabled', 'operation-status-disabled', 'operation-status-empty');
            
            if (!hasPeriods) {
                tempRentStatusText.textContent = "Agregá un período para habilitar la operación";
                tempRentStatusText.style.display = 'inline';
                tempRentStatusText.classList.add('operation-status-empty');
            } else if (isChecked) {
                tempRentStatusText.textContent = "Operación habilitada";
                tempRentStatusText.style.display = 'inline';
                tempRentStatusText.classList.add('operation-status-enabled');
            } else {
                tempRentStatusText.textContent = "Operación deshabilitada";
                tempRentStatusText.style.display = 'inline';
                tempRentStatusText.classList.add('operation-status-disabled');
            }
        }
        
        if (tempRentBlock) {
            if (hasPeriods && isChecked) {
                tempRentBlock.classList.remove('is_empty');
            } else {
                tempRentBlock.classList.add('is_empty');
            }
        }
        
        if (tempRentButton) {
            if (hasPeriods && isChecked) {
                tempRentButton.classList.add('checked');
            } else {
                tempRentButton.classList.remove('checked');
            }
        }
    }
    
    update_temprent_min_price_label();
    
    if (typeof window.updateOperationsStatesButtons === 'function') {
        setTimeout(function() {
            window.updateOperationsStatesButtons();
        }, 100);
    }
}

var editingFields = {
    'OP-1-primary': false,
    'OP-1-secondary': false,
    'OP-2-primary': false,
    'OP-2-secondary': false
};

function autoEnableOperationIfHasPrice(operationId) {
    const input = document.getElementById(operationId);
    if (!input) return;
    
    const $input = $(input);
    const hasPrice = checkOperationHasPrice(operationId);
    
    if (hasPrice) {
        const isAlreadyChecked = $input.is(':checked');
        if (!isAlreadyChecked) {
            input.checked = true;
            $input.prop('checked', true);
            updateOperationState(operationId, true, false);
            save_operation(operationId, true);
        } else {
            updateOperationState(operationId, true, false);
        }
    } else {
        input.checked = false;
        $input.prop('checked', false);
        const switchLabel = input.closest('.switch');
        const statusText = document.getElementById(operationId + '_status_text');
        const blockId = operationId === 'OP-1-ENA' ? 'sale_operation_block' : 'rent_operation_block';
        const buttonId = operationId === 'OP-1-ENA' ? 'sale_button' : 'rent_button';
        const block = document.getElementById(blockId);
        const button = document.getElementById(buttonId);
        if (switchLabel) {
            switchLabel.classList.add('switch-disabled');
            input.disabled = true;
        }
        if (statusText) {
            statusText.textContent = "Ingresá un precio";
            statusText.style.display = 'inline';
            statusText.classList.remove('operation-status-enabled', 'operation-status-disabled');
            statusText.classList.add('operation-status-empty');
        }
        if (block) {
            block.classList.add('is_empty');
        }
        if (button) {
            button.classList.remove('checked');
        }
        updateOperationState(operationId, false, false);
    }
    
    if (typeof window.updateOperationsStatesButtons === 'function') {
        setTimeout(function() {
            window.updateOperationsStatesButtons();
        }, 100);
    }
}

function updateOperationStateAfterEdit(fieldId) {
    if (!fieldId) return;
    const opType = fieldId.includes('OP-1') ? 'OP-1-ENA' : 'OP-2-ENA';
    autoEnableOperationIfHasPrice(opType);
    if (typeof window.updateOperationsStatesButtons === 'function') {
        setTimeout(function() {
            window.updateOperationsStatesButtons();
        }, 200);
    }
}

$(document).ready(function() {
    updateAllOperationsState();
    updateTemporaryRentState();
   
});

<div class="operation_state_container" from_empty_state="true">
    
    <button id="sale_button_from_empty" onclick="handleOperationStateClick(true,'sale','sale_button_from_empty')" class="btn-secondary-outlined selected">Venta<i class="icon icon-aceptar"></i></button>
    <button id="rent_button_from_empty" onclick="handleOperationStateClick(true,'rent','rent_button_from_empty')" class="btn-secondary-outlined">Alquiler<i class="icon icon-aceptar"></i></button>
    <button id="temporary_rent_button_from_empty" onclick="handleOperationStateClick(true,'temporary_rent','temporary_rent_button_from_empty')" class="btn-secondary-outlined">Alquiler temporario<i class="icon icon-aceptar"></i></button>
    
</div>

<script>

if (typeof window.handleOperationStateClick === 'undefined') {

window.handleOperationStateClick = function(fromEmptyState, operation,btnID) {
    if(btnID && document.getElementById(btnID).classList.contains('disabled_element_operation')) {
        return;
    }
    isFromEmptyState = fromEmptyState;
    const saleButton = $('#sale_button');
    const rentButton = $('#rent_button');
    const temporaryRentButton = $('#temporary_rent_button');
    
    const saleBlock = $('#sale_operation_block');
    const rentBlock = $('#rent_operation_block');
    const temporaryRentBlock = $('#temporary_rent_operation_block');
    
    const salePrimary = $('#OP-1-primary');
    const saleSecondary = $('#OP-1-secondary');
    const rentPrimary = $('#OP-2-primary');
    const rentSecondary = $('#OP-2-secondary');
    
    const cotizationBoxContainer = document.querySelector('.cotization_box_container');
    const emptyStateContainer = document.querySelector('.cotization_empty_state_container.expanded_content');
    
    const operationsState = typeof getOperationsState === 'function' ? getOperationsState() : {
        hasSalePrice: false,
        hasRentPrice: false,
        hasTempRentPeriods: false,
        hasAnyOperation: false
    };
    
    const hasSalePrice = operationsState.hasSalePrice;
    const hasRentPrice = operationsState.hasRentPrice;
    const hasTempRentPeriods = operationsState.hasTempRentPeriods;

    if(fromEmptyState) {
        if (cotizationBoxContainer) cotizationBoxContainer.style.display = 'flex';
        if (emptyStateContainer) emptyStateContainer.style.display = 'none';
    }

    if (operation === 'sale') {
        const isSelected = saleButton.hasClass('selected');
        saleButton.toggleClass('selected', !isSelected);
        if (hasSalePrice) {
            const tempRentEnabled = $('#OP-3-ENA').is(':checked');
            const hasOtherOperations = hasRentPrice || tempRentEnabled;
            if (!hasOtherOperations && typeof statuses !== 'undefined' && statuses.selected == 2) {
                if (typeof Alert === 'function') {
                    Alert("No podés borrar todas las tasaciones de una propiedad disponible.", function(){}, 'Advertencia');
                    saleButton.toggleClass('selected', true);
                }
                return;
            }
            if (isSelected) {
                if (saleBlock) saleBlock.addClass('operation_off');
                const saleSwitchChecked = $('#OP-1-ENA').is(':checked');
                if (saleSwitchChecked) {
                    const rentSwitchChecked = $('#OP-2-ENA').is(':checked');
                    const tempRentSwitchChecked = $('#OP-3-ENA').is(':checked');
                    const otherOperationsActive = rentSwitchChecked || tempRentSwitchChecked;
                    
                    if (typeof statuses !== 'undefined' && statuses.selected == 2 && !otherOperationsActive) {
                        if (typeof Alert === 'function') {
                            Alert("No podés deshabilitar todas las tasaciones de una propiedad disponible.", function(){}, 'Advertencia');
                            saleButton.toggleClass('selected', false);
                            return;
                        }
                    }
                    
                    if (typeof save_operation === 'function') {
                        const saleSwitch = document.getElementById('OP-1-ENA');
                        save_operation('OP-1-ENA', false, saleSwitch);
                        if (typeof updateOperationState === 'function') {
                            setTimeout(function() {
                                updateOperationState('OP-1-ENA', false, true);
                                if (typeof window.updateOperationsStatesButtons === 'function') {
                                    window.updateOperationsStatesButtons();
                                }
                            }, 100);
                        }
                    }
                    return;
                } else {
                    return;
                }
            } else {
                if (saleBlock) saleBlock.removeClass('operation_off');
                if (typeof window.updateOperationsStatesButtons === 'function') {
                    setTimeout(function() {
                        window.updateOperationsStatesButtons();
                    }, 100);
                }
            }
        } else {
            if (saleBlock && !isSelected) saleBlock.removeClass('operation_off');
            if (saleBlock && isSelected) saleBlock.addClass('operation_off');
            if (typeof updateOperationStateAfterEdit === 'function') {
            setTimeout(function() {
                updateOperationStateAfterEdit('OP-1-ENA');
                }, 100);
        }
        }
        window.updateOperationButtonsState({checkAll:false, fromEmptyState: fromEmptyState});
    } else if (operation === 'rent') {
        const isSelected = rentButton.hasClass('selected');
        rentButton.toggleClass('selected', !isSelected);
        if (hasRentPrice) {
            if (isSelected) {
                if (rentBlock) rentBlock.addClass('operation_off');
                const rentSwitchChecked = $('#OP-2-ENA').is(':checked');
                if (rentSwitchChecked) {
                    const saleSwitchChecked = $('#OP-1-ENA').is(':checked');
                    const tempRentSwitchChecked = $('#OP-3-ENA').is(':checked');
                    const otherOperationsActive = saleSwitchChecked || tempRentSwitchChecked;
                    
                    if (typeof statuses !== 'undefined' && statuses.selected == 2 && !otherOperationsActive) {
                        if (typeof Alert === 'function') {
                            Alert("No podés deshabilitar todas las tasaciones de una propiedad disponible.", function(){}, 'Advertencia');
                            rentButton.toggleClass('selected', false);
                            return;
                        }
                    }
                    
                    if (typeof save_operation === 'function') {
                        const rentSwitch = document.getElementById('OP-2-ENA');
                        save_operation('OP-2-ENA', false, rentSwitch);
                        if (typeof updateOperationState === 'function') {
                            setTimeout(function() {
                                updateOperationState('OP-2-ENA', false, true);
                                if (typeof window.updateOperationsStatesButtons === 'function') {
                                    window.updateOperationsStatesButtons();
                                }
                            }, 100);
                        }
                    }
                    return;
                } else {
                    return;
                }
            } else {
                if (rentBlock) rentBlock.removeClass('operation_off');
                if (typeof window.updateOperationsStatesButtons === 'function') {
                    setTimeout(function() {
                        window.updateOperationsStatesButtons();
                    }, 100);
                }
            }
        } else {
            if (rentBlock && !isSelected) rentBlock.removeClass('operation_off');
            if (rentBlock && isSelected) rentBlock.addClass('operation_off');
        }
        window.updateOperationButtonsState({checkAll:false,  fromEmptyState: fromEmptyState});
    } else if (operation === 'temporary_rent') {
        const isSelected = temporaryRentButton.hasClass('selected');
        temporaryRentButton.toggleClass('selected', !isSelected);
        
        const tempRentEnabled = $('#OP-3-ENA').is(':checked');
        const hasTempRentPeriods = $('#property_temporary_rent_ul > li[data-period]').length > 0;
        
        if (hasTempRentPeriods) {
            if (isSelected) {
                if (temporaryRentBlock) temporaryRentBlock.addClass('operation_off');
                if (tempRentEnabled) {
                    const saleSwitchChecked = $('#OP-1-ENA').is(':checked');
                    const rentSwitchChecked = $('#OP-2-ENA').is(':checked');
                    const otherOperationsActive = saleSwitchChecked || rentSwitchChecked;
                    
                    if (typeof statuses !== 'undefined' && statuses.selected == 2 && !otherOperationsActive) {
                        if (typeof Alert === 'function') {
                            Alert("No podés deshabilitar todas las tasaciones de una propiedad disponible.", function(){}, 'Advertencia');
                            temporaryRentButton.toggleClass('selected', false);
                            return;
                        }
                    }
                    
                    if (typeof save_operation === 'function') {
                        const tempRentSwitch = document.getElementById('OP-3-ENA');
                        save_operation('OP-3-ENA', false, tempRentSwitch);
                        if (typeof updateOperationState === 'function') {
                            setTimeout(function() {
                                updateOperationState('OP-3-ENA', false, true);
                                if (typeof window.updateOperationsStatesButtons === 'function') {
                                    window.updateOperationsStatesButtons();
                                }
                            }, 100);
                        }
                    }
                    return;
                } else {
                    return;
                }
            } else {
                if (temporaryRentBlock) temporaryRentBlock.removeClass('operation_off');
                if (typeof window.updateOperationsStatesButtons === 'function') {
                    setTimeout(function() {
                        window.updateOperationsStatesButtons();
                    }, 100);
                }
            }
        } else {
            if (temporaryRentBlock && !isSelected) temporaryRentBlock.removeClass('operation_off');
            if (temporaryRentBlock && isSelected) temporaryRentBlock.addClass('operation_off');
        }
        window.updateOperationButtonsState({checkAll:false, fromEmptyState: fromEmptyState});
    }
    
}
}

if (typeof window.updateOperationButtonsState === 'undefined') {

window.updateOperationButtonsState = function(options) {
    const saleButton = document.getElementById('sale_button');
    const rentButton = document.getElementById('rent_button');
    const temporaryRentButton = document.getElementById('temporary_rent_button');
    
    if (!saleButton || !rentButton || !temporaryRentButton) return;
    
    const saleBlock = document.getElementById('sale_operation_block');
    const rentBlock = document.getElementById('rent_operation_block');
    const temporaryRentBlock = document.getElementById('temporary_rent_operation_block');
    
    const buttonsMap = {
        sale: saleButton,
        rent: rentButton,
        temporary_rent: temporaryRentButton
    };

    const operationsState = typeof getOperationsState === 'function' ? getOperationsState() : {
        hasSalePrice: typeof checkOperationHasPrice === 'function' ? checkOperationHasPrice('OP-1-ENA') : false,
        hasRentPrice: typeof checkOperationHasPrice === 'function' ? checkOperationHasPrice('OP-2-ENA') : false,
        hasTempRentPeriods: typeof $ !== 'undefined' ? $('#OP-3-ENA').is(':checked') : false,
        hasAnyOperation: false
    };
    
    const hasSalePrice = operationsState.hasSalePrice;
    const hasRentPrice = operationsState.hasRentPrice;
    const hasTempRentPeriods = operationsState.hasTempRentPeriods;

    function updateButton(button, hasPrice, block) {
        const isButtonSelected = button.classList.contains('selected');
        if (hasPrice) {
            button.classList.add('selected');
        } else {
            if (!isButtonSelected) {
                button.classList.remove('selected');
            }
        }
        if (block) {
            if (isButtonSelected) {
                block.classList.remove('operation_off');
            } else if (!hasPrice) {
                block.classList.add('operation_off');
            }
        }
    }


    const tempRentEnabled = $('#OP-3-ENA').is(':checked');
    const updateMap = {
        sale: () => updateButton(saleButton, hasSalePrice, saleBlock),
        rent: () => updateButton(rentButton, hasRentPrice, rentBlock),
        temporary_rent: () => updateButton(temporaryRentButton, tempRentEnabled, temporaryRentBlock)
    };

    if (options?.checkAll) {
    Object.values(updateMap).forEach((fn) => fn());
    }

    if (options && !options.checkAll){
        updateMap[options.operations]?.()
    } 

    const cotizationBoxContainer = document.querySelector('.cotization_box_container');
    const emptyStateContainer = document.querySelector('.cotization_empty_state_container.expanded_content');
    
    const saleSwitchChecked = $('#OP-1-ENA').is(':checked');
    const rentSwitchChecked = $('#OP-2-ENA').is(':checked');
    const tempRentSwitchChecked = $('#OP-3-ENA').is(':checked');
    const enabledOperationsCount = [saleSwitchChecked, rentSwitchChecked, tempRentSwitchChecked].filter(Boolean).length;

    if(typeof statuses !== 'undefined' && statuses.selected == 2 && enabledOperationsCount == 1) {
        if (options && !options.checkAll) {
            if($(".operation_state_container button.disabled_element_operation").length == 0) {
                if (saleSwitchChecked) saleButton.classList.add('disabled_element_operation');
                if (rentSwitchChecked) rentButton.classList.add('disabled_element_operation');
                if (tempRentSwitchChecked) temporaryRentButton.classList.add('disabled_element_operation');
            }
        }
        else {
            if (saleSwitchChecked) saleButton.classList.add('disabled_element_operation');
            if (rentSwitchChecked) rentButton.classList.add('disabled_element_operation');
            if (tempRentSwitchChecked) temporaryRentButton.classList.add('disabled_element_operation');
        }
    }
    if(typeof statuses !== 'undefined' && statuses.selected == 2 && enabledOperationsCount > 1) {
        saleButton.classList.remove('disabled_element_operation');
        rentButton.classList.remove('disabled_element_operation');
        temporaryRentButton.classList.remove('disabled_element_operation');
    }

    setTimeout(() => {
        const thereIsOtherBtnSelected = $('.operation_state_container button.selected').length > 0;
        if (operationsState.hasAnyOperation || thereIsOtherBtnSelected) {
            if (emptyStateContainer) emptyStateContainer.style.display = 'none';
            if (cotizationBoxContainer) cotizationBoxContainer.style.display = 'flex';
        } else if (!options.fromEmptyState && !thereIsOtherBtnSelected) {
            if (emptyStateContainer) emptyStateContainer.style.display = 'flex';
            if (cotizationBoxContainer) cotizationBoxContainer.style.display = 'none';
            if (options.operations == 'temporary_rent') $('#box_temprent_operations').closest('.ui-tooltip').find('.ui-tooltip-close').trigger('click');
        }
    }, 150);
}
}

if (typeof window.updateOperationButtonsSelectedState === 'undefined') {
window.updateOperationButtonsSelectedState = function() {
    const saleButton = document.getElementById('sale_button');
    const rentButton = document.getElementById('rent_button');
    const temporaryRentButton = document.getElementById('temporary_rent_button');
    const saleButtonFromEmpty = document.getElementById('sale_button_from_empty');
    const rentButtonFromEmpty = document.getElementById('rent_button_from_empty');
    const temporaryRentButtonFromEmpty = document.getElementById('temporary_rent_button_from_empty');
    
    const saleBlock = $('#sale_operation_block');
    const rentBlock = $('#rent_operation_block');
    const temporaryRentBlock = $('#temporary_rent_operation_block');
    
    const saleSwitchChecked = $('#OP-1-ENA').is(':checked');
    const rentSwitchChecked = $('#OP-2-ENA').is(':checked');
    const tempRentSwitchChecked = $('#OP-3-ENA').is(':checked');
    
    if (saleButton) {
        if (saleSwitchChecked) {
            saleButton.classList.add('selected');
            saleButton.classList.add('checked');
        } else {
            saleButton.classList.remove('selected');
            saleButton.classList.remove('checked');
        }
    }
    
    if (saleButtonFromEmpty) {
        if (saleSwitchChecked) {
            saleButtonFromEmpty.classList.add('selected');
        } else {
            saleButtonFromEmpty.classList.remove('selected');
        }
    }
    
    if (saleBlock && saleBlock.length) {
        if (saleSwitchChecked) {
            saleBlock.removeClass('operation_off');
            saleBlock.removeClass('is_empty');
        } else {
            saleBlock.addClass('operation_off');
            saleBlock.addClass('is_empty');
        }
    }
    
    if (rentButton) {
        if (rentSwitchChecked) {
            rentButton.classList.add('selected');
            rentButton.classList.add('checked');
        } else {
            rentButton.classList.remove('selected');
            rentButton.classList.remove('checked');
        }
    }
    
    if (rentButtonFromEmpty) {
        if (rentSwitchChecked) {
            rentButtonFromEmpty.classList.add('selected');
        } else {
            rentButtonFromEmpty.classList.remove('selected');
        }
    }
    
    if (rentBlock && rentBlock.length) {
        if (rentSwitchChecked) {
            rentBlock.removeClass('operation_off');
            rentBlock.removeClass('is_empty');
        } else {
            rentBlock.addClass('operation_off');
            rentBlock.addClass('is_empty');
        }
    }
    
    if (temporaryRentButton) {
        if (tempRentSwitchChecked) {
            temporaryRentButton.classList.add('selected');
            temporaryRentButton.classList.add('checked');
        } else {
            temporaryRentButton.classList.remove('selected');
            temporaryRentButton.classList.remove('checked');
        }
    }
    
    if (temporaryRentButtonFromEmpty) {
        if (tempRentSwitchChecked) {
            temporaryRentButtonFromEmpty.classList.add('selected');
        } else {
            temporaryRentButtonFromEmpty.classList.remove('selected');
        }
    }
    
    if (temporaryRentBlock && temporaryRentBlock.length) {
        if (tempRentSwitchChecked) {
            temporaryRentBlock.removeClass('operation_off');
            temporaryRentBlock.removeClass('is_empty');
        } else {
            temporaryRentBlock.addClass('operation_off');
            temporaryRentBlock.addClass('is_empty');
        }
    }
}
}

if (typeof window.updateOperationsStatesButtons === 'undefined') {
window.updateOperationsStatesButtons = function() {
    const saleButton = document.getElementById('sale_button');
    const rentButton = document.getElementById('rent_button');
    const temporaryRentButton = document.getElementById('temporary_rent_button');
    
    if (!saleButton || !rentButton || !temporaryRentButton) return;
    
    if (typeof statuses === 'undefined' || statuses.selected != 2) {
        saleButton.classList.remove('disabled_element_operation');
        rentButton.classList.remove('disabled_element_operation');
        temporaryRentButton.classList.remove('disabled_element_operation');
        return;
    }
    
    const saleSwitchChecked = $('#OP-1-ENA').is(':checked');
    const rentSwitchChecked = $('#OP-2-ENA').is(':checked');
    const tempRentSwitchChecked = $('#OP-3-ENA').is(':checked');
    const enabledOperations = [saleSwitchChecked, rentSwitchChecked, tempRentSwitchChecked].filter(Boolean).length;
    
    saleButton.classList.remove('disabled_element_operation');
    rentButton.classList.remove('disabled_element_operation');
    temporaryRentButton.classList.remove('disabled_element_operation');
    
    if (enabledOperations == 1) {
        if (saleSwitchChecked) saleButton.classList.add('disabled_element_operation');
        if (rentSwitchChecked) rentButton.classList.add('disabled_element_operation');
        if (tempRentSwitchChecked) temporaryRentButton.classList.add('disabled_element_operation');
    }
}
}

var initializedButtons = false;
function initializeOperationButtons() {
    if (typeof window.updateOperationButtonsState === 'function' && !initializedButtons) {
        initializedButtons = true;
        const saleButton = document.getElementById('sale_button');
        const rentButton = document.getElementById('rent_button');
        const temporaryRentButton = document.getElementById('temporary_rent_button');
        const salePrimary = document.getElementById('OP-1-primary');
        const rentPrimary = document.getElementById('OP-2-primary');
        
        if (saleButton && rentButton && temporaryRentButton && salePrimary && rentPrimary) {
            window.updateOperationButtonsState({checkAll: true});
        } 
    }
    
    if (typeof window.updateOperationButtonsSelectedState === 'function') {
        setTimeout(function() {
            window.updateOperationButtonsSelectedState();
        }, 100);
    }
}
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    initializeOperationButtons();
});

</script>

<script>

if (typeof window.handleOperationStateClick === 'undefined') {

window.handleOperationStateClick = function(fromEmptyState, operation,btnID) {
    if(btnID && document.getElementById(btnID).classList.contains('disabled_element_operation')) {
        return;
    }
    isFromEmptyState = fromEmptyState;
    const saleButton = $('#sale_button');
    const rentButton = $('#rent_button');
    const temporaryRentButton = $('#temporary_rent_button');
    
    const saleBlock = $('#sale_operation_block');
    const rentBlock = $('#rent_operation_block');
    const temporaryRentBlock = $('#temporary_rent_operation_block');
    
    const salePrimary = $('#OP-1-primary');
    const saleSecondary = $('#OP-1-secondary');
    const rentPrimary = $('#OP-2-primary');
    const rentSecondary = $('#OP-2-secondary');
    
    const cotizationBoxContainer = document.querySelector('.cotization_box_container');
    const emptyStateContainer = document.querySelector('.cotization_empty_state_container.expanded_content');
    
    const operationsState = typeof getOperationsState === 'function' ? getOperationsState() : {
        hasSalePrice: false,
        hasRentPrice: false,
        hasTempRentPeriods: false,
        hasAnyOperation: false
    };
    
    const hasSalePrice = operationsState.hasSalePrice;
    const hasRentPrice = operationsState.hasRentPrice;
    const hasTempRentPeriods = operationsState.hasTempRentPeriods;

    if(fromEmptyState) {
        if (cotizationBoxContainer) cotizationBoxContainer.style.display = 'flex';
        if (emptyStateContainer) emptyStateContainer.style.display = 'none';
    }

    if (operation === 'sale') {
        const isSelected = saleButton.hasClass('selected');
        saleButton.toggleClass('selected', !isSelected);
        if (hasSalePrice) {
            const tempRentEnabled = $('#OP-3-ENA').is(':checked');
            const hasOtherOperations = hasRentPrice || tempRentEnabled;
            if (!hasOtherOperations && typeof statuses !== 'undefined' && statuses.selected == 2) {
                if (typeof Alert === 'function') {
                    Alert("No podés borrar todas las tasaciones de una propiedad disponible.", function(){}, 'Advertencia');
                    saleButton.toggleClass('selected', true);
                }
                return;
            }
            if (isSelected) {
                if (saleBlock) saleBlock.addClass('operation_off');
                const saleSwitchChecked = $('#OP-1-ENA').is(':checked');
                if (saleSwitchChecked) {
                    const rentSwitchChecked = $('#OP-2-ENA').is(':checked');
                    const tempRentSwitchChecked = $('#OP-3-ENA').is(':checked');
                    const otherOperationsActive = rentSwitchChecked || tempRentSwitchChecked;
                    
                    if (typeof statuses !== 'undefined' && statuses.selected == 2 && !otherOperationsActive) {
                        if (typeof Alert === 'function') {
                            Alert("No podés deshabilitar todas las tasaciones de una propiedad disponible.", function(){}, 'Advertencia');
                            saleButton.toggleClass('selected', false);
                            return;
                        }
                    }
                    
                    if (typeof save_operation === 'function') {
                        const saleSwitch = document.getElementById('OP-1-ENA');
                        save_operation('OP-1-ENA', false, saleSwitch);
                        if (typeof updateOperationState === 'function') {
                            setTimeout(function() {
                                updateOperationState('OP-1-ENA', false, true);
                                if (typeof window.updateOperationsStatesButtons === 'function') {
                                    window.updateOperationsStatesButtons();
                                }
                            }, 100);
                        }
                    }
                    return;
                } else {
                    return;
                }
            } else {
                if (saleBlock) saleBlock.removeClass('operation_off');
                if (typeof window.updateOperationsStatesButtons === 'function') {
                    setTimeout(function() {
                        window.updateOperationsStatesButtons();
                    }, 100);
                }
            }
        } else {
            if (saleBlock && !isSelected) saleBlock.removeClass('operation_off');
            if (saleBlock && isSelected) saleBlock.addClass('operation_off');
            if (typeof updateOperationStateAfterEdit === 'function') {
            setTimeout(function() {
                updateOperationStateAfterEdit('OP-1-ENA');
                }, 100);
        }
        }
        window.updateOperationButtonsState({checkAll:false, fromEmptyState: fromEmptyState});
    } else if (operation === 'rent') {
        const isSelected = rentButton.hasClass('selected');
        rentButton.toggleClass('selected', !isSelected);
        if (hasRentPrice) {
            if (isSelected) {
                if (rentBlock) rentBlock.addClass('operation_off');
                const rentSwitchChecked = $('#OP-2-ENA').is(':checked');
                if (rentSwitchChecked) {
                    const saleSwitchChecked = $('#OP-1-ENA').is(':checked');
                    const tempRentSwitchChecked = $('#OP-3-ENA').is(':checked');
                    const otherOperationsActive = saleSwitchChecked || tempRentSwitchChecked;
                    
                    if (typeof statuses !== 'undefined' && statuses.selected == 2 && !otherOperationsActive) {
                        if (typeof Alert === 'function') {
                            Alert("No podés deshabilitar todas las tasaciones de una propiedad disponible.", function(){}, 'Advertencia');
                            rentButton.toggleClass('selected', false);
                            return;
                        }
                    }
                    
                    if (typeof save_operation === 'function') {
                        const rentSwitch = document.getElementById('OP-2-ENA');
                        save_operation('OP-2-ENA', false, rentSwitch);
                        if (typeof updateOperationState === 'function') {
                            setTimeout(function() {
                                updateOperationState('OP-2-ENA', false, true);
                                if (typeof window.updateOperationsStatesButtons === 'function') {
                                    window.updateOperationsStatesButtons();
                                }
                            }, 100);
                        }
                    }
                    return;
                } else {
                    return;
                }
            } else {
                if (rentBlock) rentBlock.removeClass('operation_off');
                if (typeof window.updateOperationsStatesButtons === 'function') {
                    setTimeout(function() {
                        window.updateOperationsStatesButtons();
                    }, 100);
                }
            }
        } else {
            if (rentBlock && !isSelected) rentBlock.removeClass('operation_off');
            if (rentBlock && isSelected) rentBlock.addClass('operation_off');
        }
        window.updateOperationButtonsState({checkAll:false,  fromEmptyState: fromEmptyState});
    } else if (operation === 'temporary_rent') {
        const isSelected = temporaryRentButton.hasClass('selected');
        temporaryRentButton.toggleClass('selected', !isSelected);
        
        const tempRentEnabled = $('#OP-3-ENA').is(':checked');
        const hasTempRentPeriods = $('#property_temporary_rent_ul > li[data-period]').length > 0;
        
        if (hasTempRentPeriods) {
            if (isSelected) {
                if (temporaryRentBlock) temporaryRentBlock.addClass('operation_off');
                if (tempRentEnabled) {
                    const saleSwitchChecked = $('#OP-1-ENA').is(':checked');
                    const rentSwitchChecked = $('#OP-2-ENA').is(':checked');
                    const otherOperationsActive = saleSwitchChecked || rentSwitchChecked;
                    
                    if (typeof statuses !== 'undefined' && statuses.selected == 2 && !otherOperationsActive) {
                        if (typeof Alert === 'function') {
                            Alert("No podés deshabilitar todas las tasaciones de una propiedad disponible.", function(){}, 'Advertencia');
                            temporaryRentButton.toggleClass('selected', false);
                            return;
                        }
                    }
                    
                    if (typeof save_operation === 'function') {
                        const tempRentSwitch = document.getElementById('OP-3-ENA');
                        save_operation('OP-3-ENA', false, tempRentSwitch);
                        if (typeof updateOperationState === 'function') {
                            setTimeout(function() {
                                updateOperationState('OP-3-ENA', false, true);
                                if (typeof window.updateOperationsStatesButtons === 'function') {
                                    window.updateOperationsStatesButtons();
                                }
                            }, 100);
                        }
                    }
                    return;
                } else {
                    return;
                }
            } else {
                if (temporaryRentBlock) temporaryRentBlock.removeClass('operation_off');
                if (typeof window.updateOperationsStatesButtons === 'function') {
                    setTimeout(function() {
                        window.updateOperationsStatesButtons();
                    }, 100);
                }
            }
        } else {
            if (temporaryRentBlock && !isSelected) temporaryRentBlock.removeClass('operation_off');
            if (temporaryRentBlock && isSelected) temporaryRentBlock.addClass('operation_off');
        }
        window.updateOperationButtonsState({checkAll:false, fromEmptyState: fromEmptyState});
    }
    
}
}

if (typeof window.updateOperationButtonsState === 'undefined') {

window.updateOperationButtonsState = function(options) {
    const saleButton = document.getElementById('sale_button');
    const rentButton = document.getElementById('rent_button');
    const temporaryRentButton = document.getElementById('temporary_rent_button');
    
    if (!saleButton || !rentButton || !temporaryRentButton) return;
    
    const saleBlock = document.getElementById('sale_operation_block');
    const rentBlock = document.getElementById('rent_operation_block');
    const temporaryRentBlock = document.getElementById('temporary_rent_operation_block');
    
    const buttonsMap = {
        sale: saleButton,
        rent: rentButton,
        temporary_rent: temporaryRentButton
    };

    const operationsState = typeof getOperationsState === 'function' ? getOperationsState() : {
        hasSalePrice: typeof checkOperationHasPrice === 'function' ? checkOperationHasPrice('OP-1-ENA') : false,
        hasRentPrice: typeof checkOperationHasPrice === 'function' ? checkOperationHasPrice('OP-2-ENA') : false,
        hasTempRentPeriods: typeof $ !== 'undefined' ? $('#OP-3-ENA').is(':checked') : false,
        hasAnyOperation: false
    };
    
    const hasSalePrice = operationsState.hasSalePrice;
    const hasRentPrice = operationsState.hasRentPrice;
    const hasTempRentPeriods = operationsState.hasTempRentPeriods;

    function updateButton(button, hasPrice, block) {
        const isButtonSelected = button.classList.contains('selected');
        if (hasPrice) {
            button.classList.add('selected');
        } else {
            if (!isButtonSelected) {
                button.classList.remove('selected');
            }
        }
        if (block) {
            if (isButtonSelected) {
                block.classList.remove('operation_off');
            } else if (!hasPrice) {
                block.classList.add('operation_off');
            }
        }
    }


    const tempRentEnabled = $('#OP-3-ENA').is(':checked');
    const updateMap = {
        sale: () => updateButton(saleButton, hasSalePrice, saleBlock),
        rent: () => updateButton(rentButton, hasRentPrice, rentBlock),
        temporary_rent: () => updateButton(temporaryRentButton, tempRentEnabled, temporaryRentBlock)
    };

    if (options?.checkAll) {
    Object.values(updateMap).forEach((fn) => fn());
    }

    if (options && !options.checkAll){
        updateMap[options.operations]?.()
    } 

    const cotizationBoxContainer = document.querySelector('.cotization_box_container');
    const emptyStateContainer = document.querySelector('.cotization_empty_state_container.expanded_content');
    
    const saleSwitchChecked = $('#OP-1-ENA').is(':checked');
    const rentSwitchChecked = $('#OP-2-ENA').is(':checked');
    const tempRentSwitchChecked = $('#OP-3-ENA').is(':checked');
    const enabledOperationsCount = [saleSwitchChecked, rentSwitchChecked, tempRentSwitchChecked].filter(Boolean).length;

    if(typeof statuses !== 'undefined' && statuses.selected == 2 && enabledOperationsCount == 1) {
        if (options && !options.checkAll) {
            if($(".operation_state_container button.disabled_element_operation").length == 0) {
                if (saleSwitchChecked) saleButton.classList.add('disabled_element_operation');
                if (rentSwitchChecked) rentButton.classList.add('disabled_element_operation');
                if (tempRentSwitchChecked) temporaryRentButton.classList.add('disabled_element_operation');
            }
        }
        else {
            if (saleSwitchChecked) saleButton.classList.add('disabled_element_operation');
            if (rentSwitchChecked) rentButton.classList.add('disabled_element_operation');
            if (tempRentSwitchChecked) temporaryRentButton.classList.add('disabled_element_operation');
        }
    }
    if(typeof statuses !== 'undefined' && statuses.selected == 2 && enabledOperationsCount > 1) {
        saleButton.classList.remove('disabled_element_operation');
        rentButton.classList.remove('disabled_element_operation');
        temporaryRentButton.classList.remove('disabled_element_operation');
    }

    setTimeout(() => {
        const thereIsOtherBtnSelected = $('.operation_state_container button.selected').length > 0;
        if (operationsState.hasAnyOperation || thereIsOtherBtnSelected) {
            if (emptyStateContainer) emptyStateContainer.style.display = 'none';
            if (cotizationBoxContainer) cotizationBoxContainer.style.display = 'flex';
        } else if (!options.fromEmptyState && !thereIsOtherBtnSelected) {
            if (emptyStateContainer) emptyStateContainer.style.display = 'flex';
            if (cotizationBoxContainer) cotizationBoxContainer.style.display = 'none';
            if (options.operations == 'temporary_rent') $('#box_temprent_operations').closest('.ui-tooltip').find('.ui-tooltip-close').trigger('click');
        }
    }, 150);
}
}

if (typeof window.updateOperationButtonsSelectedState === 'undefined') {
window.updateOperationButtonsSelectedState = function() {
    const saleButton = document.getElementById('sale_button');
    const rentButton = document.getElementById('rent_button');
    const temporaryRentButton = document.getElementById('temporary_rent_button');
    const saleButtonFromEmpty = document.getElementById('sale_button_from_empty');
    const rentButtonFromEmpty = document.getElementById('rent_button_from_empty');
    const temporaryRentButtonFromEmpty = document.getElementById('temporary_rent_button_from_empty');
    
    const saleBlock = $('#sale_operation_block');
    const rentBlock = $('#rent_operation_block');
    const temporaryRentBlock = $('#temporary_rent_operation_block');
    
    const saleSwitchChecked = $('#OP-1-ENA').is(':checked');
    const rentSwitchChecked = $('#OP-2-ENA').is(':checked');
    const tempRentSwitchChecked = $('#OP-3-ENA').is(':checked');
    
    if (saleButton) {
        if (saleSwitchChecked) {
            saleButton.classList.add('selected');
            saleButton.classList.add('checked');
        } else {
            saleButton.classList.remove('selected');
            saleButton.classList.remove('checked');
        }
    }
    
    if (saleButtonFromEmpty) {
        if (saleSwitchChecked) {
            saleButtonFromEmpty.classList.add('selected');
        } else {
            saleButtonFromEmpty.classList.remove('selected');
        }
    }
    
    if (saleBlock && saleBlock.length) {
        if (saleSwitchChecked) {
            saleBlock.removeClass('operation_off');
            saleBlock.removeClass('is_empty');
        } else {
            saleBlock.addClass('operation_off');
            saleBlock.addClass('is_empty');
        }
    }
    
    if (rentButton) {
        if (rentSwitchChecked) {
            rentButton.classList.add('selected');
            rentButton.classList.add('checked');
        } else {
            rentButton.classList.remove('selected');
            rentButton.classList.remove('checked');
        }
    }
    
    if (rentButtonFromEmpty) {
        if (rentSwitchChecked) {
            rentButtonFromEmpty.classList.add('selected');
        } else {
            rentButtonFromEmpty.classList.remove('selected');
        }
    }
    
    if (rentBlock && rentBlock.length) {
        if (rentSwitchChecked) {
            rentBlock.removeClass('operation_off');
            rentBlock.removeClass('is_empty');
        } else {
            rentBlock.addClass('operation_off');
            rentBlock.addClass('is_empty');
        }
    }
    
    if (temporaryRentButton) {
        if (tempRentSwitchChecked) {
            temporaryRentButton.classList.add('selected');
            temporaryRentButton.classList.add('checked');
        } else {
            temporaryRentButton.classList.remove('selected');
            temporaryRentButton.classList.remove('checked');
        }
    }
    
    if (temporaryRentButtonFromEmpty) {
        if (tempRentSwitchChecked) {
            temporaryRentButtonFromEmpty.classList.add('selected');
        } else {
            temporaryRentButtonFromEmpty.classList.remove('selected');
        }
    }
    
    if (temporaryRentBlock && temporaryRentBlock.length) {
        if (tempRentSwitchChecked) {
            temporaryRentBlock.removeClass('operation_off');
            temporaryRentBlock.removeClass('is_empty');
        } else {
            temporaryRentBlock.addClass('operation_off');
            temporaryRentBlock.addClass('is_empty');
        }
    }
}
}

if (typeof window.updateOperationsStatesButtons === 'undefined') {
window.updateOperationsStatesButtons = function() {
    const saleButton = document.getElementById('sale_button');
    const rentButton = document.getElementById('rent_button');
    const temporaryRentButton = document.getElementById('temporary_rent_button');
    
    if (!saleButton || !rentButton || !temporaryRentButton) return;
    
    if (typeof statuses === 'undefined' || statuses.selected != 2) {
        saleButton.classList.remove('disabled_element_operation');
        rentButton.classList.remove('disabled_element_operation');
        temporaryRentButton.classList.remove('disabled_element_operation');
        return;
    }
    
    const saleSwitchChecked = $('#OP-1-ENA').is(':checked');
    const rentSwitchChecked = $('#OP-2-ENA').is(':checked');
    const tempRentSwitchChecked = $('#OP-3-ENA').is(':checked');
    const enabledOperations = [saleSwitchChecked, rentSwitchChecked, tempRentSwitchChecked].filter(Boolean).length;
    
    saleButton.classList.remove('disabled_element_operation');
    rentButton.classList.remove('disabled_element_operation');
    temporaryRentButton.classList.remove('disabled_element_operation');
    
    if (enabledOperations == 1) {
        if (saleSwitchChecked) saleButton.classList.add('disabled_element_operation');
        if (rentSwitchChecked) rentButton.classList.add('disabled_element_operation');
        if (tempRentSwitchChecked) temporaryRentButton.classList.add('disabled_element_operation');
    }
}
}

var initializedButtons = false;
function initializeOperationButtons() {
    if (typeof window.updateOperationButtonsState === 'function' && !initializedButtons) {
        initializedButtons = true;
        const saleButton = document.getElementById('sale_button');
        const rentButton = document.getElementById('rent_button');
        const temporaryRentButton = document.getElementById('temporary_rent_button');
        const salePrimary = document.getElementById('OP-1-primary');
        const rentPrimary = document.getElementById('OP-2-primary');
        
        if (saleButton && rentButton && temporaryRentButton && salePrimary && rentPrimary) {
            window.updateOperationButtonsState({checkAll: true});
        } 
    }
    
    if (typeof window.updateOperationButtonsSelectedState === 'function') {
        setTimeout(function() {
            window.updateOperationButtonsSelectedState();
        }, 100);
    }
}
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    initializeOperationButtons();
});

</script>

<script>
    var currentPriceData = null;
    var currentTab = 'sale';

    function actionClick() {
        hideSmartPriceScaleModal();
        window.openSmartCotizationModal()
    }

    function showSmartPriceScaleModal() {
        $('#smart_price_scale_modal').show();
        $('body').addClass('modal-open');
    }

    function hideSmartPriceScaleModal() {
        $('#smart_price_scale_modal').hide();
        $('body').removeClass('modal-open');
    }

    function switchPriceTab(tab) {
        currentTab = tab;
        $('.smart_scale_tab').removeClass('active');
        $(`.smart_scale_tab[data-tab="${tab}"]`).addClass('active');
        
        if (currentPriceData && currentPriceData[tab]) {
            renderPriceScale(currentPriceData[tab]);
        }
    }

    function setInitSmartRangeTab(tab) {
        currentTab = tab || 'sale';
        switchPriceTab(currentTab);
    }

    function initializePriceScale(data) {
        currentPriceData = data;
        
        $('#smart_scale_subtitle_sale_rent').hide();
        $('#smart_scale_subtitle_sale').hide();
        
        if (data.sale && data.rent) {
            $('.smart_scale_tabs').show();
            $('.smart_scale_tab[data-tab="sale"]').show();
            $('.smart_scale_tab[data-tab="rent"]').show();
            $('.smart_scale_tab').css('width', '50%').css('pointer-events', 'auto');
            $('#smart_scale_subtitle_sale_rent').show();
        } else if (data.sale && !data.rent) {
            $('.smart_scale_tabs').hide();
            $('#smart_scale_subtitle_sale').show();
            currentTab = 'sale';
        }
        if (data && data[currentTab]) {
            renderPriceScale(data[currentTab]);
        }
    }

    function renderPriceScale(tabData) {
        if (!tabData || !tabData.percentiles) {
            return;
        }

        if (tabData.propertyPriceCurrency) {
            window.priceScaleCurrency = tabData.propertyPriceCurrency;
        }

        var percentiles = tabData.percentiles;
        var percentile50 = percentiles["50"] || percentiles[50];
        var percentile90 = percentiles["90"] || percentiles[90];

        if (!percentile50 || !percentile90) {
            return;
        }

        var idealPrice = parseFloat(percentile50);
        var maxPrice = parseFloat(percentile90);

        var segment1Width = 15;
        var segment2Width = 15;
        var segment3Width = 50;
        var segment4Width = 20;

        $('#smart_scale_bar .segment-1').css('width', segment1Width + '%');
        $('#smart_scale_bar .segment-2').css('width', segment2Width + '%');
        $('#smart_scale_bar .segment-3').css('width', segment3Width + '%');
        $('#smart_scale_bar .segment-4').css('width', segment4Width + '%');

        var idealPosition = segment1Width;
        var maxPosition = segment1Width + segment2Width + segment3Width;

        $('#smart_scale_price_min').text(formatPrice(idealPrice));
        $('#smart_scale_price_max').text(formatPrice(maxPrice));
        
        $('#smart_scale_price_min').css({
            'left': idealPosition + '%',
            'transform': 'translateX(-50%)'
        });
        $('#smart_scale_price_max').css({
            'left': maxPosition + '%',
            'transform': 'translateX(-50%)'
        });

        if (tabData.propertyPrice !== undefined && tabData.propertyPrice !== null && tabData.priceLabelTranslated) {
            var propertyPrice = parseFloat(tabData.propertyPrice);
            var pricePosition = parseFloat(tabData.pricePosition);
            
            if (!isNaN(propertyPrice) && !isNaN(pricePosition)) {
                var tooltipText = formatPrice(propertyPrice) + " es un precio " + tabData.priceLabelTranslated;
                $('#tooltip_content').text(tooltipText);
                
                var visualPosition = mapDataPercentageToVisualPosition(pricePosition);
                $('#smart_scale_tooltip').css({
                    'left': visualPosition + '%',
                    'display': 'block'
                }).show();
            } else {
                $('#smart_scale_tooltip').hide();
            }
        } else {
            $('#smart_scale_tooltip').hide();
        }
    }

    function mapDataPercentageToVisualPosition(dataPercentage) {
        if (dataPercentage <= 50) {
            return (dataPercentage / 50) * 15;
        } else if (dataPercentage <= 70) {
            return 15 + ((dataPercentage - 50) / 20) * 15;
        } else if (dataPercentage <= 90) {
            return 30 + ((dataPercentage - 70) / 20) * 50;
        } else {
            return 80 + ((dataPercentage - 90) / 10) * 20;
        }
    }

    function formatPrice(price) {
        if (!price || price === 0) {
            return '0';
        }
        
        var currency = window.priceScaleCurrency || 'BRL';
        var locale = window.priceScaleLocale || 'pt-BR';
        
        try {
            return new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, {
                style: 'currency',
                currency: currency,
                minimumFractionDigits: 0,
                maximumFractionDigits: 0
            }).format(price);
        } catch (e) {
            return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', {
                style: 'currency',
                currency: currency,
                minimumFractionDigits: 0,
                maximumFractionDigits: 0
            }).format(price);
        }
    }

    $(document).ready(function() {
        if (typeof window.smartPriceScaleData !== 'undefined') {
            initializePriceScale(window.smartPriceScaleData);
        }
    });

    window.updateSmartPriceScale = function(data, currency, locale) {
        if (currency && typeof currency === 'string') {
            window.priceScaleCurrency = currency;
        }
        if (locale && typeof locale === 'string') {
            window.priceScaleLocale = locale;
        }
        initializePriceScale(data);
    };

    window.setInitSmartRangeTab = function(tab) {
        currentTab = tab || 'sale';
        switchPriceTab(currentTab);
    };
</script>

<script>
var smartCotizationEnabled = false;
var showQuintoAndarPriceTag = true;

if (smartCotizationEnabled) {
    $('#smart-cotization-btn').click(function(e) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        
        const propertyId = 8002445;
        const localStorageKey = 'quintoandar_smart_cotizer_' + propertyId;
        
        if (localStorage.getItem(localStorageKey)) {
            $('#smart_cotization_disabled_modal').hide();
            $('#modalSmartCotizationAttrs').hide();
            openQuintoAndarCalculator(propertyId);
            return false;
        }
        
        const fieldStatus = {
            address: false,
            total_surface: false,
            room_amount: false,
            bathroom_amount: false
        };
    
        const street_value = $("#street").data('init');
        const street_number_value = $("#street_number").data('init');
        const location_value = $("#location").text();
        
        if (street_value && street_value.trim() !== '' && 
            street_number_value && 
            location_value && location_value.trim() !== '') {
            fieldStatus.address = true;
        }
    
        const total_surface_value = Number($("#basic_total_surface").text());
        if (!isNaN(total_surface_value) && total_surface_value > 0) {
            fieldStatus.total_surface = true;
        }
    
        const rooms_value = Number($("#basic_room_amount").text());
        if (!isNaN(rooms_value) && rooms_value > 0) {
            fieldStatus.room_amount = true;
        }
    
        const bathrooms_value = Number($("#basic_bathroom_amount").text());
        if (!isNaN(bathrooms_value) && bathrooms_value > 0) {
            fieldStatus.bathroom_amount = true;
        }
    
        const hasEmptyFields = !fieldStatus.address || !fieldStatus.total_surface || 
                               !fieldStatus.room_amount || !fieldStatus.bathroom_amount;
    
        if (hasEmptyFields) {
            updateDisabledModalFields(fieldStatus);
            $('#smart_cotization_disabled_modal').show();
            $('#modalSmartCotizationAttrs').hide();
            return false;
        }
        $('#smart_cotization_disabled_modal').hide();
        window.openSmartCotizationModal();
    });

    function updateDisabledModalFields(fieldStatus) {
        Object.keys(fieldStatus).forEach(function(fieldKey) {
            const fieldId = fieldKey === 'address' ? 'field_address' : 'field_basic_' + fieldKey;
            const fieldElement = $('#' + fieldId);
            const iconElement = fieldElement.find('i');
            
            if (fieldStatus[fieldKey]) {
                fieldElement.hide();
            } else {
                fieldElement.show();
                iconElement.off('click').on('click', function(e) {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    goToIncompleteField(fieldKey);
                });
            }
        });
    }

    function goToIncompleteField(fieldKey) {
        $('#smart_cotization_disabled_modal').hide();
        
        if (fieldKey === 'address') {
            if (typeof showAddresModal === 'function') {
                showAddresModal();
            }
            return;
        }
        
        const targetElement = $('#basic_' + fieldKey);
        if (targetElement.length) {
            $('html, body').animate({
                scrollTop: targetElement.offset().top - 100
            }, 500);
            
            targetElement.addClass('focused');
            targetElement.trigger('click');
        }
    }

    function getRecommendedPricesTag(recommended_prices) {
        const propertyId = 8002445;
        
    }

    function isCookieValid(cookieData) {
        if (!cookieData) return false;
        if (cookieData.expiry) {
            return new Date().getTime() < cookieData.expiry;
        }
        return true;
    }

    function updateTagsFromData(data) {
        if (data && data.sale) {
            const saleContainer = $('#qa_price_tag_container_sale');
            if (saleContainer.length && data.sale.priceLabel && data.sale.priceLabelTranslated) {
                saleContainer.show();
                saleContainer.attr('data-evaluation-id', data.sale.priceLabel.toLocaleLowerCase());
                saleContainer.find('.price_compared_value').attr('data-id', data.sale.priceLabel.toLocaleLowerCase());
                saleContainer.find('.price_compared_value').text(data.sale.priceLabelTranslated);
            }
            saleContainer.off('click').on('click', function() {
                const salePrice = parseFloat($('#OP-1-primary').text().replace(/[^\d]/g, '')) || null;
                const rentPrice = parseFloat($('#OP-2-primary').text().replace(/[^\d]/g, '')) || null;
                if (typeof window.updateSmartPriceScale === 'function') {
                    window.updateSmartPriceScale(data, salePrice, rentPrice);
                }
                if (typeof window.setInitSmartRangeTab === 'function') {
                    window.setInitSmartRangeTab('sale');
                }
                $('#smart_price_scale_modal').show();
                $('body').addClass('modal-open');
            });
        }else {
            $('#qa_price_tag_container_sale').hide();
            $('body').removeClass('modal-open');
        }
        
        if (data && data.rent) {
            const rentContainer = $('#qa_price_tag_container_rent');
            if (rentContainer.length && data.rent.priceLabel && data.rent.priceLabelTranslated) {
                rentContainer.show();
                rentContainer.attr('data-evaluation-id', data.rent.priceLabel.toLocaleLowerCase());
                rentContainer.find('.price_compared_value').attr('data-id', data.rent.priceLabel.toLocaleLowerCase());
                rentContainer.find('.price_compared_value').text(data.rent.priceLabelTranslated);
            }
            rentContainer.off('click').on('click', function() {
                const salePrice = parseFloat($('#OP-1-primary').text().replace(/[^\d]/g, '')) || null;
                const rentPrice = parseFloat($('#OP-2-primary').text().replace(/[^\d]/g, '')) || null;
                if (typeof window.updateSmartPriceScale === 'function') {
                    window.updateSmartPriceScale(data, salePrice, rentPrice);
                }
                if (typeof window.setInitSmartRangeTab === 'function') {
                    window.setInitSmartRangeTab('rent');
                }
                $('#smart_price_scale_modal').show();
                $('body').addClass('modal-open');
            });
        }else {
            $('#qa_price_tag_container_rent').hide();
            $('body').removeClass('modal-open');
        }
    }

    function updatePriceEvaluationTags() {
        const propertyId = 8002445;
        const cookieKey = 'qa_price_evaluation_' + propertyId;
                
        const cachedData = getCookie(cookieKey);
        if (cachedData && isCookieValid(cachedData)) {
            const dataToUse = cachedData.data || cachedData;
            if (dataToUse && (dataToUse.sale || dataToUse.rent)) {
                updateTagsFromData(dataToUse);
                const salePrice = parseFloat($('#OP-1-primary').text().replace(/[^\d]/g, '')) || null;
                const rentPrice = parseFloat($('#OP-2-primary').text().replace(/[^\d]/g, '')) || null;
                if (typeof window.updateSmartPriceScale === 'function') {
                    window.updateSmartPriceScale(dataToUse, salePrice, rentPrice);
                }
            }
            return;
        }
        
        var url = "/portals/quintoandar/api3/properties/" + propertyId + "/pricing-report/";
        $.ajax({
            url: url,
            method: 'GET',
            headers: {
                'Content-Type': 'application/json'
            }
        })
            .done(function(result) {
                if (result && (result.sale || result.rent)) {
                    setCookie(cookieKey, {
                        data: result,
                        expiry: new Date().getTime() + (24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)
                    }, 24);
                    updateTagsFromData(result);
                    const salePrice = parseFloat($('#OP-1-primary').text().replace(/[^\d]/g, '')) || null;
                    const rentPrice = parseFloat($('#OP-2-primary').text().replace(/[^\d]/g, '')) || null;
                    if (typeof window.updateSmartPriceScale === 'function') {
                        window.updateSmartPriceScale(result, salePrice, rentPrice);
                    }
                }
            })
            .fail(function(xhr, status, error) {
                console.error('Error fetching pricing report:', error);
                $('#qa_price_tag_container_sale').hide();
                $('#qa_price_tag_container_rent').hide();
            });
    }

    $(document).ready(function() {
        if (showQuintoAndarPriceTag) {
            updatePriceEvaluationTags();
        }
    });
}

let setCurrencyIfNeeded = true;
function initPricePerM2Editable() {
    $('#price_per_m2').editable(function(value, settings) {
        var normalized = normalizePriceNumber(value);
        var normalizedOriginal = $(this).data('original-normalized-value') || '';
        $(this).closest('.data_field_subbox').css('gap', '8px');
        $('#price_per_m2_currency_selector .currency-dropdown__btn').removeClass('edition_mode');

        const currencySelector = $(`#price_per_m2_currency_selector`);
        const fieldCurrencySelected = $(`#price_per_m2_currency_selector .currency-selected`).attr('data-currency-code');
        const fieldCurrencyBtn = $(`#price_per_m2_currency_selector .currency-dropdown__btn`);
        const persistedCurrency = currencySelector.attr('data-selected-currency');


        if (normalized === normalizedOriginal && fieldCurrencySelected === persistedCurrency) {
            var originalValue = normalizedOriginal ? parseFloat(normalizedOriginal) : 0;
            return originalValue.toLocaleString('es-AR');
        }

        const payload = {
            value: normalized ? parseFloat(normalized) : 0,
            currency: fieldCurrencySelected
        };

        if (!value || value.trim() === '') {
            save('price_per_m2', JSON.stringify(payload));
            return 0;
        }
        
        var numericValue = parseFloat(normalized);

        $(this).closest('.data_field_subbox.editFieldContainer').toggleClass('is_empty', isNaN(numericValue) || numericValue === 0);

        if (isNaN(numericValue)) {
            save('price_per_m2', JSON.stringify(payload));
            return 0;
        }

        const empty_currency_to_show = 'None' == 'None';

        save('price_per_m2', JSON.stringify(payload));
        currencySelector.attr('data-selected-currency', payload.currency)

        return numericValue.toLocaleString('es-AR');
    }, {
        tooltip   : 'Hacé click para editar',
        placeholder   : 'Editar...',
        data: function(value, settings) {
            var normalized = normalizePriceNumber(value);
            $(this).data('original-normalized-value', normalized);
            $('#price_per_m2_currency_selector .currency-dropdown__btn').addClass('edition_mode');

            return normalized;
        },
        onsubmit: function(settings, original) {
            var $input = $(this).find('input');
            if ($input.length === 0) return true;
            
            var normalizedNew = normalizePriceNumber($input.val());
            var normalizedOriginal = $(original).data('original-normalized-value') || '';
            
            if (normalizedNew === normalizedOriginal) {
                var originalValue = normalizedOriginal ? parseFloat(normalizedOriginal) : 0;
                return originalValue.toLocaleString('es-AR');
            }
            
            return true;
        },
        onblur : 'ignore',
        onedit : function(settings, original) {
            var $host = $(this);
            var max = $host.data('maxlength');

            $host.closest('.data_field_subbox').css('gap', '0')

            setTimeout(function() {
                var $input = $host.find('input[name=value]');
                $input.attr('maxlength', '12');
                if (max) {
                    $input.attr('maxlength', max);
                }
                
                $input.on('input keyup', function(e) {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.keyCode === 13) return;
                    var cleanValue = $(this).val().replace(/[^0-9.,]/g, '');
                    if ($(this).val() !== cleanValue) {
                        $(this).val(cleanValue);
                    }
                });
                
                var tabHandler = setupEditableTabHandler('price_per_m2');
                tabHandler.call($host[0], settings, original);
            }, 0);
            $(document).off(`click.price_per_m2_value`).on(`click.price_per_m2_value`, function (e) {
                    var $form = $host.find('form');
                    if (!$form.length) return;
                    
                    var $fieldBox = $host.closest('.data_field_subbox');
                    var $parentBox = $host.closest('.new_box_field_data');  

                    var inField = $fieldBox.is(e.target) || $fieldBox.has(e.target).length > 0;
                    var inParent = $parentBox.is(e.target) || $parentBox.has(e.target).length > 0;
                    
                    if (!inField && !inParent) {
                    setTimeout(function () { $form.trigger('submit'); }, 0);
                    }
            });
        }
    });}
