function updatePromotionalCurrencyAvailability() {
    const container = document.getElementById('promotional_currency_selector');
    if (!container) return;
    
    const btn = container.querySelector('.currency-dropdown__btn');
  const menu = container.querySelector('.currency-dropdown__menu');
  
  const primaryCode = container.getAttribute('data-primary-code');
  const secondaryCode = container.getAttribute('data-secondary-code');
  
  const primaryItem = container.querySelector('.currency-dropdown__item[data-currency-code="' + primaryCode + '"]');
  const secondaryItem = container.querySelector('.currency-dropdown__item[data-currency-code="' + secondaryCode + '"]');
  
  var primaryPrice = $('#OP-1-primary').text().trim().replace(/\./g,'').replace(/,/g,'').replace(/ /g, '');
  var secondaryPrice = $('#OP-1-secondary').text().trim().replace(/\./g,'').replace(/,/g,'').replace(/ /g, '');

  var p = parseInt(primaryPrice);
  var s = parseInt(secondaryPrice);
  var hasPrimary = !isNaN(p) && p > 0;
  var hasSecondary = !isNaN(s) && s > 0;
  
  if (primaryItem) primaryItem.classList.toggle('is-hidden', !hasPrimary);
  if (secondaryItem) secondaryItem.classList.toggle('is-hidden', !hasSecondary);

  if (hasPrimary && hasSecondary) {
    if (btn) btn.classList.remove('is-disabled');
    return;
    }
  if ((hasPrimary && !hasSecondary) || (!hasPrimary && hasSecondary)) {
    if (btn) btn.classList.add('is-disabled');
    if (menu) menu.style.display = 'none';

    const onlyCode = hasPrimary ? primaryCode : secondaryCode;
    setPromotionalCurrencyUI(container, onlyCode);
    return;
  }

  if (btn) btn.classList.add('is-disabled');
  if (menu) menu.style.display = 'none';
}

function updatePromotionalPriceVisibility() {
    var primaryPrice = $('#OP-1-primary').text().trim().replace(/\./g,'').replace(/,/g,'').replace(/ /g, '');
    var secondaryPrice = $('#OP-1-secondary').text().trim().replace(/\./g,'').replace(/,/g,'').replace(/ /g, '');
    var primaryPriceNumber = parseInt(primaryPrice);
    var secondaryPriceNumber = parseInt(secondaryPrice);
    var hasPrimaryPrice = !isNaN(primaryPriceNumber) && primaryPriceNumber > 0;
    var hasSecondaryPrice = !isNaN(secondaryPriceNumber) && secondaryPriceNumber > 0;
    
    var shouldShow = hasPrimaryPrice || hasSecondaryPrice;

    $('#promotional_price').toggleClass('editFieldContainer', shouldShow);

    if (shouldShow) {
        $('#li_buyer_commision').show();
    } else {
        $('#li_buyer_commision').hide();
        var currentPromotionalPrice = $('#promotional_price').text().trim();
        if (currentPromotionalPrice && currentPromotionalPrice !== '---' && currentPromotionalPrice !== '') {
            $('#promotional_price').text('---'); 
        }
    }

    if (typeof updatePromotionalCurrencyAvailability === 'function') {
        updatePromotionalCurrencyAvailability();
    }
}

function togglePromotionalCurrencyDropdown(btn, event) {
  if (event) { event.preventDefault(); event.stopPropagation(); }

  const container = btn.closest('.currency-dropdown');
  if (!container || btn.classList.contains('is-disabled')) return;

  const menu = container.querySelector('.currency-dropdown__menu');
  if (!menu) return;

  const isOpen = menu.style.display === 'block';
  menu.style.display = isOpen ? 'none' : 'block';
}

function canChangePromotionalCurrency() {
  const editionMode = true
  if (!hasPromotionalPrice(editionMode)) return false;

  const primaryPrice = normalizeValue($('#OP-1-primary').text().trim());
  const secondaryPrice = normalizeValue($('#OP-1-secondary').text().trim());
  const p = parseInt(primaryPrice);
  const s = parseInt(secondaryPrice);
  const hasPrimary = !isNaN(p) && p > 0;
  const hasSecondary = !isNaN(s) && s > 0;

  return hasPrimary && hasSecondary;
}

function selectPromotionalCurrency(item, event) {
  if (event) { event.preventDefault(); event.stopPropagation(); }

  if (!canChangePromotionalCurrency()) return;

  const container = item.closest('.currency-dropdown');
  const code = item.getAttribute('data-currency-code');
  if (!container || !code) return;

  setPromotionalCurrencyUI(container, code);
  container.querySelector('.currency-dropdown__menu').style.display = 'none';
}

function setPromotionalCurrencyUI(container, currencyCode) {
  const btn = container.querySelector('.currency-dropdown__btn');
  const label = container.querySelector('.currency-dropdown__label');
  const flag = container.querySelector('.currency-dropdown__btn .currency-dropdown__flag');

  if (label) label.textContent = currencyCode;

  const item = container.querySelector('.currency-dropdown__item[data-currency-code="' + currencyCode + '"]');
  const itemImg = item ? item.querySelector('img') : null;

  if (flag && itemImg) {
    flag.src = itemImg.getAttribute('src');
    flag.alt = currencyCode + ' flag';
  }

  container.querySelectorAll('.currency-dropdown__item').forEach(function (el) {
    var isSelected = el.getAttribute('data-currency-code') === currencyCode;
    el.classList.toggle('currency-selected', isSelected);
  });

  if (btn && !btn.getAttribute('data-selected-code')) {
    btn.setAttribute('data-selected-code', currencyCode);
  }
}

    $('#rent_requirements_multiselect_container').toggleClass('is_empty', !selectedText);

document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
    var $menu = $('#rent_requirements_dropdown_menu');
    if (!$menu.is(':visible')) {
        if (e.key === 'Tab' || e.keyCode === 9) {
            $menu.hide();
            $('.rent_requirement_checkbox_item').removeClass('focused');
            currentRentRequirementIndex = -1;
        }
        return;
    }
    
    var $items = $menu.find('.rent_requirement_checkbox_item');
    var key = e.key || e.keyCode;
    
    if (key === 'ArrowDown' || key === 'Down' || key === 40) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        currentRentRequirementIndex = currentRentRequirementIndex < 0 ? 0 : (currentRentRequirementIndex + 1) % $items.length;
        $items.removeClass('focused').eq(currentRentRequirementIndex).addClass('focused').get(0).scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
        return false;
    }
    
    if (key === 'ArrowUp' || key === 'Up' || key === 38) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        currentRentRequirementIndex = currentRentRequirementIndex < 0 ? $items.length - 1 : (currentRentRequirementIndex - 1 + $items.length) % $items.length;
        $items.removeClass('focused').eq(currentRentRequirementIndex).addClass('focused').get(0).scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
        return false;
    }
    
    if (key === 'Enter' || key === 13) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        if (currentRentRequirementIndex >= 0) {
            var optionId = $items.eq(currentRentRequirementIndex).find('input').data('option-id');
            toggleRentRequirementCheckbox(optionId);
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    if (key === 'Tab' || key === 9) {
        $menu.hide();
        $('.rent_requirement_checkbox_item').removeClass('focused');
        currentRentRequirementIndex = -1;
    }
}, true);

</script>

<script>
    if(has_quintoandar_access){
        const publicationQualityBanner = $('#publication_quality_banner');
        publicationQualityBanner.show();
    
        function updateQualityBanner(qualityLabel, qualityPercentage) {
            const container = document.querySelector('#publication_quality_banner');
            if (!container) return;
    
            container.setAttribute('bar-label', qualityLabel);
            container.setAttribute('bar-percentage', qualityPercentage);
    
            const publicationContainer = container.querySelector('.qa_publication_quality_container');
            if (publicationContainer) {
                publicationContainer.setAttribute('bar-label', qualityLabel);
                publicationContainer.setAttribute('bar-percentage', qualityPercentage);
            }
    
            const labelElement = container.querySelector('.quality-label');
            if (labelElement) {
                labelElement.textContent = qualityLabel;
            }
    
            if (typeof applyBarFillColor === 'function') {
                applyBarFillColor(qualityPercentage, container);
            }
        }
    
        function fetchCompletenessScore(forceRefresh) {
            const propertyId = 8002445;
            const cookieKey = 'quintoandar_completeness_score_' + propertyId;
            
            if (forceRefresh) {
                deleteCookie(cookieKey);
            } else {
                const cachedData = getCookie(cookieKey);
                if (cachedData && cachedData.score !== undefined && cachedData.qualityTranslated) {
                    const qualityLabel = cachedData.qualityTranslated;
                    const qualityPercentage = typeof cachedData.score === 'number' ? cachedData.score : parseFloat(String(cachedData.score)) || 0;
                    updateQualityBanner(qualityLabel, qualityPercentage);
                    return;
                }
            }
            
            const url = '/portals/quintoandar/api3/properties/' + propertyId + '/completeness-score';
    
            fetch(url, {
                method: 'GET',
                credentials: 'include',
                headers: {
                    'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                }
            })
                .then(function(response) {
                    if (!response.ok) {
                        if (response.status === 404) {
                            return response.json().then(function(errorData) {
                                if (errorData && errorData.message && errorData.message.toLowerCase().includes('publication not found')) {
                                    const naData = { score: 0, qualityTranslated: 'No disponible', quality: 'N/A' };
                                    setCookie(cookieKey, naData, 24);
                                    updateQualityBanner('No disponible', 0);
                                    return;
                                }
                                throw new Error('HTTP error! status: ' + response.status);
                            }).catch(function() {
                                updateQualityBanner('No disponible', 0);
                            });
                        }
                        throw new Error('HTTP error! status: ' + response.status);
                    }
                    return response.json();
                })
                .then(function(data) {
                    if (data && data.score !== undefined && data.qualityTranslated) {
                        setCookie(cookieKey, data, 24);
                        const qualityLabel = data.qualityTranslated;
                        const qualityPercentage = typeof data.score === 'number' ? data.score : parseFloat(String(data.score)) || 0;
                        updateQualityBanner(qualityLabel, qualityPercentage);
                    } else {
                        const naData = { score: 0, qualityTranslated: 'No disponible', quality: 'N/A' };
                        setCookie(cookieKey, naData, 24);
                        updateQualityBanner('No disponible', 0);
                    }
                })
                .catch(function(error) {
                    console.error('Error fetching completeness score:', error);
                    updateQualityBanner('No disponible', 0);
                });
        }
    
        function initCompletenessScore() {
            const banner = document.querySelector('#publication_quality_banner');
            if (banner) {
                fetchCompletenessScore();
            } else {
                setTimeout(initCompletenessScore, 100);
            }
        }
        
        $(document).ready(function() {
            initCompletenessScore();
        });
    }
</script>

<script>
const DATE_ATTRIBUTES = {};

function detectAvailableDateAttributes() {
    const exclusiveStartContainer = document.getElementById('exclusive_start_date_container');
    const confidencialityStartContainer = document.getElementById('confidenciality_start_date_container');
    
    if (exclusiveStartContainer) {
        DATE_ATTRIBUTES.exclusive = {
            start_date: 'exclusive_start_date',
            days: 'exclusive_days',
            end_date: 'exclusive_end_date'
        };
        makeDaysEditable('exclusive');
    }
    
    if (confidencialityStartContainer) {
        DATE_ATTRIBUTES.confidenciality = {
            start_date: 'confidenciality_start_date',
            days: 'confidenciality_days',
            end_date: 'confidenciality_end_date'
        };
        makeDaysEditable('confidenciality');
    }
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', detectAvailableDateAttributes);

function handleDateFieldChange(attrType, fieldType, value) {
    if (!DATE_ATTRIBUTES[attrType]) {
        return;
    }
    
    const config = DATE_ATTRIBUTES[attrType];
    let isValid = false;
    let oldValue = '';
    
    if (fieldType === 'start_date') {
        oldValue = document.getElementById(config.start_date ).getAttribute('data-original-value') || '';
        isValid = validateDate(value);
    } else if (fieldType === 'days') {
        oldValue = document.getElementById(config.days ).getAttribute('data-original-value') || '';
        isValid = validateDays(value);
    }
    
    if (!isValid) {
        const input = document.getElementById(fieldType === 'start_date' ? config.start_date  : config.days );
        input.value = oldValue;
        input.style.borderColor = 'var(--rojo-tokko)';
        
        const endDateSpan = document.getElementById(config.end_date );
        if (endDateSpan) {
            endDateSpan.textContent = '--/--/----';
        }
        return;
    }
    
    const input = document.getElementById(fieldType === 'start_date' ? config.start_date  : config.days );
    input.style.borderColor = '';

    if (fieldType === 'start_date') {
        save(config.start_date, value);
        document.getElementById(config.start_date ).setAttribute('data-original-value', value);
    } else if (fieldType === 'days') {
        save(config.days, value);
        document.getElementById(config.days ).setAttribute('data-original-value', value);
    }
    
    let startDate;
    const startDateInput = document.getElementById(config.start_date );
    if (startDateInput && startDateInput.tagName === 'INPUT') {
        startDate = startDateInput.value;
    } else {
        const startDateSpan = document.getElementById(config.start_date + '_container');
        if (startDateSpan) {
            const spanText = startDateSpan.textContent.trim();
            if (spanText && spanText !== '--/--/----') {
                const parts = spanText.split('/');
                if (parts.length === 3) {
                    startDate = parts[2] + '-' + parts[1] + '-' + parts[0];
                }
            }
        }
    }
    let days;
    const daysInput = document.getElementById(config.days);
    if (daysInput && daysInput.tagName === 'INPUT') {
        days = daysInput.value;
    } else {
        const daysSpan = document.getElementById(config.days);
        if (daysSpan) {
            const spanText = daysSpan.textContent.trim();
            if (spanText && spanText !== '--') {
                days = spanText;
            }
        }
    }
    
    if (startDate && startDate.trim() !== '' && days && days.trim() !== '' && validateDate(startDate) && validateDays(days)) {
        handleDateCalculation(attrType, startDate, days);
    } else {
        const endDateSpan = document.getElementById(config.end_date);
        if (endDateSpan) {
            endDateSpan.textContent = '--/--/----';
        }
    }
}

    function handleInputDateKeyPress(event, attrType, fieldType, inputElement) {
        if (event.keyCode === 13) {
            event.preventDefault();            
            inputElement.blur();
        }
    }

    function makeDaysEditable(attrType) {
        const config = DATE_ATTRIBUTES[attrType];
        if (!config) return;
        
        const daysId = config.days;
        const daysElement = document.getElementById(daysId);
        if (!daysElement) return;
        
        $('#' + daysId).editable(function(value, settings) {
            const cleanValue = value ? value.trim() : '';           
            save(config.days, cleanValue);

            const startDateSpan = document.getElementById(config.start_date + '_container');
            const startDate = startDateSpan ? startDateSpan.textContent.trim() : '';
            if (startDate && startDate !== '--/--/----' && cleanValue) {
                const parts = startDate.split('/');
                if (parts.length === 3) {
                    const formattedStartDate = parts[2] + '-' + parts[1] + '-' + parts[0];
                    handleDateCalculation(attrType, formattedStartDate, cleanValue);
                }
            }
            
            return cleanValue;
        }, {
            event: 'edit',
            tooltip: 'Hacé click para editar',
            select: true,
            placeholder: 'Editar...',
            onblur: 'submit',
            onedit: function(settings, original) {
                var tabHandler = setupEditableTabHandler(daysId);
                tabHandler.call(this, settings, original);
                
                setTimeout(() => {
                    var input = $(this).find('input[name=value]');
                    input.attr('maxlength', '3');
                    
                    input.on('input keyup', function(e) {
                        if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.keyCode === 13) return;
                        var cleanValue = $(this).val().replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');
                        if ($(this).val() !== cleanValue) {
                            $(this).val(cleanValue);
                        }
                    });
                }, 0);
            }
        });
        
        $('#' + daysId).click(function() {
            
            $("#" + this.id).trigger('edit');
        });
    }

    function toggleDateEditable(attrType) {
        const config = DATE_ATTRIBUTES[attrType];
        if (!config) return;
        
        const container = document.getElementById(config.start_date + '_container');
        if (!container) return;
        
        const isEditable = container.classList.contains('editable-mode');
        
        if (isEditable) {
            switchDateToReadOnly(container, attrType);
        } else {
            switchDateToEditable(container, attrType);
        }
    }

    function switchDateToEditable(container, attrType) {
        const config = DATE_ATTRIBUTES[attrType];
        const span = container.querySelector('.readonly-value');
        const currentValue = span ? span.textContent : '';
        
        const input = document.createElement('input');
        input.type = 'date';
        input.id = config.start_date;
        input.name = config.start_date;
        
        if (currentValue && currentValue !== '--/--/----') {
            const parts = currentValue.split('/');
            if (parts.length === 3) {
                input.value = parts[2] + '-' + parts[1] + '-' + parts[0];
            }
        }
        
        input.setAttribute('data-original-value', input.value);
                input.oninput = function() { validateDateInput(this); };
                input.onblur = function() {
                    const value = this.value;
                    handleDateFieldChange(attrType, 'start_date', value);
                    switchDateToReadOnly(container, attrType);
                };
        input.onkeypress = function(event) {
            if (event.keyCode === 13) {
                event.preventDefault();
                this.blur();
            }
        };
        
        input.onkeydown = function(event) {
            var isTab = event.key === 'Tab' || event.keyCode === 9;
            if (isTab) {
                event.preventDefault();
                this.blur();
                
                setTimeout(function() {
                    var fields = indexEditableFields();
                    var containerId = container.id;
                    var currentIndex = fields.indexOf(document.getElementById(containerId));
                    if (currentIndex >= 0) {
                        var nextIndex = event.shiftKey ? (currentIndex - 1 + fields.length) % fields.length
                                                       : (currentIndex + 1) % fields.length;
                        var next = fields[nextIndex];
                        if (next) {
                            focusField(next, { click: true });
                        }
                    }
                }, 50);
            }
        };
        
        container.innerHTML = '';
        container.appendChild(input);
        container.classList.add('editable-mode');
        input.focus();
    }

    function switchDateToReadOnly(container, attrType) {
        const config = DATE_ATTRIBUTES[attrType];
        const input = container.querySelector('input');
        const value = input ? input.value : '';
        
        const span = document.createElement('span');
        span.className = 'readonly-value new_box_field_data';
        span.onclick = function() { toggleDateEditable(attrType); };
        span.style.cursor = 'pointer';
        span.title = 'Hacé click para editar';
        
        if (value) {
            const parts = value.split('-');
            if (parts.length === 3) {
                const year = parts[0];
                const month = parts[1];
                const day = parts[2];
                span.textContent = day + '/' + month + '/' + year;
            } else {
                span.textContent = '--/--/----';
            }
        } else {
            span.textContent = '--/--/----';
        }
        
        container.innerHTML = '';
        container.appendChild(span);
        container.classList.remove('editable-mode');
    }
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', detectAvailableDateAttributes);


</script>

<script>

  // Event click to focus editable fields inside attr_field
  $('.attr_field').on('click', function(e) {
    
    
    $(this).addClass('attr_editing');
    const editableElement = $(this).find('[id^="basic_"]').first();
    const ageTypeSelector = $(this).find('#age_type_selector');
    
    if (editableElement.length > 0 && 
        !$(e.target).closest('[id^="basic_"]').length &&
        !$(e.target).closest('#renovation-year-dropdown, #construction-year-dropdown').length &&
        !$(e.target).closest('#age_type_selector').length &&
        !editableElement.hasClass('editing')) {
      
        if (editableElement.attr('id') === 'basic_age' && !$('#basic_age').is(':visible') && ageTypeSelector.length > 0) {
          ageTypeSelector.trigger('click');
        } else {
          editableElement.trigger('click');
      }
    }
  });

function measurement_selection() {
    var measure = document.getElementById("surface_measure_select").value;
    apply_surface_measure(measure);
}

var editingStarted = false;
var keydownListenerAdded = false;

$(document).click(function(e) {
  var basicInfoBlock = document.getElementById('basic_info');
  if (basicInfoBlock && !basicInfoBlock.contains(e.target)) {
    editingStarted = false;
    keydownListenerAdded = false;
  }
  
  if (e.target.matches('.attribute_basic_surface')) {
    
    editingStarted = true; 

  if (!keydownListenerAdded) {
    keydownListenerAdded = true;
  }

  document.querySelectorAll('.attribute_basic_surface').forEach(function(el) {
    el.classList.remove('focused');
  });

  e.target.classList.add('focused');
  }
});


function initSurfaceField() {
    const surfaceField = $('#basic_surface');
    const maxlen = 12; 
    surfaceField.editable(function(value, settings) {
        let to_send = value.trim().replace(/\s+/g, '').replace(',', '.');
        to_send = to_send === '' || isNaN(to_send) ? 0 : parseFloat(to_send);
        
        if ($('#measurement_display').data('value') == 'HA') {
            to_send = to_send * 10000;
        }
        
        let normalizedOriginal = $(this).data('original-normalized-value');
        if (normalizedOriginal !== undefined) {
            let originalNum = parseFloat(normalizedOriginal) || 0;
            if ($('#measurement_display').data('value') == 'HA') {
                originalNum = originalNum * 10000;
            }
            if (to_send === originalNum) {
                return value;
            }
        }
        hideEmptyFieldOnCollapse(this, to_send);
        save('surface', to_send);
                if (typeof needUpdateQACompScore === 'function') {
            needUpdateQACompScore();
        }
        $("#measurement_display").show();
        $("#surface_measure_select").hide();
        
        return value;
    }, {
        data: function(value, settings) {
            let normalized = value.trim().replace(/\s+/g, '').replace(',', '.');
            normalized = normalized === '' || isNaN(normalized) ? '0' : parseFloat(normalized).toString();
            $(this).data('original-normalized-value', normalized);
            return value;
        },
        event: 'edit',
        tooltip: 'Hacé click para editar',
        placeholder: 'Editar...',
        select: true,
        onblur: 'ignore',
        onsubmit: function(settings, original) {
            var $input = $(this).find('input');
            if ($input.length > 0) {
                var normalizedNew = $input.val().trim();
                if (normalizedNew === '' || isNaN(normalizedNew)) {
                    normalizedNew = '0';
                }
                var normalizedOriginal = $(original).data('original-normalized-value') || '';
                
                if (normalizedNew === normalizedOriginal) {
                    $(document).off('mousedown.surface_field');
                    $("#measurement_display").show();
                    $("#surface_measure_select").hide();
                    $("#save_surface_btn").hide();
                    $(this).closest('.new_box_field').removeClass('attr_editing');
                    surfaceField.removeClass('focused');
                    return $input.val();
                }
            }
            
            $(document).off('mousedown.surface_field');
            
            $("#measurement_display").show();
            $("#surface_measure_select").hide();
            $("#save_surface_btn").hide();
            $(this).closest('.new_box_field').removeClass('attr_editing');
            surfaceField.removeClass('focused');
            return true;
        },
        onedit: function(settings, original) {
            var max = $(this).data('maxlength');
            const $host = $(this); 
            $("#measurement_display").hide();
            $("#surface_measure_select").show();

            $(document).off('mousedown.surface_field').on('mousedown.surface_field', function(e) {
                const $form = $host.find('form');
                if (!$form.length) return;

                const $container = $('#basic_surface').closest('.new_box_field_data');
                const $select = $('#surface_measure_select');

                const clickDentroCampo  = $container.is(e.target) || $container.has(e.target).length > 0;
                const clickDentroSelect = $select.is(e.target)     || $select.has(e.target).length > 0;

                if (!clickDentroCampo && !clickDentroSelect) {
                setTimeout(() => { 
                    $form.trigger('submit');  
                }, 0); 
                }
            });
            setTimeout(() => {
                const $input = $host.find('input[name=value]'); 
                const max = $host.data('maxlength');
                if (max) $input.attr('maxlength', max);
                if ($input.length) {
                    $input.focus();
                }

                var $select = $('#surface_measure_select');
                $select.off('focus.surface blur.surface keydown.surface').on('focus.surface', function() {
                    $(this).addClass('focused');
                }).on('blur.surface', function() {
                    $(this).removeClass('focused');
                });
                setupCircularSelectNavigation($select);
                $select.on('keydown.surface', function(e) {
                    if (e.key === 'Tab' || e.keyCode === 9) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        var $form = $host.find('form');
                        if ($form.length) {
                            $form.trigger('submit');
                        }
                        var fields = indexEditableFields();
                        var currentIndex = fields.indexOf(document.getElementById('basic_surface'));
                        if (currentIndex >= 0) {
                            var nextIndex = e.shiftKey ? (currentIndex - 1 + fields.length) % fields.length
                                                       : (currentIndex + 1) % fields.length;
                            var next = fields[nextIndex];
                            if (next) {
                                setTimeout(function() {
                                    focusField(next, { click: true });
                                }, e.shiftKey ? 150 : 100);
                            }
                        }
                        return false;
                    }
                });

                $input.on('keydown', (e) => {
                const isEnter = e.key === 'Enter' || e.keyCode === 13;
                const isTab   = e.key === 'Tab'   || e.keyCode === 9;

                if (isTab && !e.shiftKey) {
                    var $select = $('#surface_measure_select');
                    if ($select.is(':visible')) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        $select.focus();
                        $select.addClass('focused');
                        return false;
                    }
                }

                if (isEnter || isTab) {
                    e.preventDefault(); 
                    const $form = $host.find('form');
                    if ($form.length) {
                    $form.trigger('submit');

                    if (isTab) {
                        setTimeout(() => {
                        var fields = indexEditableFields();
                        var currentIndex = fields.indexOf(document.getElementById('basic_surface'));
                        if (currentIndex >= 0) {
                            var nextIndex = e.shiftKey ? (currentIndex - 1 + fields.length) % fields.length
                                                       : (currentIndex + 1) % fields.length;
                            var next = fields[nextIndex];
                            if (next) {
                                focusField(next, { click: true });
                            }
                        }
                        }, 50);
                    }
                    }
                    }
                });

                $input.on('input', function() {
                const clean = $(this).val().replace(/[^0-9.,]/g, '');
                if ($(this).val() !== clean) $(this).val(clean);
                });
            }, 0);
        }
    });
}
$('#basic_surface').click(function() {
    
    $("#" + this.id).trigger('edit');
});
initSurfaceField();

function apply_surface_measure(me) {
  const $host = $('#basic_surface');
  const $input = $host.find('input[name=value]');
  const previous = $('#measurement_display').data('value');

  function normToNumber(s) {
    const t = (s || '').toString().trim();
    if (!t) return 0;
    const cleaned = t.replace(/\s+/g, '').replace(/\./g, '').replace(',', '.');
    const n = parseFloat(cleaned);
    return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 0;
  }

  function cleanDecimals(number, decimals) {
    let formatted = number.toFixed(decimals);
    return formatted.replace(/(\.\d*?[1-9])0+$/, '$1').replace(/\.0+$/, '');
  }

  const currentStr = $input.length ? $input.val() : $host.text();
  let valueNum = normToNumber(currentStr);

function generateYearOptions(yearsBack=100) {
    var currentYear = new Date().getFullYear();
    var years = [];
    for (var i = currentYear; i >= currentYear - yearsBack; i--) {
        years.push(i);
    }
    return years;
}

var renovationYears = generateYearOptions(50);
var constructionYears = generateYearOptions(100);
var selectedIndex = -1;
var keyboardSelection = false;

function createYearSelector(config) {
    var $field = $(config.fieldSelector);
    var searchInputId = config.searchInputId;
    var dropdownId = config.dropdownId;
    var years = config.years;
    var saveField = config.saveField;
    var onSave = config.onSave || function(value) { save(saveField, value); };
    var onHide = config.onHide || function() {};
    var needsDestroy = config.needsDestroy || false;
    var minYears = config.minYears || 50;
    
    if (needsDestroy && $field.hasClass('editable')) {
        $field.editable('destroy');
    }
    
    $field.off('click');
    $field.hide();
    
    if ($('#' + searchInputId).length === 0) {
        var searchInputHtml = '<input type="text" maxlength="4" pattern="[0-9]*" id="' + searchInputId + '">';
        $field.after(searchInputHtml);
    }
    
    if ($('#' + dropdownId).length === 0) {
        var dropdownClass = dropdownId === 'construction-year-dropdown' ? ' class="year-dropdown"' : '';
        $field.after('<div id="' + dropdownId + '"' + dropdownClass + '></div>');
    }
    
    var $searchInput = $('#' + searchInputId);
    var $dropdown = $('#' + dropdownId);
    
    if (config.isConstructionYear) {
        $searchInput.val('2025');
    } else {
        $searchInput.val('');
    }
    $searchInput.show();

    $dropdown.off('mouseenter').on('mouseenter', function() {
        $(this).scrollTop(0);
    });
    
    setTimeout(function() {
        $searchInput.focus();
    }, 100);
    
    selectedIndex = -1;
    
    $searchInput.off('focus click keyup keypress input').on('focus', function() {
        showYearDropdownGeneric(searchInputId, dropdownId, years, config);
    }).on('click', function() {
        showYearDropdownGeneric(searchInputId, dropdownId, years, config);
    }).on('keypress', function(e) {
        var keyCode = e.which || e.keyCode;
        var currentValue = $(this).val();
        
        var allowedKeys = [8, 9, 13, 46];
        var isNumber = (keyCode >= 48 && keyCode <= 57);
        
        if (!isNumber && allowedKeys.indexOf(keyCode) === -1) {
            e.preventDefault();
            return false;
        }
        
        if (isNumber && currentValue.length >= 4) {
            e.preventDefault();
            return false;
        }
    }).on('input', function(e) {
        var value = $(this).val();
        
        var numericValue = value.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');
        
        if (numericValue.length > 4) {
            numericValue = numericValue.substring(0, 4);
        }
        
        if (value !== numericValue) {
            $(this).val(numericValue);
        }
    }).on('keyup', function(e) {
        if (e.keyCode === 38 || e.keyCode === 40) {
            return;
        }
        
        var searchTerm = $(this).val();
        if (searchTerm.length > 0) {
            filterYearDropdownGeneric(searchInputId, dropdownId, years, searchTerm, config);
        } else {
            populateYearDropdownGeneric(dropdownId, years, config);
        }
    });
    
    $searchInput.off('blur').on('blur', function(e) {
        // Only process real blur events (not programmatic)
        if (!e.originalEvent && !e.relatedTarget) {
            return false;
        }
        setTimeout(function() {
            if (keyboardSelection || $(document.activeElement).closest('#' + dropdownId).length > 0) {
                keyboardSelection = false;
                return;
            }
            var entered = $('#' + searchInputId).val().trim();
            
            if ((!entered || entered === '') && saveField !== "last_renovation_year") {
                $('#' + searchInputId).hide();
                $('#' + dropdownId).hide();
                $field.show();
                onHide();
                return;
            }
            if (saveField === "last_renovation_year" && (!entered || entered === '')) {
                onSave("");
                $field.html(0).show()
                $($field).closest('.editFieldContainer').addClass('is_empty');
            }
            var currentYear = new Date().getFullYear();
            var minYear = currentYear - minYears;
            if (
                entered && 
                /^\d{4}$/.test(entered) && 
                entered <= currentYear && 
                entered >= minYear
            ) {
                if (config.isConstructionYear) {
                    var selectedAge = currentYear - entered;
                    onSave(selectedAge);
                    var yearText = selectedAge === 1 ? 'año' : 'años';
                    $field.html(entered + ' <span class="age-text">(' + selectedAge + ' ' + yearText + ')</span>').show();
                } else {
                    onSave(entered);
                    $field.html(entered).show();
                }
                $('#' + searchInputId).hide();
                $('#' + dropdownId).hide();
                $($field).closest('.editFieldContainer').removeClass('is_empty');
                onHide();
            } else {
                $('#' + searchInputId).hide();
                $('#' + dropdownId).hide();
                $field.show();
                onHide();
            }
        }, config.isConstructionYear ? 100 : 200);
    });

    $searchInput.off('keypress').on('keypress', function(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter') {
            e.preventDefault();
            return false;
        }
    });
    
    $(document).off('click.' + dropdownId).on('click.' + dropdownId, function(e) {
if (!$(e.target).closest('#' + searchInputId + ', #' + dropdownId).length) {
            $dropdown.hide();
        }
    });

    var isNavigating = false;
    
    $searchInput.off('keydown').on('keydown', function(e) {
        if (isNavigating) return;
        
        var $options = $('#' + dropdownId + ' .year-option');
        
        if (e.keyCode === 40) {
            e.preventDefault();
            isNavigating = true;
            
            selectedIndex++;
            if (selectedIndex >= $options.length) selectedIndex = 0;
            
            $options.removeAttr('style').removeClass('option-selected');
            var $currentOption = $options.eq(selectedIndex);
            $currentOption.addClass('option-selected');
            
            $currentOption[0].scrollIntoView({
                behavior: 'smooth',
                block: 'nearest'
            });
            
            setTimeout(function() { isNavigating = false; }, 50);
            
        } else if (e.keyCode === 38) {
            e.preventDefault();
            isNavigating = true;
            
            selectedIndex--;
            if (selectedIndex < 0) selectedIndex = $options.length - 1;
            
            $options.removeAttr('style').removeClass('option-selected');
            var $currentOption = $options.eq(selectedIndex);
            $currentOption.addClass('option-selected');
            
            $currentOption[0].scrollIntoView({
                behavior: 'smooth',
                block: 'nearest'
            });
            
            setTimeout(function() { isNavigating = false; }, 50);
            
        } else if (e.keyCode === 13) {
            e.preventDefault();
            if (selectedIndex >= 0 && selectedIndex < $options.length) {
                var $selectedOption = $options.eq(selectedIndex);
                var selectedYear = $selectedOption.data('year');
                
                keyboardSelection = true;
                
                if (config.isConstructionYear) {
                    var current = new Date().getFullYear();
                    var selectedAge = current - selectedYear;

                $('#' + config.dropdownId).hide();

function filterYearDropdownGeneric(searchInputId, dropdownId, years, searchTerm, config) {
    var filtered = years.filter(function(year) {

    if (filtered.length === 0) {

function handleCircularSelectNavigation(select, e) {
  if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.keyCode === 40) {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    var currentIndex = select.selectedIndex;
    var maxIndex = select.options.length - 1;
    if (currentIndex >= maxIndex) {
      select.selectedIndex = 0;
    } else {
      select.selectedIndex = currentIndex + 1;
    }
    $(select).data('arrowNav', true);
    $(select).trigger('change');
    return false;
  }
  
  if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.keyCode === 38) {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    var currentIndex = select.selectedIndex;
    var maxIndex = select.options.length - 1;
    if (currentIndex <= 0) {
      select.selectedIndex = maxIndex;
    } else {
      select.selectedIndex = currentIndex - 1;
    }
    $(select).data('arrowNav', true);
    $(select).trigger('change');
    return false;
  }
  
  return true;
}

function setupCircularSelectNavigation(selectElement) {
  selectElement.on('keydown', function(e) {
    return handleCircularSelectNavigation(this, e);
  });
}

function focusField(el, options) {
  options = options || {};
  var click = options.click || false;
  var shouldScroll = options.shouldScroll !== undefined ? options.shouldScroll : true;
  
  if (!el) return;
  
  clearFocus();
  el.classList.add('focused');
  
  var $el = $(el);
  var $tagsList = $el.closest('ul.new_tags_list');
  if (shouldScroll) {
    if ($tagsList.length && $el.hasClass('tags_checkbox')) {
      var $viewMoreBtn = $tagsList.siblings('[id^="viewmore_"]');
      if ($viewMoreBtn.length > 0 && $viewMoreBtn.is(':visible')) {
        $tagsList[0].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
      } else {
        el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
      }
    } else {
      el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
    }
  }
  
  var container = $(el).closest('.new_box_field');
  if (container.length) {
    container.addClass('attr_editing');
  }
  
  if (click) {
    $(el).trigger('click');
  }
}

function getFieldKind(el) {
  var $el = $(el);
  
  if ($el.hasClass('tags_checkbox') && $el.hasClass('editable-field')) return 'tag';
  if ($el.hasClass('new_attr_checkbox')) return 'attrCheckbox';
  if (el.id === 'unified_tags_search') return 'unifiedSearch';
  if ($el.hasClass('buttons-field')) return 'button';
  
  return 'editable';
}

function isButtonElement(el) {
  return el && ($(el).hasClass('buttons-field') || el.tagName === 'BUTTON');
}

function findPreviousValidField(fields, currentIndex) {
  var maxAttempts = fields.length;
  var attempts = 0;
  var prevIndex = (currentIndex - 1 + fields.length) % fields.length;
  var prev = fields[prevIndex];
  
  while (attempts < maxAttempts && isButtonElement(prev)) {
    prevIndex = (prevIndex - 1 + fields.length) % fields.length;
    prev = fields[prevIndex];
    attempts++;
  }
  
  return prev && !isButtonElement(prev) ? prev : null;
}

function navigateToField(field, options) {
  options = options || {};
  var click = options.click || false;
  var shouldNavigate = options.shouldNavigate !== undefined ? options.shouldNavigate : true;
  
  if (!field || !shouldNavigate) return;
  
  const kind = getFieldKind(field);
  
  if (kind === 'tag' || kind === 'attrCheckbox') {
    focusField(field);
  } else if (kind === 'unifiedSearch') {
    clearFocus();
    field.focus();
    field.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
  } else if (kind === 'button') {
    clearFocus();
    $(field).addClass('focused');
    field.focus();
    field.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
  } else {
    focusField(field, { click: click });
  }
}

function getCurrentFieldIndex(fields, current) {
  var currentIndex = fields.indexOf(current);
  if (currentIndex < 0) {
    currentIndex = fields.findIndex(function(f) {
      return f === current || f.id === current.id;
    });
  }
  return currentIndex < 0 ? 0 : currentIndex;
}

function indexEditableFields() {
  var fields = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(
    '.editable-field, .new_attr_checkbox'
  )).filter(function(el){ 
    var $el = $(el);
    if (!$el.is(':visible')) return false;
    if (el.id.includes('renovation-year') || el.id.includes('construction-year')) return false;
    if ($el.hasClass('currency-dropdown__btn') || $el.closest('.currency-dropdown__btn').length > 0) return false;
    
    var $collapsedContainer = $el.closest('.new_file_box_container.collapsed_file');
    if ($collapsedContainer.length > 0) {
      return false;
    }
    
    if ($el.hasClass('tags_checkbox')) {
      var $ul = $el.closest('ul.new_tags_list');
      if ($ul.length) {
        if (!$ul.hasClass('new_viewmore')) {
          var $allTags = $ul.find('li.tags_checkbox');
          const maxVisibleTags = getMaxVisibleItems();
          var tagIndex = $allTags.index($el);
          if (tagIndex >= maxVisibleTags) {
          return false;
        }
      }
    }
    }
    
    return true;
  });
  
  var buttonsFields = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(
    '.buttons-field'
  )).filter(function(el){ 
    var $el = $(el);
    if (!$el.is(':visible')) return false;
    var $collapsedContainer = $el.closest('.new_file_box_container.collapsed_file');
    if ($collapsedContainer.length > 0) {
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  });
  
  fields = fields.concat(buttonsFields);
  
  fields.sort(function(a, b) {
    var pos = a.compareDocumentPosition(b);
    if (pos & Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_FOLLOWING || pos & Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_CONTAINS) {
      return -1;
    }
    if (pos & Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_PRECEDING || pos & Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_CONTAINED_BY) {
      return 1;
    }
    return 0;
  });
  
  fields.forEach(function(el, i){ el.setAttribute('data-index', String(i)); });
  return fields;
}

function setupEditableTabHandler(fieldId) {
  return function(settings, original) {
    var $host = $(this);
    setTimeout(function() {
      var $input = $host.find('input[name=value]');
      if ($input.length) {
        $input.on('keydown', function(e) {
          var isEnter = e.key === 'Enter' || e.keyCode === 13;
          var isTab = e.key === 'Tab' || e.keyCode === 9;
          
          if (isEnter || isTab) {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            var $form = $host.find('form');
            if ($form.length) {
              var shiftKey = e.shiftKey;
              $form.trigger('submit');
              
              if (isTab) {
                setTimeout(function() {
                  var fields = indexEditableFields();
                  var currentElement = document.getElementById(fieldId);
                  if (!currentElement) return;
                  
                  var currentIndex = fields.indexOf(currentElement);
                  if (currentIndex >= 0) {
                    var nextIndex = shiftKey ? (currentIndex - 1 + fields.length) % fields.length
                                             : (currentIndex + 1) % fields.length;
                    var next = fields[nextIndex];
                    if (next && next !== currentElement) {
                      focusField(next, { click: true });
                    }
                  } else {
                    var nextIndex = shiftKey ? fields.length - 1 : 0;
                    var next = fields[nextIndex];
                    if (next) {
                      focusField(next, { click: true });
                    }
                  }
                }, 50);
              }
            }
          }
        });
      }
    }, 10);
  };
}

  var isActiveEditable = activeEl && ($(activeEl).hasClass('editable-field') || $(activeEl).hasClass('new_attr_checkbox'));
  var isActiveButton = activeEl && $(activeEl).hasClass('buttons-field');

      $textarea = $(activeElement);
    }
    if (!$textarea.length) {
      $textarea = $form.find('textarea');
    }
    
    var isTextareaActive = activeElement && activeElement.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' && 
                           ($(activeElement).closest($current).length > 0 || $(activeElement).closest('form').is($form));
    var isCancelBtnActive = activeElement === $cancelBtn[0];
    var isSubmitBtnActive = activeElement === $submitBtn[0];
    
    if (isTextareaActive && $textarea.length > 0) {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (e.shiftKey) {
        $textarea[0].blur();
        $cancelBtn[0].click();
        setTimeout(function() {
          var currentIndex = getCurrentFieldIndex(fields, current);
          var prev = findPreviousValidField(fields, currentIndex);
          navigateToField(prev, { click: true });
        }, 50);
      } else {
        $cancelBtn[0].focus();
      }
      return;
    }
    
    if (isCancelBtnActive) {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (e.shiftKey) {
        $textarea[0].focus();
        $textarea[0].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
      } else {
        $submitBtn[0].focus();
      }
      return;
    }
    
    if (isSubmitBtnActive) {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (e.shiftKey) {
        $cancelBtn[0].focus();
      } else {
        setTimeout(function() {
          var currentIndex = getCurrentFieldIndex(fields, current);
          var nextIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % fields.length;
          var next = fields[nextIndex];
          navigateToField(next, { click: true });
        }, 10);
      }
      return;
    }
  }
  
  if (e.shiftKey && !isTextareaWithButtons) {
    var currentIndex = getCurrentFieldIndex(fields, current);
    if (currentIndex >= 0) {
      var prevIndex = (currentIndex - 1 + fields.length) % fields.length;
      var prev = fields[prevIndex];
      if (prev) {
        var $prevForm = $(prev).find('form');
        var $prevSubmitBtn = $prevForm.find('button[type="submit"]');
        if ($prevForm.length && $prevForm.find('textarea').length && $prevSubmitBtn.length) {
          e.preventDefault();
          $prevSubmitBtn[0].focus();
          return;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  if (isEditableOpen || isDateEditable) {
    e.preventDefault();
    
    if (isDateEditable) {
      $dateInput[0].blur();
    } else {
      var $form = $current.find('form');
      if ($form.length) {
        $form.trigger('submit');
      } else {
        $editableInput.trigger('blur');
      }
    }
    
    setTimeout(function() {
      var currentIndex = getCurrentFieldIndex(fields, current);

      var nextIndex = e.shiftKey ? (currentIndex - 1 + fields.length) % fields.length
                                 : (currentIndex + 1) % fields.length;
      var next = fields[nextIndex];
      if (!next) return;

      var shouldNavigate = next !== current;
      navigateToField(next, { click: true, shouldNavigate: shouldNavigate });
    }, 50);
    return;
  }

  e.preventDefault();
  
  if (isActiveUnifiedSearch && activeEl) {
    activeEl.blur();
  }
  
  var currentIndex = getCurrentFieldIndex(fields, current);

  var isCurrentFocused = current && (current.classList.contains('focused') || document.activeElement === current);
  var isFirstTab = currentIndex === 0 && !hasActiveField && !isCurrentFocused && !e.shiftKey;

  var nextIndex;
  var next;
  if (isFirstTab) {
    nextIndex = 0;
    next = fields[0];
  } else {
    nextIndex = e.shiftKey ? (currentIndex - 1 + fields.length) % fields.length
                           : (currentIndex + 1) % fields.length;
    next = fields[nextIndex];
  }
  if (!next) return;

  var shouldNavigate = next !== current || isFirstTab;
  navigateToField(next, { click: true, shouldNavigate: shouldNavigate });
});

function unifiedFilterTags(value){
    var searchInput = $('#unified_tags_search');
    var clearBtn = $('#clear_search_btn');
    
    clearTimeout(window.filterTimeout);
    
    if (value.trim() === '') {
        searchInput.removeClass('filtering');
        clearBtn.hide();
        restoreAllContainers();
    } else {
        searchInput.addClass('filtering');
        clearBtn.show();
        window.filterTimeout = setTimeout(function() {
            filterAllContainers(value.trim());
        }, 300);
    }
}

function restoreAllContainers() {
  ['services', 'rooms', 'additionals'].forEach(item => {
    const liCount = $(`#${item}_tags_list > li`).length;
    const maxVisibleItems = getMaxVisibleItems();
    if (liCount > maxVisibleItems) {
        $(`#${item}_tags_list`).css('height', '141px')
    }
    $(`ul#${item}_tags_list > li`).show();
    $(`#${item}_tags_list`).removeClass('filtered new_viewmore')
    $(`#viewmore_${item}`).show();
    $(`#viewless_${item}`).hide();
    $(`#no_results_${item}`).remove();
  });
  
  checkViewMoreButtons();
}

function filterAllContainers(value) {
  const searchValue = value.toLowerCase();

  ['services', 'rooms', 'additionals'].forEach(item => {
    $(`ul#${item}_tags_list > li:not([name='li_filter_${item}'])`).hide();
    $(`ul#${item}_tags_list > li[name*='${searchValue}']`).show();
    $(`#${item}_tags_list`).addClass('filtered');
    adjustContainerHeight(`${item}_tags_list`);
  });

  showNoResultsMessage();
}

function showNoResultsMessage() {
  ['services', 'rooms', 'additionals'].forEach(item => {
    const visible = $(`ul#${item}_tags_list > li:visible:not([name='li_filter_${item}'])`).length;
    const $noResults = $(`#no_results_${item}`);

    if (visible === 0) {
      if ($noResults.length === 0) {
        $(`#${item}_tags_list`).after(
          `<div id="no_results_${item}" class="no_results_message">No hay resultados en esta categoría</div>`
        );
      }
    } else {
      $noResults.remove();
    }
  });
}

function clearSearch(){
    clearTimeout(window.filterTimeout);
    
    $('#unified_tags_search').val('').focus();
    unifiedFilterTags('');
}

function setTagContainerHeight(isCollapsed=null) {
    ['services', 'rooms', 'additionals'].forEach(item => {
        const liCount = $(`#${item}_tags_list > li`).length;
        if (liCount > getMaxVisibleItems() && !isCollapsed) {
            $(`#${item}_tags_list`).css('height', '141px').removeClass('new_viewmore');
        }
        if(isCollapsed){
            $(`#viewmore_${item}`).hide();
            $(`#viewless_${item}`).hide();
            $(`#${item}_tags_list`).css('height', 'auto').removeClass('new_viewmore')
        }   
        if(!isCollapsed && liCount > getMaxVisibleItems()){
            $(`#viewmore_${item}`).show();
            $(`#viewless_${item}`).hide();
        }
        if(!isCollapsed && liCount < getMaxVisibleItems()){
            $(`#viewmore_${item}`).hide();
        }
    });
}

$(document).ready(function() {
    setTagContainerHeight(false);
});
</script>

        var $viewLess = $('#' + container.viewLessId);
        
        if ($ul.length > 0) {

            if (itemCount <= getMaxVisibleItems()) {
                $viewMore.hide();
                $viewLess.hide();
            } else {

        }
    });
}

function AddRemovePropertyTag(containerId) {
  
  var $li = $('#' + containerId);
  var $checkbox = $li.find('input[type="checkbox"]').first();
  var newChecked = !$checkbox.prop('checked');
  $checkbox.prop('checked', newChecked);
  
  var parts = containerId.split('_');
  var tag_id = parts[2];

  const smartCotizationRadioTag = $('#modalSmartCotizationAttrs').find('input[type="radio"][name="attribute_' + tag_id + '"]');
  if (smartCotizationRadioTag.length) {
      const valueMap = {
          true: 'yes',
          false: 'no'
      };
      const newValue = valueMap[newChecked];
      smartCotizationRadioTag.val([newValue]);
  }

  var action = newChecked ? 'add' : 'remove';

  $.ajax('/property/8002445/add_remove_tag?tag=' + tag_id + '&action=' + action)
    .done(function(result) {
      
    })
    .fail(function() {
      $checkbox.prop('checked', !newChecked);
    });
}

<script>
    var whichWYSIWYG;
    var wysiwygIsOpen = false;
    function sendForm(button){
         event.preventDefault();
        
        if (whichWYSIWYG=="sp") {
            var form = $('#form_prop_wysiwyg')[0];
            var urlForm = "/property/8002445/?description=:)";
        }else{
            var form = $('#form_prop_wysiwyg_en')[0];
            var urlForm = "/property/8002445/?description_en=:)";
        }
        $(".wrapper-loader-wysiwyg."+whichWYSIWYG).css("display","inline-block");
        var data = new FormData(form);
        
        $.ajax({
            type: "POST",
            enctype: 'multipart/form-data',
            url: urlForm,
            data: data,
            processData: false,
            contentType: false,
            cache: false,
            timeout: 800000,
            success: function (data) {
                if (whichWYSIWYG=="sp") {
                    var prop_desc_sp = proccess_prop_desc($("#summernote").val());
                    $("#desc_edit").html(prop_desc_sp);
                }else{
                    var prop_desc_en = proccess_prop_desc($("#summernote2").val());
                    $("#desc_en_edit").html(prop_desc_en);
                }
                if (typeof needUpdateQACompScore === 'function') {
                    needUpdateQACompScore();
                }
                ensurePlaceholderTargetsEmpty();
                hideWysiwyg(null, 200);
                updatePropertyDescCounter();
                if($('#property_info').hasClass('collapsed_mode')){
                    toggleFileBoxFromElement(button, { forceCollapsed: true })
                }
                $(".wrapper-loader-wysiwyg."+whichWYSIWYG).css("display","none");
            }
        });
    }

    function updateCharCounter(editorId, counterId) {
        var textContent = '';
        if (editorId === 'summernote') {
            var $editable = $('#form_prop_wysiwyg .note-editable');
            if ($editable.length) {
                textContent = $editable.text();
            }
        } else if (editorId === 'summernote2') {
            var $editable = $('#form_prop_wysiwyg_en .note-editable');
            if ($editable.length) {
                textContent = $editable.text();
            }
        }
        var trimmedText = textContent ? textContent.trim() : '';
        var count = trimmedText.length;

        if($('#' + counterId).is(':hidden')){
            $('#' + counterId).show();
        }
        $('#' + counterId).text(count);
    }

    $(document).ready(function () {
        $('#summernote').summernote({
            height: 180,
            toolbar: [
                ['style', ['bold', 'italic', 'underline']],
                ['fontsize', ['fontsize']],
                ['height', ['height']]
              ],
            disableResizeEditor: true,
            callbacks: {
                onInit: function() {
                    var $counter = $('#char_counter_sp');
                    var $propertyDesc = $('#property_description');
                    if ($propertyDesc.length && $counter.length) {
                        $counter.appendTo($propertyDesc);
                    }
                    updateCharCounter('summernote', 'char_counter_sp');
                },
                onChange: function() {
                    updateCharCounter('summernote', 'char_counter_sp');
                }
            }
        });

        $('#summernote2').summernote({
            height: 180,
            toolbar: [
                ['style', ['bold', 'italic', 'underline']],
                ['fontsize', ['fontsize']],
                ['height', ['height']]
              ],
            disableResizeEditor: true,
            callbacks: {
                onInit: function() {
                    var $counter = $('#char_counter_en');
                    var $propertyDesc = $('#property_description');
                    if ($propertyDesc.length && $counter.length) {
                        $counter.appendTo($propertyDesc);
                    }
                    updateCharCounter('summernote2', 'char_counter_en');
                },
                onChange: function() {
                    updateCharCounter('summernote2', 'char_counter_en');
                }
            }
        });


        function handlePasteEvent(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            
            var text = e.clipboardData.getData("text/plain");
            
            // Normalize line breaks from Windows (\r\n) and Mac (\r) to Unix (\n)
            text = text.replace(/\r\n/g, '\n').replace(/\r/g, '\n');
            
            // Remove trailing whitespace/newlines
            text = text.replace(/\s+$/, '');
            
            // Split text by line breaks and preserve ALL lines (including empty ones)
            var lines = text.split('\n');
            
            var htmlContent = '';
            
            for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
                var line = lines[i];
                
                if (i === 0) {
                    // First line: direct text (no div wrapper)
                    htmlContent += line;
                } else {
                    // For subsequent lines: check if empty or has content
                    if (line.trim() === '') {
                        // Empty line: just add line break
                        htmlContent += '<div><br></div>';
                    } else {
                        // Line with content: add content in div
                        htmlContent += '<div>' + line + '</div>';
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Add final <div><br></div> if there were multiple lines
            if (lines.length > 1) {
                htmlContent += '<div><br></div>';
            }
            
            // Insert the properly formatted HTML
            if (htmlContent) {
                document.execCommand("insertHTML", false, htmlContent);
            }
        }

        document.getElementsByClassName("note-editable")[0].addEventListener("paste", function(e) {
            handlePasteEvent(e);
            setTimeout(function() {
                updateCharCounter('summernote', 'char_counter_sp');
            }, 100);
        });
        document.getElementsByClassName("note-editable")[1].addEventListener("paste", function(e) {
            handlePasteEvent(e);
            setTimeout(function() {
                updateCharCounter('summernote2', 'char_counter_en');
            }, 100);
        });

        $(document).on('input keyup', '#form_prop_wysiwyg .note-editable', function() {
            updateCharCounter('summernote', 'char_counter_sp');
        });

        $(document).on('input keyup', '#form_prop_wysiwyg_en .note-editable', function() {
            updateCharCounter('summernote2', 'char_counter_en');
        });

        $('[data-toggle="tooltip"]').tooltip();
    });


    function showWysiwyg(which){
        
        if (!$("#property_info").hasClass("collapsed_mode")){
            $("#property_description .box_body").css('height','auto');
        }

        whichWYSIWYG = which;
        wysiwygIsOpen = true;
        if (which=="sp") {
            $("#desc_edit").hide();
            $("#char_counter_en").hide();
            $("#char_counter_es").show();
            $("#new_wrapper_wysiwyg_sp").show();
            $("#new_wrapper_wysiwyg_en").hide();
            setTimeout(function() {
                var $counter = $('#char_counter_sp');
                var $propertyDesc = $('#property_description');
                if ($propertyDesc.length && $counter.length && !$counter.parent().is('#property_description')) {
                    $counter.appendTo($propertyDesc);
                }
                updateCharCounter('summernote', 'char_counter_sp');
            }, 300);
        }else{
            $("#char_counter_es").hide();

function generateOpenAIDescription() {
    const entityType = "PROP";
    const entityID = 8002445;
    
    const lengthMapping = {
        'short': 1,
        'medium': 2,
        'long': 3
    };
    
    const styleMapping = {
        'formal': 1,
        'neutral': 2,
        'friendly': 3
    };
    
    selectedLengthBtn = document.querySelector('.desc-length-btn.selected');
    selectedStyleBtn = document.querySelector('.desc-style-btn.selected');
    additionalInstructions = document.getElementById('additional-info-ia-desc').value.trim();
    
    const textLength = lengthMapping[selectedLengthBtn.dataset.value];
    const textStyle = styleMapping[selectedStyleBtn.dataset.value];
    
    const objectModel = entityType === 'PROP' ? 'PRO' : 'DEV';
    const currentLang = $('#desc_es_tab').hasClass('selected') ? 'sp' : 'en';
    const improveExisting = useDescBtns.filter(':checked').val() === 'improve';

    const payload = {
        object_id: entityID,
        object_model: objectModel,
        text_length: textLength,
        text_style: textStyle,
        save_for_next_time: false,
        language: currentLang === 'en' ? 'En' : '',
        improve_existing: improveExisting
    };
    
    if (additionalInstructions) {
        payload.additional_instructions = additionalInstructions;
    }

    descriptionForm.hide();
    footerSelect.hide();
    loader.show();

    $.ajax({
        url: '/api3/properties/openai/description/',
        type: 'POST',
        contentType: 'application/json',
        data: JSON.stringify(payload),
        processData: false,
        headers: {
            'X-CSRFToken': 'DCH3hhl20acrpjyohtiE88QvcbeYPP8ZrO1vjw3S6OJxolY8uGxHDCztkwEjNpN3'
        },
        success: function(response) {
            if (response.description) {
                $('#new-description-ia').val(response.description);
            } else if (response.error) {
                console.log('Error: ' + response.error);
            }
            loader.hide();
            newDescription.show();
            footerGenerate.show();
        },
        error: function(xhr, status, error) {
            console.error('Error generating description:', xhr.responseText);
            let errorMessage = 'Error generating description';
            if (xhr.responseJSON && xhr.responseJSON.error) {
                errorMessage += ': ' + xhr.responseJSON.error;
            } else if (xhr.responseText) {
                try {
                    const errorData = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText);
                    if (errorData.error) {
                        errorMessage += ': ' + errorData.error;
                    }
                } catch (e) {
                    errorMessage += ': ' + xhr.responseText;
                }
            }
            loader.hide();

$('#use_generated_description_btn').on('click', function(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    
    const generatedDescription = $('#new-description-ia').val();
    if (!generatedDescription || !generatedDescription.trim()) {
        return;
    }
    
    const mixpanel_extra_info = {
        'text-length': selectedLengthBtn.dataset.value,
        'text-style': selectedStyleBtn.dataset.value,
        'text-instructions': additionalInstructions ? 'yes' : 'no',
        'action': useDescBtns.filter(':checked').val() === 'improve' ? 'enhance actual text' : 'suggest new text',
    };
    mixpanel_track('platform_property-file_ai-description-edition', extra_info=mixpanel_extra_info);



    const $modal = $('#modalIADescription');
    $modal.removeClass('show').hide();
    $('body').removeClass('modal-open');
    
    const currentLang = $('#desc_es_tab').hasClass('selected') ? 'sp' : 'en';
    const summernoteId = currentLang === 'sp' ? '#summernote' : '#summernote2';
    const wrapperId = currentLang === 'sp' ? '#new_wrapper_wysiwyg_sp' : '#new_wrapper_wysiwyg_en';
    const descriptionBanner = '#wysiwyg_ia_banner_'
        + (currentLang === 'en' ? 'en' : 'es');

    if (typeof showWysiwyg === 'function') {
        showWysiwyg(currentLang);
        
        const textContent = generatedDescription.trim();
        const htmlContent = textContent.replace(/\n/g, '<br>');
        
        function insertDescription() {
            const $editor = $(summernoteId);
            const $wrapper = $(wrapperId);
            
            try {
                const summernoteInstance = $editor.data('summernote');
                if (summernoteInstance) {
                    $editor.summernote('code', htmlContent);
                    $editor.summernote('trigger', 'change');
                    console.log('Content inserted successfully via summernote code');
                    return;
                }
                
                const $noteEditable = $wrapper.find('.note-editable');
                if ($noteEditable.length) {
                    $noteEditable.html(htmlContent);
                    $noteEditable.trigger('input');
                    $noteEditable.trigger('change');
                    $editor.trigger('change');
                    return;
                }
                
            } catch (err) {
                console.error('Error inserting description:', err);
            }
            
        }
        setTimeout(insertDescription, 500);
    }
    resetModalState();
    $(descriptionBanner).show();

});

function checkAndShowEditOptions() {
    const hasDescription = hasExistingDescription();
    const $editOptions = $('#description-edit-options');
    
    if (hasDescription) {
        $editOptions.show();
        $('input[name="edit_mode"][value="improve"]').prop('checked', true);
    } else {
        $editOptions.hide();
        $('input[name="edit_mode"][value="new"]').prop('checked', true);
    }
}

<script>

function buildExtraAttrHTML(id) {
    console.log("Building extra attr HTML for id:", id);
  return ''
    + '<li class="extra_attr_row editFieldContainer">'
    +   '<span class="new_box_field_data extra_attr_field extra_attr_placeholder editable-field longest" id="name_extra_attr_'+id+'"></span>'
    +   '<div class="extra_attr_value_container">'
    +     '<span id="value_extra_attr_'+id+'" class="new_box_field_data extra_attr_field extra_attr_placeholder editable-field longest"></span>'
    +     '<div class="extra_attr_icons">'
    +       '<i id="ea_property_measure_icon_'+id+'" class="fa fa-arrows-h expanded_content" onclick="toggle_room_measure(\''+id+'\')" title="Si esta habilitado, este ítem sera usado como medida de la propiedad (para portales, pdfs, web)"></i>'
    +       '<i id="ea_property_expenditure_icon_'+id+'" class="icon-expensas expanded_content" aria-hidden="true" onclick="toggle_room_expenditure(\''+id+'\')" title="Si esta habilitado, este ítem será usado como gasto de la propiedad (para portales, pdfs, web)"></i>'
    +       '<i id="ea_property_visibility_icon_'+id+'" onclick="toggle_room_visibility(\''+id+'\')" class="icon icon-ver" title="Si no esta habilitado, este ítem solo se podrá visualizar aquí en la ficha, como información privada."></i>'
    +       '<a class="expanded_content" href="javascript:remove_room(\''+id+'\')"><i class="icon icon-eliminar"></i></a>'
    +     '</div>'
    +   '</div>'
    + '</li>';
}

function initExtraAttrEditors(id) {
  $("#name_extra_attr_"+id).editable(function(value) {
    add_remove_placeholder(value, '#name_extra_attr_'+id);
    $(this).closest('li.extra_attr_row').toggleClass('is_empty', value.trim() === '' && isValueEmpty(id));
    save('extra_attr::name::'+id, value);
    $(this).removeClass('focused');
    return value;
  }, {
    tooltip: 'Hacé click para editar',
    placeholder: 'Agregá un nombre (p. ej., Impuestos)',
    onblur: 'submit',
    onedit: function(){
       var $field = $(this);
       $field.addClass('focused');
       if (typeof indexEditableFields === 'function') {
           indexEditableFields();
       }
       setTimeout(function() {
           var $input = $field.find('input[name=value], textarea[name=value]');
           if ($input.length) {
               $input.focus();
           }
       }, 10);
    }
  });

  $("#value_extra_attr_"+id).editable(function(value) {
    add_remove_placeholder(value, '#value_extra_attr_'+id);
    $(this).closest('li.extra_attr_row').toggleClass('is_empty', value.trim() === '' && isNameEmpty(id));
    save('extra_attr::value::'+id, value);
    $(this).removeClass('focused');
    return value;
  }, {
    tooltip: 'Hacé click para editar',
    placeholder: 'Agregar un valor o medida',
    onblur: 'submit',
    onedit: function(){
       var $field = $(this);
       $field.addClass('focused');
       if (typeof indexEditableFields === 'function') {
           indexEditableFields();
       }
       setTimeout(function() {
           var $input = $field.find('input[name=value], textarea[name=value]');
           if ($input.length) {
               $input.focus();
           }
       }, 10);
    }
  });
}

function upgradePlaceholderIds(oldId, newId) {
  var li = $("#name_extra_attr_"+oldId).closest("li.extra_attr_row");
  if (!li.length) return;

  li.find("#name_extra_attr_"+oldId)
    .attr("id", "name_extra_attr_"+newId)
    .removeClass("extra_attr_placeholder");

  li.find("#value_extra_attr_"+oldId)
    .attr("id", "value_extra_attr_"+newId)
    .removeClass("extra_attr_placeholder");

  li.find("#ea_property_measure_icon_"+oldId)
    .attr("id", "ea_property_measure_icon_"+newId)
    .attr("onclick", "toggle_room_measure('"+newId+"')");

  li.find("#ea_property_expenditure_icon_"+oldId)
    .attr("id", "ea_property_expenditure_icon_"+newId)
    .attr("onclick", "toggle_room_expenditure('"+newId+"')");

  li.find("#ea_property_visibility_icon_"+oldId)
    .attr("id", "ea_property_visibility_icon_"+newId)
    .attr("onclick", "toggle_room_visibility('"+newId+"')");

  li.find("a[href=\"javascript:remove_room('"+oldId+"')\"]")
    .attr("href", "javascript:remove_room('"+newId+"')");

  initExtraAttrEditors(newId);
}

function addOrUpdateExtraAttrRender(id, update=false){
  if (update){
    $('#name_extra_attr_is_empty').editable("destroy");
    $('#value_extra_attr_is_empty').editable("destroy");
    upgradePlaceholderIds("is_empty", id);
  } else {
    $("#new_extra_attributes_ul").append(buildExtraAttrHTML(id));
    initExtraAttrEditors(id);
  }
}

function add_extra_attr() {
  var url = '/property/8002445/add_room';

  $.ajax(url).done(function(result) {
    var hasPlaceholder = $("#name_extra_attr_is_empty").length > 0;
    var nameVal = '';
    var valueVal = '';

    if (hasPlaceholder) {
      nameVal  = $.trim($("#name_extra_attr_is_empty").text());
      valueVal = $.trim($("#value_extra_attr_is_empty").text());
    }
    addOrUpdateExtraAttrRender(result, hasPlaceholder);

    if (hasPlaceholder) {
      if (nameVal && nameVal != "Agregá un nombre (p. ej., Impuestos)") {
        $('#name_extra_attr_' + result).text(nameVal);
        add_remove_placeholder(nameVal, '#name_extra_attr_' + result);
        save('extra_attr::name::' + result, nameVal);
      } else{
        $('#name_extra_attr_' + result).addClass('extra_attr_placeholder');
      }
      if (valueVal && valueVal != "Agregar un valor o medida") {
        $('#value_extra_attr_' + result).text(valueVal);
        add_remove_placeholder(valueVal, '#value_extra_attr_' + result);
        save('extra_attr::value::' + result, valueVal);
      } else{
        $('#value_extra_attr_' + result).addClass('extra_attr_placeholder');
      }
    }
    const liElement = $("#name_extra_attr_"+result).closest("li.extra_attr_row");
    liElement.addClass("editFieldContainer");
}).fail(function() {
  });
}

function add_extra_attr_placeholder() {
    if ($("#name_extra_attr_is_empty").length > 0) {
        return;
    }
  const pid = "is_empty";

  $("#new_extra_attributes_ul").append(buildExtraAttrHTML(pid));

  $("#name_extra_attr_"+pid).editable(function(value) {
    if ($.trim(value) !== '') add_extra_attr();
    $(this).closest('li.extra_attr_row').toggleClass('is_empty', value.trim() === '' && isValueEmpty(pid));
    return value;
  }, {
    tooltip: 'Hacé click para editar',
    placeholder: 'Agregá un nombre (p. ej., Impuestos)',
    onblur: 'submit',
    onedit: function(){
       var $field = $(this);
       $field.addClass('focused');
       if (typeof indexEditableFields === 'function') {
           indexEditableFields();
       }
       setTimeout(function() {
           var $input = $field.find('input[name=value], textarea[name=value]');
           if ($input.length) {
               $input.focus();
           }
       }, 10);
    }
  });

  $("#value_extra_attr_"+pid).editable(function(value) {
    if ($.trim(value) !== '') add_extra_attr();
    $(this).closest('li.extra_attr_row').toggleClass('is_empty', value.trim() === '' && isNameEmpty(pid));
    return value;
  }, {
    tooltip: 'Hacé click para editar',
    placeholder: 'Agregar un valor o medida',
    onblur: 'submit',
    onedit: function(){
       var $field = $(this);
       $field.addClass('focused');
       if (typeof indexEditableFields === 'function') {
           indexEditableFields();
       }
       setTimeout(function() {
           var $input = $field.find('input[name=value], textarea[name=value]');
           if ($input.length) {
               $input.focus();
           }
       }, 10);
    }
  });
  const placeElement = $("#name_extra_attr_"+pid).closest("li.extra_attr_row");
  placeElement.addClass("is_empty");
  //placeElement.removeClass("editFieldContainer")
}

function remove_room(id){
    if (!id || id === 'is_empty') {
        return;
    }

  $.ajax('/property/8002445/remove_room?id='+id)
    .done(function() {
      $('#name_extra_attr_'+id).parent().remove();
      if ($("#new_extra_attributes_ul li").length == 1){
        add_extra_attr_placeholder();
      }
    });
}

function add_remove_placeholder(value, selector){
  if ($.trim(value) === '') {
    $(selector).addClass('extra_attr_placeholder');
  } else {
    $(selector).removeClass('extra_attr_placeholder');
  }
}

$(document).ready(function() {
  if ($("#new_extra_attributes_ul li").length == 1){
    add_extra_attr_placeholder();
  }
});
</script>
