    function formatNumberWithLocalization(number) {
        const locale = 'es-ar';
        return new Intl.NumberFormat(locale).format(number);
    }

    function get_commision_input(commision_key, value) {
        // Check if this is buyer commission
        var isBuyerCommission = commision_key === 'buyer_commision';
        
        var labelHtml = isBuyerCommission ? '' : '<p>Comisión:</p>';
        var removeHtml = isBuyerCommission ? '' : '<p style="cursor: pointer; margin-left: 16px;" class="new_box_field_data expanded_content" onclick="commision_selector_remove(\'' + commision_key + '\')">Eliminar comisión</p>';
        
        return `<div class="commision-selector-input-container">
            ${labelHtml}
            <div class="commision-value-container new_box_field_data">
                <span class="commision-display-value" id="commision-display-${commision_key}" onclick="commision_edit_mode('${commision_key}')" style="cursor: pointer;">${value || '0'}</span>
                <input type="number" class="commision-selector-input" id="commision-input-${commision_key}" min="0" max="100" step="0.5" style="display: none;"/>
                <span>%</span>
                <span class="commision-money-value" id="commision-money-${commision_key}"></span>
            </div>
            ${removeHtml}
        </div>`;
    }

    function get_add_button(commision_key) {
        return `<div class="commision-selector-item-add expanded_content" onclick="commision_selector_add('${commision_key}')">
            <i class="icon icon-agregar"></i>
            <p>Comisión</p>
        </div>`;
    }

    function setupCommissionEventListeners(commision_key) {
        $('#commision-input-' + commision_key).on('keydown', function(e) {
            if (e.keyCode === 45 || e.keyCode === 109 || e.keyCode === 189) {
                e.preventDefault();
            }
        });
        
        $('#commision-input-' + commision_key).on('input', function(e) {
            var inputVal = e.target.value.trim();
            
            $('#commision-container-' + commision_key).toggleClass('is_empty', inputVal === '' || inputVal === '0');

            if (inputVal === '') {
                $('#commision-money-' + commision_key).text('');
                return;
            }
            var value = parseFloat(inputVal);
            if (!isNaN(value)) {
                if (value > 100) {
                    e.target.value = 100;
                    value = 100;
                }
                if (value < 0) {
                    e.target.value = 0;
                    value = 0;
                }
                
                updateMoneyDisplay(commision_key, value);
            }
        });
        
        $('#commision-input-' + commision_key).on('paste', function(e) {
            setTimeout(function() {
                var value = parseFloat(e.target.value);
                if (value < 0) {
                    e.target.value = 0;
                    value = 0;
                }
                if (value > 100) {
                    e.target.value = 100;
                    value = 100;
                }
                
                updateMoneyDisplay(commision_key, value);
            }, 10);
        });
        
        $('#commision-input-' + commision_key).on('keypress', function(e) {
            if (e.which === 13) {
                commision_save_value(commision_key);
            }
        });
        
        $('#commision-input-' + commision_key).on('blur', function(e) {
            // Only save on real blur events (not programmatic)
            if (e.originalEvent || e.relatedTarget) {
                commision_save_value(commision_key);
            }
        });
    }

    $(document).ready(function() {
        var commisionKey = 'appraiser_commision';
        var commisionValue = '0';
        
        // Parse commission value
        var numericValue = 0;
        if (commisionValue && commisionValue !== '0' && commisionValue !== '') {
            var cleanValue = commisionValue.toString().replace(',', '.');
            numericValue = parseFloat(cleanValue) || 0;
        }
        
        // For buyer commission, always show input. For others, show add button if value is 0
        if (commisionKey === 'buyer_commision' || numericValue > 0) {
            $('#commision-container-' + commisionKey).html(get_commision_input(commisionKey, commisionValue));
            setupCommissionEventListeners(commisionKey);
        } else {
            $('#commision-container-' + commisionKey).html(get_add_button(commisionKey));
        }
    });

    function commision_selector_add(commision_key) {
        const container = $('#commision-container-' + commision_key);
        const input = get_commision_input(commision_key, '0');
        container.html(input);
        setupCommissionEventListeners(commision_key);
    }
    
    function commision_edit_mode(commision_key) {
        var currentValue = $('#commision-display-' + commision_key).text();
        $('#commision-display-' + commision_key).hide();
        $('#commision-input-' + commision_key).val(currentValue).show().focus();
    }
    
    function commision_save_value(commision_key) {
        var inputValue = $('#commision-input-' + commision_key).val().trim();
        
        // If empty or invalid, set to 0
        if (!inputValue || inputValue === '' || isNaN(parseFloat(inputValue))) {
            inputValue = '0';
        }
        
        var displayValue = inputValue;
        var numericValue = parseFloat(inputValue);
        
        // Save to backend using the existing save function
        if (typeof save === 'function') {
            var valueToSave = inputValue.replace(',', '.');
            save(commision_key, valueToSave);
        }
        
        // For buyer commission, always keep the input visible. For others, show add button if value is 0
        if (commision_key === 'buyer_commision') {
            $('#commision-display-' + commision_key).text(displayValue).show();
            $('#commision-input-' + commision_key).hide();
            updateMoneyDisplay(commision_key, numericValue);
        } else {
            if (numericValue === 0) {
                const container = $('#commision-container-' + commision_key);
                const addButton = get_add_button(commision_key);
                container.html(addButton);
            } else {
                $('#commision-display-' + commision_key).text(displayValue).show();
                $('#commision-input-' + commision_key).hide();
                updateMoneyDisplay(commision_key, numericValue);
            }
        }
    }
    
    function commision_selector_remove(commision_key) {
        // For buyer commission, just set to 0 but keep the input visible
        $('#commision-container-' + commision_key).toggleClass('is_empty', true);
        if (commision_key === 'buyer_commision') {
            $('#commision-display-' + commision_key).text('0');
            $('#commision-input-' + commision_key).val('0');
            updateMoneyDisplay(commision_key, 0);
            
            if (typeof save === 'function') {
                save(commision_key, '0');
            }
        } else {
            // Normal behavior: show add button
            if (typeof save === 'function') {
                save(commision_key, '0');
            }
            
            const container = $('#commision-container-' + commision_key);
            const addButton = get_add_button(commision_key);
            container.html(addButton);
        }
    }

    function updateMoneyDisplay(commision_key, percentage) {
        const moneyValue = calculateCommissionMoneyValue(percentage);
        $('#commision-money-' + commision_key).text(moneyValue);
    }
    
    function calculateCommissionMoneyValue(percentage) {
        if (!window.commissionBaseData?.has_price || !percentage) return '';
        
        const amount = (window.commissionBaseData.base_price * percentage) / 100;
        const formattedAmount = formatNumberWithLocalization(Math.round(amount));
        
        return `(${window.commissionBaseData.currency} ${formattedAmount})`;
    }
    
    function updateAllCommissionMoneyValues() {
        $('[id^="commision-money-"]').each(function() {
            const key = $(this).attr('id').replace('commision-money-', '');
            const percentage = parseFloat($('#commision-display-' + key).text()) || 0;
            updateMoneyDisplay(key, percentage);
        });
    }

        container.html(input);
        setupCommissionEventListeners(commision_key);
    }
    
    function commision_edit_mode(commision_key) {
        var currentValue = $('#commision-display-' + commision_key).text();
        $('#commision-display-' + commision_key).hide();
        $('#commision-input-' + commision_key).val(currentValue).show().focus();
    }
    
    function commision_save_value(commision_key) {
        var inputValue = $('#commision-input-' + commision_key).val().trim();
        
        // If empty or invalid, set to 0
        if (!inputValue || inputValue === '' || isNaN(parseFloat(inputValue))) {
            inputValue = '0';
        }
        
        var displayValue = inputValue;
        var numericValue = parseFloat(inputValue);
        
        // Save to backend using the existing save function
        if (typeof save === 'function') {
            var valueToSave = inputValue.replace(',', '.');
            save(commision_key, valueToSave);
        }
        
        // For buyer commission, always keep the input visible. For others, show add button if value is 0
        if (commision_key === 'buyer_commision') {
            $('#commision-display-' + commision_key).text(displayValue).show();
            $('#commision-input-' + commision_key).hide();
            updateMoneyDisplay(commision_key, numericValue);
        } else {
            if (numericValue === 0) {
                const container = $('#commision-container-' + commision_key);
                const addButton = get_add_button(commision_key);
                container.html(addButton);
            } else {
                $('#commision-display-' + commision_key).text(displayValue).show();
                $('#commision-input-' + commision_key).hide();
                updateMoneyDisplay(commision_key, numericValue);
            }
        }
    }
    
    function commision_selector_remove(commision_key) {
        // For buyer commission, just set to 0 but keep the input visible
        $('#commision-container-' + commision_key).toggleClass('is_empty', true);
        if (commision_key === 'buyer_commision') {
            $('#commision-display-' + commision_key).text('0');
            $('#commision-input-' + commision_key).val('0');
            updateMoneyDisplay(commision_key, 0);
            
            if (typeof save === 'function') {
                save(commision_key, '0');
            }
        } else {
            // Normal behavior: show add button
            if (typeof save === 'function') {
                save(commision_key, '0');
            }
            
            const container = $('#commision-container-' + commision_key);
            const addButton = get_add_button(commision_key);
            container.html(addButton);
        }
    }

    function updateMoneyDisplay(commision_key, percentage) {
        const moneyValue = calculateCommissionMoneyValue(percentage);
        $('#commision-money-' + commision_key).text(moneyValue);
    }
    
    function calculateCommissionMoneyValue(percentage) {
        if (!window.commissionBaseData?.has_price || !percentage) return '';
        
        const amount = (window.commissionBaseData.base_price * percentage) / 100;
        const formattedAmount = formatNumberWithLocalization(Math.round(amount));
        
        return `(${window.commissionBaseData.currency} ${formattedAmount})`;
    }
    
    function updateAllCommissionMoneyValues() {
        $('[id^="commision-money-"]').each(function() {
            const key = $(this).attr('id').replace('commision-money-', '');
            const percentage = parseFloat($('#commision-display-' + key).text()) || 0;
            updateMoneyDisplay(key, percentage);
        });
    }

function can_be_cotized(){
    if ($("#OP-1-ENA").is(':checked') || $("#OP-2-ENA").is(':checked') || $("#OP-3-ENA").is(':checked')){
        return true;
    }else{
        return false;
    }
}

function hasOperationValues(operationId){
    var primaryId = operationId.replace('ENA', 'primary');
    var secondaryId = operationId.replace('ENA', 'secondary');
    var primaryText = $('#' + primaryId).text().trim();
    var secondaryText = $('#' + secondaryId).text().trim();
    var primaryVal = primaryText !== 'Editar...' ? parseFloat(primaryText.replace(/[^\d]/g, '')) || 0 : 0;
    var secondaryVal = secondaryText !== 'Editar...' ? parseFloat(secondaryText.replace(/[^\d]/g, '')) || 0 : 0;
    return primaryVal > 0 || secondaryVal > 0;
}

function handle_fire_insurance_cost(operation){
    if (operation == 'OP-2-secondary' || operation == 'OP-2-primary'){
        const secRawText = $('#OP-2-secondary').text().trim();
        const priRawText = $('#OP-2-primary').text().trim();
        
        const secNumericText = secRawText.replace(/[^\d]/g, '');
        const priNumericText = priRawText.replace(/[^\d]/g, '');
        
        const secVal = secNumericText !== '' ? parseFloat(secNumericText) : 0;
        const priVal = priNumericText !== '' ? parseFloat(priNumericText) : 0;

        if (secVal > 0 || priVal > 0){
            //$('#rent_additional_info_block').show().addClass('editFieldsSection');
            $('#fire_insurance_cost_container, #fire_insurance_cost_container').addClass('editFieldContainer');
        } else {
            //$('#rent_additional_info_block').hide().removeClass('editFieldsSection');
            $('#fire_insurance_cost_container, #fire_insurance_cost_container').removeClass('editFieldContainer');
            
        }
    }
}

function handle_cleaning_tax_visibility(updatedPeriod, updatedValue){
    // Check if there are any temporary rent prices with values > 0
    let hasTempRentPrice = false;
    
    $('#property_temporary_rent_ul li[data-period]').each(function(){
        const $li = $(this);
        const periodId = $li.attr('id').replace('li_temprent_', '');
        let priceText = '';
        
        if (updatedPeriod && periodId === updatedPeriod && updatedValue !== undefined) {
            priceText = updatedValue.toString();
        } else {
            const priceElement = $li.find('.property_data_value');
            if (priceElement.length > 0) {
                priceText = priceElement.text().trim();
            }
        }
        
        if (priceText) {
            const numericValue = priceText.replace(/[^\d]/g, '');
            const price = numericValue !== '' ? parseFloat(numericValue) : 0;
            if (price > 0) {
                hasTempRentPrice = true;
                return false; // Break the loop
            }
        }
    });
    
    // Check if there are any temporary rent occupations
    let hasTempRentOccupation = false;
    $('#property_temporary_rent_ocu_ul li').each(function(){
        // Skip the header row (first li with name="temprent_fixed_li")
        if (!$(this).attr('name')) {
            hasTempRentOccupation = true;
            return false; // Break the loop
        }
    });
    
    if (hasTempRentPrice || hasTempRentOccupation) {
        $('#temp_rent_additional_info_block').show().addClass('editFieldsSection');
        $('#guests_amount_container, #down_payment_container, #cleaning_tax_container').addClass('editFieldContainer');
    } else {
        $('#temp_rent_additional_info_block').hide().removeClass('editFieldsSection');
        $('#guests_amount_container, #down_payment_container, #cleaning_tax_container').removeClass('editFieldContainer');
    }
}

function save_operation(operation, value, ckb){
    $('#OP-1-ENA').show();
    $('#OP-2-ENA').show();

    var isPriceField = operation.indexOf('primary') !== -1 || operation.indexOf('secondary') !== -1;
    var valueNum = parseInt(value) || 0;
    var isEmptyValue = value === '' || value === null || value === undefined || (isPriceField && valueNum === 0);
    
    if (isPriceField && isEmptyValue && typeof statuses !== 'undefined' && statuses.selected == '2') {
        var operationId = '';
        if (operation.indexOf('OP-1') !== -1) {
            operationId = 'OP-1-ENA';
        } else if (operation.indexOf('OP-2') !== -1) {
            operationId = 'OP-2-ENA';
        }
        
        if (operationId) {
            var currentOperationHasOtherValue = hasOperationValues(operationId);
            var otherOperationId = operationId === 'OP-1-ENA' ? 'OP-2-ENA' : 'OP-1-ENA';
            var otherOperationEnabled = $('#' + otherOperationId).is(':checked');
            var otherOperationHasValues = otherOperationEnabled && hasOperationValues(otherOperationId);
            var tempRentEnabled = $('#OP-3-ENA').is(':checked');
            
            if (!currentOperationHasOtherValue && !otherOperationHasValues && !tempRentEnabled) {
                Alert("No podés borrar todas las tasaciones de una propiedad disponible.", function(){}, 'Advertencia');
                return false;
            }
        }
    }
    
    if (!isPriceField && !can_be_cotized()){
        if (statuses.selected == '2'){
            Alert("No podés deshabilitar todas las tasaciones de una propiedad disponible.", function(){}, 'Advertencia');
            $("#"+operation).attr('checked', true);
            return false
        }
    }
    
    var usd_ok = true;
    var ars_ok = true;
    if (operation.indexOf("ENA") != -1 && value){
        if (operation === 'OP-3-ENA') {
            var hasPeriods = $('#property_temporary_rent_ul > li[data-period]').length > 0;
            if (!hasPeriods) {
                Alert("Debés agregar al menos un período antes de habilitar esta operación.", function(){}, 'Advertencia');
                $("#"+operation).attr('checked', false);
                return false;
            }
        } else {
            if ($('#'+operation.replace('ENA', 'secondary')).html() == 'Editar...' || parseInt($('#'+operation.replace('ENA', 'secondary')).html()) < 1){
                usd_ok = false;
            }
            if ($('#'+operation.replace('ENA', 'primary')).html() == 'Editar...' || parseInt($('#'+operation.replace('ENA', 'primary')).html()) < 1){
                ars_ok = false;
            }
            if ( !usd_ok && !ars_ok){
                Alert("Necesitás editar los precios de esta operación antes de habilitarla.", function(){}, 'Advertencia');
                $("#"+operation).attr('checked', false);
                return false;
            }
        }
    }
    var check_val = true;
    if (operation.indexOf("secondary") != -1){
        if (parseInt(value) < 1 && ($('#'+operation.replace('secondary', 'primary')).html() == 'Editar...' || parseInt($('#'+operation.replace('secondary', 'primary')).html()) < 1)){
            check_val = false;
        }
    }
    if (operation.indexOf("primary") != -1){
        if (parseInt(value) < 1 && ($('#'+operation.replace('primary', 'secondary')).html() == 'Editar...' || parseInt($('#'+operation.replace('primary', 'secondary')).html()) < 1)){
            check_val = false;
        }
    }

	if (ckb) {
        $(ckb).prop('checked', check_val);
        if (check_val) {
            $(ckb).attr('checked', 'checked');
        } else {
            $(ckb).removeAttr('checked');
        }
    }

	if (!isPriceField && !can_be_cotized()){
        if (statuses.selected == '2'){
            if (ckb) {
                $(ckb).attr('checked', true);
            }
            if (operation.indexOf('primary') !== -1 || operation.indexOf('secondary') !== -1) {
                var operationId = '';
                if (operation.indexOf('OP-1') !== -1) {
                    operationId = 'OP-1-ENA';
                } else if (operation.indexOf('OP-2') !== -1) {
                    operationId = 'OP-2-ENA';
                }
                if (operationId) {
                    $('#' + operationId).prop('checked', true);
                }
            }
            Alert("No podés borrar todas las tasaciones de una propiedad disponible.", function(){}, 'Advertencia');
            return false
        }
    }

    qs = "?" + operation + "=" + value;
    $(window).bind('beforeunload', function(){
        return 'Estás saliendo sin guardar los cambios.';
    });
    messagebox = $.floatingMessage("<div id='messagebox' class='new'><div class='loader'></div> Guardando...</div>",{
        width:160,
        position: 'left-bottom'
    });
    var jqxhr = $.ajax( qs )
        .done(function(result) {
           $(window).unbind('beforeunload');
           messagebox.floatingMessage("destroy");
            
            handle_fire_insurance_cost(operation);
            handle_cleaning_tax_visibility();
            
            // Update price per m2 when operation prices change
            if (operation.indexOf('OP-1') !== -1 || operation.indexOf('OP-2') !== -1) {
                updatePriceM2Display();
                checkEnabledAutocalculateBtn();
                if (typeof needUpdateQACompScore === 'function') {
                    needUpdateQACompScore();
                }
                if (typeof needUpdateQAPriceReport === 'function') {
                    needUpdateQAPriceReport();
                }
            }
            
            // Update promotional price visibility when sale operations change
            if (operation.indexOf('OP-1') !== -1) {
                // Check if promotional price should be cleared first
                if (typeof checkPromotionalPriceClearance === 'function') {
                    checkPromotionalPriceClearance();
                }
                
                updatePromotionalPriceVisibility();
                
                // Also update currency availability when sale prices change
                if (typeof updatePromotionalCurrencyAvailability === 'function') {
                    updatePromotionalCurrencyAvailability();
                }
            }
            
            // Update commission calculations when operation prices change
            if (operation.indexOf('OP-1') !== -1 || operation.indexOf('OP-2') !== -1 || operation.indexOf('secondary') !== -1 || operation.indexOf('primary') !== -1) {
                refreshCommissionBaseData();
            }
         })
         .fail(function() {
           messagebox.floatingMessage("destroy");
           $.floatingMessage("<div id='messagebox' class='new'>Hubo un error al guardar... Por favor intentá nuevamente en unos minutos.</div>",{time:2000, width:600, position:'left-bottom'});
         })
  }


function normalizeValue(value) {
  return String(value || '').replace(/\./g,'').replace(/,/g,'').replace(/ /g, '');
}

function formatValue(value) {
  return value ? parseInt(value).toLocaleString('es-AR') : '';
}

function createTextInputDataCallback() {
  return function(value, settings) {
    var normalized = String(value || '').trim();
    $(this).data('original-normalized-value', normalized);
    return value;
  };
}

function createTextInputOnsubmitCallback() {
  return function(settings, original) {
    var $input = $(this).find('input');
    if ($input.length === 0) return true;
    
    var normalizedNew = String($input.val() || '').trim();
    var normalizedOriginal = $(original).data('original-normalized-value') || '';
    
    if (normalizedNew === normalizedOriginal) {
      return normalizedOriginal || '';
    }
    
    return true;
  };
}

function createNumericInputDataCallback(normalizeFn) {
  normalizeFn = normalizeFn || normalizePriceNumber;
  return function(value, settings) {
    var normalized = normalizeFn(value);
    $(this).data('original-normalized-value', normalized);
    return normalized;
  };
}

function createNumericInputOnsubmitCallback(normalizeFn, formatFn) {
  normalizeFn = normalizeFn || normalizePriceNumber;
  formatFn = formatFn || function(val) {
    var num = parseFloat(val) || 0;
    return num.toLocaleString('es-AR');
  };
  return function(settings, original) {
    var $input = $(this).find('input');
    if ($input.length === 0) return true;
    
    var normalizedNew = normalizeFn($input.val());
    var normalizedOriginal = $(original).data('original-normalized-value') || '';
    
    if (normalizedNew === normalizedOriginal) {
      return formatFn(normalizedOriginal);
    }
    
    return true;
  };
}

function createSelectDataCallback() {
  return function(value, settings) {
    var normalized = String(value || '');
    $(this).data('original-normalized-value', normalized);
    return value;
  };
}

function createSelectOnsubmitCallback(options) {
  return function(settings, original) {
    var $select = $(this).find('select');
    if ($select.length === 0) return true;
    
    var normalizedNew = String($select.val() || '');
    var normalizedOriginal = $(original).data('original-normalized-value') || '';
    
    if (normalizedNew === normalizedOriginal) {
      return options && options[normalizedOriginal] ? options[normalizedOriginal] : normalizedOriginal;
    }
    
    return true;
  };
}

function getOperationsState() {
    function getNumericValue(element) {
        if (!element || !element.length) return 0;
        const text = element.text().trim();
        if (text === '---' || text === '') return 0;
        const cleaned = text.replace(/[^\d]/g, '');
        return cleaned ? parseInt(cleaned) : 0;
    }
    
    const salePrimary = $('#OP-1-primary');
    const saleSecondary = $('#OP-1-secondary');
    const rentPrimary = $('#OP-2-primary');
    const rentSecondary = $('#OP-2-secondary');
    
    const salePrimaryVal = getNumericValue(salePrimary);
    const saleSecondaryVal = getNumericValue(saleSecondary);
    const rentPrimaryVal = getNumericValue(rentPrimary);
    const rentSecondaryVal = getNumericValue(rentSecondary);
    
    const hasSalePrice = salePrimaryVal > 0 || saleSecondaryVal > 0;
    const hasRentPrice = rentPrimaryVal > 0 || rentSecondaryVal > 0;
    
    const tempRentEnabled = $('#OP-3-ENA').is(':checked');
    
    return {
        hasSalePrice: hasSalePrice,
        hasRentPrice: hasRentPrice,
        hasTempRentPeriods: tempRentEnabled,
        hasAnyOperation: hasSalePrice || hasRentPrice || tempRentEnabled
    };
}

function createOperationEditableCallback(enaSelector) {
  const opType  = enaSelector.indexOf('OP-1') !== -1 ? 'sale' : 'rent';

    var normalizedNew = normalizeValue(value);
    var normalizedOriginal = $(this).data('original-normalized-value') || '';
    var fieldId = $(this).attr('id');
    
    if (normalizedNew === normalizedOriginal) {
      if (normalizedOriginal === "") {
        $(this).closest('.data_field_subbox.editFieldContainer').addClass('is_empty');
        if (typeof window.updateOperationButtonsState === 'function') {
        setTimeout(function() {
            window.updateOperationButtonsState({checkAll: false, operations: opType, fromEmptyState: false});
        }, 100);
        }
    }

    return formatValue(normalizedOriginal);
    }
    
    if (isNaN(normalizedNew) || normalizedNew == '') {
      var operationId = '';
      var otherFieldId = '';
      
      if (fieldId.indexOf('OP-1-primary') !== -1) {
        operationId = 'OP-1-ENA';
        otherFieldId = 'OP-1-secondary';
      } else if (fieldId.indexOf('OP-1-secondary') !== -1) {
        operationId = 'OP-1-ENA';
        otherFieldId = 'OP-1-primary';
      } else if (fieldId.indexOf('OP-2-primary') !== -1) {
        operationId = 'OP-2-ENA';
        otherFieldId = 'OP-2-secondary';
      } else if (fieldId.indexOf('OP-2-secondary') !== -1) {
        operationId = 'OP-2-ENA';
        otherFieldId = 'OP-2-primary';
      }
      
      if (operationId && otherFieldId) {
        var $otherField = $('#' + otherFieldId);
        var otherFieldText = $otherField.text().trim();
        var otherFieldValue = normalizeValue(otherFieldText);
        var otherFieldHasPrice = !isNaN(otherFieldValue) && parseInt(otherFieldValue) > 0;
        
        if (!otherFieldHasPrice) {
          var $operationSwitch = $('#' + operationId);
          var wasOperationEnabled = $operationSwitch.is(':checked');    
          
          if (wasOperationEnabled) {
            var otherOperationId = operationId === 'OP-1-ENA' ? 'OP-2-ENA' : 'OP-1-ENA';
            var otherOperationEnabled = $('#' + otherOperationId).is(':checked');
            var otherOperationHasValues = otherOperationEnabled && hasOperationValues(otherOperationId);
            var tempRentEnabled = $('#OP-3-ENA').is(':checked');
            
            if (!otherOperationHasValues && !tempRentEnabled) {
              if (typeof statuses !== 'undefined' && statuses.selected == '2') {
                Alert("No podés borrar todas las tasaciones de una propiedad disponible.", function(){}, 'Advertencia');
                return formatValue(normalizedOriginal);
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
      
      $(this).closest('.data_field_subbox.editFieldContainer').addClass('is_empty');
      var saveResult = save_operation(this.id, 0, enaSelector);
      
      if (saveResult !== false) {
        if (typeof updateOperationStateAfterEdit === 'function') {
          setTimeout(function() {
            updateOperationStateAfterEdit(fieldId);
          }, 300);
        }
      }

      setTimeout(function() {
        window.updateOperationButtonsState({checkAll: false, operations: opType, fromEmptyState: false});
      }, 100);

      return '';
    }
    
    if (parseInt(normalizedNew) === 0) {
      var operationIdZero = '';
      var otherFieldIdZero = '';
      
      if (fieldId.indexOf('OP-1-primary') !== -1) {
        operationIdZero = 'OP-1-ENA';
        otherFieldIdZero = 'OP-1-secondary';
      } else if (fieldId.indexOf('OP-1-secondary') !== -1) {
        operationIdZero = 'OP-1-ENA';
        otherFieldIdZero = 'OP-1-primary';
      } else if (fieldId.indexOf('OP-2-primary') !== -1) {
        operationIdZero = 'OP-2-ENA';
        otherFieldIdZero = 'OP-2-secondary';
      } else if (fieldId.indexOf('OP-2-secondary') !== -1) {
        operationIdZero = 'OP-2-ENA';
        otherFieldIdZero = 'OP-2-primary';
      }
      
      if (operationIdZero && otherFieldIdZero) {
        var $otherFieldZero = $('#' + otherFieldIdZero);
        var otherFieldTextZero = $otherFieldZero.text().trim();
        var otherFieldValueZero = normalizeValue(otherFieldTextZero);
        var otherFieldHasPriceZero = !isNaN(otherFieldValueZero) && parseInt(otherFieldValueZero) > 0;
        
        if (!otherFieldHasPriceZero) {
          var $operationSwitchZero = $('#' + operationIdZero);
          var wasOperationEnabledZero = $operationSwitchZero.is(':checked');    
          
          if (wasOperationEnabledZero) {
            var otherOperationIdZero = operationIdZero === 'OP-1-ENA' ? 'OP-2-ENA' : 'OP-1-ENA';
            var otherOperationEnabledZero = $('#' + otherOperationIdZero).is(':checked');
            var otherOperationHasValuesZero = otherOperationEnabledZero && hasOperationValues(otherOperationIdZero);
            var tempRentEnabledZero = $('#OP-3-ENA').is(':checked');
            
            if (!otherOperationHasValuesZero && !tempRentEnabledZero) {
              if (typeof statuses !== 'undefined' && statuses.selected == '2') {
                Alert("No podés borrar todas las tasaciones de una propiedad disponible.", function(){}, 'Advertencia');
                return formatValue(normalizedOriginal);
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
    if (typeof needUpdateQACompScore === 'function') {
         needUpdateQACompScore();
     }
    if (normalizedNew > 0) {
      $(this).closest('.data_field_subbox.editFieldContainer').removeClass('is_empty');
    } else {
      $(this).closest('.data_field_subbox.editFieldContainer').addClass('is_empty');

    };

// Function to check if promotional price exists
function hasPromotionalPrice(editionMode) {
    const promotionalPriceVal = editionMode ? $('#promotional_price form input').val().trim() : $('#promotional_price').text().trim();;

    if (!promotionalPriceVal || promotionalPriceVal === '') {
        return false;
    }

    var normalized = normalizeValue(promotionalPriceVal);
    var promotionalPriceNumber = parseInt(normalized);
    var hasPrice = !isNaN(promotionalPriceNumber) && promotionalPriceNumber > 0;
    return hasPrice;
}

// Function to check if promotional price should be cleared when regular price is deleted
function checkPromotionalPriceClearance() {
    // Get current promotional price currency
    var currentPromotionalCurrency = null;
    if ($('#promotional_primary_currency').hasClass('currency-selected')) {
        currentPromotionalCurrency = $('#promotional_primary_currency').attr('data-currency-code');
    } else if ($('#promotional_secondary_currency').hasClass('currency-selected')) {
        currentPromotionalCurrency = $('#promotional_secondary_currency').attr('data-currency-code');
    }
    
    if (!currentPromotionalCurrency || !hasPromotionalPrice()) {
        return; // No promotional price or currency to check
    }
    
    // Get current regular prices
    var primaryPrice = $('#OP-1-primary').text().trim().replace(/\./g,'').replace(/,/g,'').replace(/ /g, '');
    var secondaryPrice = $('#OP-1-secondary').text().trim().replace(/\./g,'').replace(/,/g,'').replace(/ /g, '');
    var primaryPriceNumber = parseInt(primaryPrice);
    var secondaryPriceNumber = parseInt(secondaryPrice);
    var hasPrimaryPrice = !isNaN(primaryPriceNumber) && primaryPriceNumber > 0;
    var hasSecondaryPrice = !isNaN(secondaryPriceNumber) && secondaryPriceNumber > 0;
    
    // Get primary and secondary currency codes
    var primaryCurrencyCode = $('#promotional_primary_currency').attr('data-currency-code');
    var secondaryCurrencyCode = $('#promotional_secondary_currency').attr('data-currency-code');
    
    var shouldClearPromotional = false;
    
    // Check if the promotional price currency no longer has a corresponding regular price
    if (currentPromotionalCurrency === primaryCurrencyCode && !hasPrimaryPrice) {
        shouldClearPromotional = true;
    } else if (currentPromotionalCurrency === secondaryCurrencyCode && !hasSecondaryPrice) {
        shouldClearPromotional = true;
    }
    
    if (shouldClearPromotional) {

        $('#promotional_price').text('---');

        $('#promotional_primary_currency').removeClass('currency-selected');

// Generic function to make numeric fields editable
function makeFieldEditable(fieldId, saveKey, options) {
    options = options || {};
    const hasCurrency = options.hasCurrencySelector ? true : false;
    var editableConfig = {
        tooltip   : 'Hacé click para editar',
        placeholder   : '---',
        data: function(value, settings) {
            var normalized = normalizePriceNumber(value);
            $(this).data('original-normalized-value', normalized);
            $('#' + fieldId + '_currency_selector .currency-dropdown__btn').addClass('edition_mode');
            return normalized;
        },
        onblur : hasCurrency ? 'ignore' : 'submit',
        onedit: function (settings, original) {
            const $host = $(this);

            var fieldsWithTabHandler = ['guests_amount', 'down_payment', 'cleaning_tax', 'fire_insurance_cost'];
            if (fieldsWithTabHandler.indexOf(fieldId) !== -1) {
                var tabHandler = setupEditableTabHandler(fieldId);
                tabHandler.call(this, settings, original);
            }

            if (hasCurrency) $host.closest('.data_field_subbox').css('gap', '0');
            $(document).off(`click.${fieldId}value`).on(`click.${fieldId}value`, function (e) {
                    var $form = $host.find('form');
                    if (!$form.length) return;
                    
                    var $fieldBox = $host.closest('.data_field_subbox');
                    var $parentBox = $host.closest('.new_box_field_data');
                    var $currencySelector = hasCurrency ? $('#' + fieldId + '_currency_selector') : null;

                    var inField = $fieldBox.is(e.target) || $fieldBox.has(e.target).length > 0;
                    var inParent = $parentBox.is(e.target) || $parentBox.has(e.target).length > 0;
                    var inCurrency = $currencySelector && ($currencySelector.is(e.target) || $currencySelector.has(e.target).length > 0);
                    
                    if (!inField && !inParent && !inCurrency) {
                    setTimeout(function () { $form.trigger('submit'); }, 0);
                    }
            });
        },
        onsubmit: function(settings, original) {
            var $input = $(this).find('input');
            if ($input.length === 0) return true;
            
            var normalizedNew = normalizePriceNumber($input.val());
            var normalizedOriginal = $(original).data('original-normalized-value') || '';
            
            if (normalizedNew === normalizedOriginal) {
                if (options.integer) {
                    return normalizedOriginal || '';
                } else {
                    var originalValue = normalizedOriginal ? parseFloat(normalizedOriginal) : 0;
                    return originalValue.toLocaleString('es-AR');
                }
            }
            $(document).off(`click.${fieldId}value`);
            return true;
        }
    };
   
    // Add maxValue validation and integer validation if specified
    if (options.maxValue || options.integer) {
        var originalOnEdit = editableConfig.onedit;
        editableConfig.onedit = function(settings, original) {
            originalOnEdit.call(this, settings, original);
            setTimeout(function() {
                var $host = $(this);
                var input = $host.find('.editable-input input, .editable-input textarea');
                if (input.length > 0) {
                    input.on('input keyup', function(e) {
                        var currentValue = parseFloat($(this).val());
                        
                        if (options.maxValue && !isNaN(currentValue) && currentValue > options.maxValue) {
                            $(this).val(options.maxValue);
                        }
                        
                        if (options.integer) {
                            var cleanValue = $(this).val().replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');
                            if ($(this).val() !== cleanValue) {
                                $(this).val(cleanValue);
                            }
                        }
                    });
                    
                    if (options.integer) {
                        input.on('keypress', function(e) {
                            var allowedKeys = [8, 9, 13, 46]; 
                            var keyCode = e.which || e.keyCode;
                            if (allowedKeys.indexOf(keyCode) !== -1 || 
                                (keyCode >= 48 && keyCode <= 57)) { // 0-9
                                return true;
                            }
                            e.preventDefault();
                            return false;
                        });
                    }
                }
            }.bind(this), 10);
        }
    }
    
    $('#' + fieldId).editable(function(value, settings) {
        const withCurrency = options.hasCurrencySelector ? true : false;
        
        let fieldCurrencySelected;
        let persistedCurrency;
        let fieldCurrencyBtn;
        let currencySelector;

        if (withCurrency) {
            currencySelector = $(`#${fieldId}_currency_selector`);
            fieldCurrencySelected = $(`#${fieldId}_currency_selector .currency-selected`).attr('data-currency-code');
            fieldCurrencyBtn = $(`#${fieldId}_currency_selector .currency-dropdown__btn`);
            persistedCurrency = currencySelector.attr('data-selected-currency');
            fieldCurrencyBtn.removeClass('edition_mode');
            $(this).closest('.data_field_subbox').css('gap', '8px');
        }
        var normalized = normalizePriceNumber(value);
        var normalizedOriginal = $(this).data('original-normalized-value') || '';

        const needReturnSameValue = (withCurrency) ? (normalized === normalizedOriginal && fieldCurrencySelected === persistedCurrency) : (normalized === normalizedOriginal);
        if (needReturnSameValue) {
            if (options.integer) {
                return normalizedOriginal || '';
            } else {
                var originalValue = normalizedOriginal ? parseFloat(normalizedOriginal) : 0;
                return originalValue.toLocaleString('es-AR');
            }
        }
        
        
        let cleanValue = value.trim();
        
        var numValue;

        if (options.integer) {
            var integerValue = cleanValue.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');
            numValue = parseInt(integerValue) || 0;
        } else {
            var hasComma = cleanValue.indexOf(',') !== -1;
            var hasDot = cleanValue.indexOf('.') !== -1;
            var lastCommaPos = cleanValue.lastIndexOf(',');
            var lastDotPos = cleanValue.lastIndexOf('.');
            
            if (hasComma && hasDot) {
                if (lastCommaPos > lastDotPos) {
                    numValue = parseFloat(cleanValue.replace(/\./g,'').replace(',','.'));
                } else {
                    numValue = parseFloat(cleanValue.replace(/,/g,''));
                }
            } else if (hasComma && !hasDot) {
                numValue = parseFloat(cleanValue.replace(',','.'));
            } else if (!hasComma && hasDot) {
                var dotPos = cleanValue.indexOf('.');
                var digitsAfterDot = cleanValue.length - dotPos - 1;
                
                if (digitsAfterDot === 3 && cleanValue.length > 4) {
                    numValue = parseFloat(cleanValue.replace(/\./g,''));
                } else {
                    numValue = parseFloat(cleanValue);
                }
            } else {
                numValue = parseFloat(cleanValue);
            }
        }

        let savePayload = withCurrency ? {value: numValue, currency: fieldCurrencySelected} : numValue;
        if (withCurrency) currencySelector.attr('data-selected-currency', savePayload.currency);

        if (isNaN(numValue)) {
            savePayload = withCurrency ? {value: 0} : 0;
            $(this).closest('.data_field_subbox.editFieldContainer').addClass('is_empty');
            save(saveKey, withCurrency ? JSON.stringify(savePayload) : savePayload);
            return 0;
        } else {
            if (options.maxValue && numValue > options.maxValue) {
                savePayload = withCurrency ? {value: options.maxValue} : options.maxValue;
            }
            $(this).closest('.data_field_subbox.editFieldContainer').toggleClass('is_empty', numValue === 0);
            save(saveKey, withCurrency ? JSON.stringify(savePayload) : savePayload);
                        
            setConsistentCurrencyForUniven(saveKey);
                
            // Format return value differently for integers
            if (options.integer) {
                return numValue.toString();
            } else {
                return numValue.toLocaleString('es-AR');
            }
        }
    }, editableConfig);
}

function normalizePriceNumber(str) {
    if (!str) return '';
    str = String(str).trim();

    if (str.indexOf('.') !== -1 && str.indexOf(',') !== -1) {
        if (str.lastIndexOf(',') > str.lastIndexOf('.')) {
            str = str.replace(/\./g, '').replace(',', '.');
        } else {
            str = str.replace(/,/g, '');
        }
    } else if (str.indexOf(',') !== -1) {
        str = str.replace(/\./g, ''); 
        str = str.replace(',', '.');
    } else {
        var parts = str.split('.');
        if (parts.length > 2) {
            str = str.replace(/\./g, '');
        }
    }
    return str;
}

        const prevHeight = body.style.height;
        const prevOverflow = body.style.overflow;

        body.style.height = 'auto';
        body.style.overflow = 'hidden';

        const end = body.getBoundingClientRect().height;

        const parent = body.closest('.new_file_box_container');
        if (parent) {
          let shouldBeZero = end <= 4;
          
          if (shouldBeZero && parent.classList.contains('collapsed_file')) {
            const operationBlocks = ['sale_operation_block', 'rent_operation_block', 'temporary_rent_operation_block'];
            const nonEmptySections = parent.querySelectorAll('.new_cotization_box_content .editFieldsSection:not(.is_empty)');
            
            let hasNonEmptySectionOutsideOperations = false;
            nonEmptySections.forEach(function(section) {
              const isInOperationBlock = operationBlocks.some(function(blockId) {
                return section.closest('#' + blockId) !== null;
              });
              if (!isInOperationBlock) {
                hasNonEmptySectionOutsideOperations = true;
              }
            });
            
            if (hasNonEmptySectionOutsideOperations) {
              shouldBeZero = false;
            }
          }
          
          parent.classList.toggle('body_is_zero', shouldBeZero);
        }

        body.style.height = prevHeight;
        body.style.overflow = prevOverflow;

        this.active++;

      //Function to validate if all items are selected
      function validateIfIsAllSelections() {
        var totalItems = $('.multi-select-checkbox').length;

        if (totalItems <= 1) {
          $('.select-all-pic-container').hide();
          return;
        } else{
          $('.select-all-pic-container').show();
        }

        var checkedItems = $('.multi-select-checkbox:checked').length;
        var parent = $('#select_multiple_photos_checkbox');
  
        if (checkedItems === 0) {
          parent.prop('checked', false);
          parent.prop('indeterminate', false);
          return;
        }

        if (totalItems === 0) {
          parent.prop('checked', false);
          parent.prop('indeterminate', false);
          return;
        }
  
        if (checkedItems > 0 && checkedItems < totalItems) {
          parent.prop('checked', false);
          parent.prop('indeterminate', true);
          return;
        }
  
        if (checkedItems === totalItems) {
          parent.prop('checked', true);
          parent.prop('indeterminate', false);
        } else {
          parent.prop('checked', false);
          parent.prop('indeterminate', false);
        }
      }

    // Función para actualizar la visibilidad de los checkboxes
    function updateCheckboxVisibility() {
      if (photos_selections.length > 0) {
        // Si hay alguna selección, mostramos todos los checkboxes
        $('.multi-select-checkbox,.checkbox_selection_bg').fadeIn();
      } else {
        // Si no hay selección, ocultamos los checkboxes de los ítems que no estén en hover
        $('.fileuploader-item').each(function(){
          if (!$(this).is(':hover')) {
            $(this).find('.multi-select-checkbox,.checkbox_selection_bg').fadeOut();
          }
        });
      }
      validateIfIsAllSelections();

    }


    // Mostrar el checkbox al hacer hover sobre el ítem
    $(document).on('mouseenter', '.fileuploader-item', function() {
      $(this).find('.multi-select-checkbox,.checkbox_selection_bg').fadeIn();
    });

    // Ocultar el checkbox al salir del hover, si no hay selección global
    $(document).on('mouseleave', '.fileuploader-item', function() {
      if (photos_selections.length === 0) {
        $(this).find('.multi-select-checkbox,.checkbox_selection_bg').fadeOut();
      }
    });

    // Evento change para actualizar el arreglo y la visibilidad de checkboxes
    $(document).on('change', '.multi-select-checkbox', function() {
      var id = $(this).attr('id');
      if ($(this).is(':checked')) {
        photos_selections.push(id);
      } else {
        photos_selections = photos_selections.filter(function(item) {
          return item !== id;
        });
      }
      var selection_footer = $('#fixed-bottom-container');
      if (photos_selections.length > 0) {
        selection_footer.fadeIn();
      } else {
        selection_footer.fadeOut();
      }
      updateCheckboxVisibility();
    });

    // Evento click para eliminar imagenes de manera múltiple
    
    $('#delete_selected_btn_submit').click(function () {
      if (photos_selections.length > 0) {
        var imageText = photos_selections.length === 1 ? " Imagen" : " Imágenes";
        $('body').addClass('modal-open')
        $('#image_count_label').text(imageText.toLowerCase());
        $('#deleteConfirmModal').fadeIn();
        $('#num_imgs_to_delete').text(photos_selections.length);
      }
    });
    
    
    // Cerrar el modal al hacer click en la "X" o en el botón de cancelar
    $('#cancelDelete, .modal_multiple_deletion-close').click(function() {
      $('body').removeClass('modal-open')
      $('#deleteConfirmModal').fadeOut();
    });
    
    // Evento para confirmar la eliminación
    
    $('#confirmMultipleDeletion').click(function () {
      $('#confirmMultipleDeletion').prop('disabled', true);

      $.ajax('/multiuploader/property/photo/delete?id=' + photos_selections.join(','))
      .done(function () {
          photos_selections.forEach(function (id) {
            $('#photo-item-' + id).fadeOut(400, function () {
              $(this).remove();
            });
          });
          const totalItems = $('.multi-select-checkbox').length;
          if(photos_selections.length === totalItems || photos_selections.length === totalItems - 1){
            $('.select-all-pic-container').fadeOut();
          }
          photos_selections = [];
          $('#fixed-bottom-container').fadeOut();
          updateCheckboxVisibility();
          $('#select_multiple_photos_checkbox').prop('checked', false);
          $('#select_multiple_photos_checkbox').prop('indeterminate', false);
        })
        .always(function() {
          $('body').removeClass('modal-open')
          $('#deleteConfirmModal').fadeOut();
          $('#confirmMultipleDeletion').prop('disabled', false);
        });
    });
    

    $('#undo_selection_btn_submit').click(function () {
        photos_selections = [];
        $('#fixed-bottom-container').fadeOut();
        $('.multi-select-checkbox:checked').prop('checked', false)
        updateCheckboxVisibility();
    })

    $('#download_selected_btn_submit').click(function () {
      const downloadButton = $(this);
      downloadButton.addClass('disabled');
      $('#loading_download_photos').css('display', 'block');
      
      if (photos_selections.length > 0) {
        var cleanIds = photos_selections.map(function(id) {
          return String(id).trim();
        }).filter(function(id) {
          return id.length > 0;
        });
        
        if (cleanIds.length > 0) {
          var downloadUrl = '/multiuploader/property/8002445/photo/download_zip?ids=' + cleanIds.join(',');
          
          fetch(downloadUrl)
            .then(function(response) {
              if (!response.ok) {
                throw new Error('Download failed');
              }
              return response.blob();
            })
            .then(function(blob) {
              var url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
              var a = document.createElement('a');
              a.style.display = 'none';
              a.href = url;
              a.download = 'property_' + property_id + '_photos.zip';
              document.body.appendChild(a);
              a.click();
              
              setTimeout(function() {
                window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
                document.body.removeChild(a);
                $('#loading_download_photos').css('display', 'none');
                downloadButton.removeClass('disabled');
              }, 100);
            })
            .catch(function(error) {
              console.error('Download error:', error);
              $('#loading_download_photos').css('display', 'none');
              downloadButton.removeClass('disabled');
            });
        } else {
          $('#loading_download_photos').css('display', 'none');
          downloadButton.removeClass('disabled');
        }
      } else {
        $('#loading_download_photos').css('display', 'none');
        downloadButton.removeClass('disabled');
      }
    });

    });
  });


</script>

<script type="text/javascript">

  var imageEditor = window.Lollipop.setOptions({
    path: "/lollipop/index.html",
    appendTo: "body",
    gallery_icon: false,
    camera_icon: false,
    save_icon: true,
    share_icon: false,
    enabledCORS: false,
    getImageUrl: "/multiuploader/get_photo",
    onSave: function (data, extension) {
      sendImageToServer(data, extension);
    }
  });

  // Función para comprimir imagen usando canvas y convertir a blob
  function compressImageToBlob(base64Data, maxSizeKB, callback) {
    var img = new Image();
    img.onload = function() {
      var canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
      var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
      
      // Calcular dimensiones óptimas
      var maxWidth = 1200;
      var maxHeight = 900;
      var width = img.width;
      var height = img.height;
      
      // Redimensionar si es necesario
      if (width > height) {
        if (width > maxWidth) {
          height = height * (maxWidth / width);
          width = maxWidth;
        }
      } else {
        if (height > maxHeight) {
          width = width * (maxHeight / height);
          height = maxHeight;
        }
      }
      
      canvas.width = width;
      canvas.height = height;
      ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, width, height);
      
      // Comprimir con calidad ajustable
      var maxSizeBytes = maxSizeKB * 1024;
      var minQuality = 0.3;
      var maxQuality = 0.9;
      var quality = maxQuality;
      
      function tryCompress() {
        canvas.toBlob(function(blob) {
          if (blob.size <= maxSizeBytes || quality <= minQuality) {
            callback(blob);
          } else {
            quality -= 0.1;
            tryCompress();
          }
        }, 'image/jpeg', quality);
      }
      
      tryCompress();
    };
    img.src = base64Data;
  }

  // Función para enviar imagen al servidor
  function sendImageToServer(data, extension) {
    window.Lollipop.image.src = data;
    
    // Comprimir imagen a máximo 800KB para evitar problemas con nginx
    compressImageToBlob(data, 800, function(blob) {
      var formData = new FormData();
      formData.append('image_file', blob, 'edited_image.jpg');
      formData.append('photo_id', photo_id);
      
      window.$.ajax({
        type: 'POST',
        url: '/multiuploader/property/8002445/photo/edit',
        data: formData,
        processData: false,
        contentType: false,
        beforeSend: function() {
          $(".lollipop-bg-loading").fadeIn();
          $(".uil-ripple-css").show();
        },
        success: function (response) {
          $(".lollipop-bg-loading").hide();
          $("#lollipop-editor-container").fadeOut();
          Lollipop.close()
          var file = response.files[0];
          if (!file) {
            return;
          }
          var imgElement = $("#pphoto-"+file.id);
          
          var thumbnailUrl = file.thumbnail || file.file;
          var originalUrl = file.original;
          
          var photoItem = imgElement.closest('.fileuploader-item');
          
          photoItem.hide();
          
          imgElement.attr('src', thumbnailUrl);
          imgElement.data('original', originalUrl);
          
          imgElement[0].style.display = 'none';
          imgElement[0].offsetHeight; 
          imgElement[0].style.display = '';
          
          photoItem.show();
          
        },
        error: function(xhr, status, error) {
          $(".lollipop-bg-loading").hide();
          $("#lollipop-editor-container").fadeOut();
          Lollipop.close();
          console.error("Error al enviar la imagen editada:", error);

        }
      });
    });
  }


  function open_image_editor(data) {
    photo_id = data;
    var img = new Image();
    img.src = $('#pphoto-' + data).data("original");
    img.onload = function () {
        imageEditor.open({
          image_url: this.src
        }, this);
      }

  }

  function selectAllPhotos(checkbox) {
    if (checkbox.checked) {
      $('.multi-select-checkbox').each(function() {
        if (!$(this).is(':checked')) {
          $(this).prop('checked', true).trigger('change');
        }
      });
    } else {
      $('.multi-select-checkbox').each(function() {
        if ($(this).is(':checked')) {
          $(this).prop('checked', false).trigger('change');
        }
      });
    }
  }

</script>

<script>
var regEx = 1;
var OTHERS_PROVIDER_NAME = 'Otro';
var STATIC_URL = "https://static.tokkobroker.com/";

function display_video_form(video_pk) {
  $(".addnewvideo_title").hide();
  $("#add_video").appendTo($("#property_video_" + video_pk)).hide().slideDown("slow");
}

function showInputMsjError(input_id, error_msj_id, elem_to_hide_id=null) {
  var error_msj = $("#" + error_msj_id);
  if (error_msj.css('display') !== "none") return;
  var input = $("#" + input_id);
  input.addClass("input-video-error");
  error_msj.show();
  if (elem_to_hide_id) {
    $("#" + elem_to_hide_id).hide();
  }
}


function reappend_form(options) {
  var slow = true;
  var reopen = true;
  if (options && options.slow === false) {
    slow = false;
  }
  if (options && options.reopen === false) {
    reopen = false;
  }

  $("#btnAddVideo").val("Cargar video");
  $("#video_pk").val("0");
  $("#video_title").val("");
  $("#video_provider_logo").attr("src", "");
  $('#video_id').val("");
  $("#video_url_input").val("");
  $("#proveedor_name").text("");
  $("#video_provider").val("");
  $(".video_proveedor_name").hide();
  $("#video_description").val("");
  $(".addnewvideo_title").show();
  $("#btnAddVideo").addClass("disabled");
  matchProviderId();
  if (reopen){
    $("#addnewvideo").fadeOut();
  }

  if (slow) {
    $("#add_video").appendTo($("#property_video_form")).hide().slideDown("slow");
  } else {
    $("#add_video").appendTo($("#property_video_form")).hide().show();
  }
  
  if (!reopen) {
    $("#add_video").hide();
    $("#addnewvideo").show();
  }
}

function validate_video_data() {
  const regex = /^(https?:\/\/|www\.)[^ ]*\.[^ ]+$/i;
  const video_url = $("#video_url_input").val();
  if ($("#video_title").val() == "") {
    showInputMsjError("video_title","title_input_text_error");
    return false;
  }
  if ($("#video_id").val() == "" || !regex.test(video_url)) {
    showInputMsjError("video_url_input","url_input_text_error","url_video_suggestion");
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}

function add_update_video() {
  var inputValue = $("#video_pk").val();
  if (inputValue == 0) {
    add_new_video();
  } else {
    update_video();
  }
}

function add_new_video() {
  $("#btnAddVideo").val("Cargar video");
  if (validate_video_data()) {
    var data = {
      'property_id': 8002445,
      'title': $("#video_title").val(),
      'video_id': $('#video_id').val(),
      'provider': $("#video_provider").val(),
      'description': $("#video_description").val()
    };

    $.ajax({
      'url': '/property/add_property_video',
      'type': 'POST',
      'data': data
    }).done(function(request) {
      eval("video_info = " + request);
      showToast(`Cargaste un video`)
      var video_html = "<li class='item_video_uploaded' id='property_video_" + video_info['id'] + "'>";
      video_html += "<div class='prop_videohead'>";
      video_html += "<div class='prop_videotitle'>" + video_info['title'] + "</div>";
      
      video_html += "<div class='prop_videoactions' onclick='delete_video_dialogue(" + video_info['id'] + ")'><i class='icon-eliminar'></i></div>";
      video_html += "<div class='prop_videoactions' onclick='update_video_dialogue(" + video_info['id'] + ")'><i class='icon-editar'></i></div>";
      
      video_html += "<a class='prop_videoactions' href='" + video_info['url'] + "' target='_blank'><i class='fa fa-play-circle' style='font-size:20px'></i></a>";
      video_html += "</div>";
      video_html += "<div class='prop_videodata'>Proveedor: " + video_info['provider'] + " | Video id: " + video_info["video_id"] + "</div>";
      video_html += "<div class='prop_videodesc'>" + video_info['description'] + "</div>";
      video_html += "</li>";

      $("#property_videos_list").append(video_html);

      reappend_form({
        slow: false,
        reopen: true
      });
  
    });
  }
}

function delete_video(video_pk) {
  var $video_li = $("#property_video_" + video_pk);
  // Si el formulario de edición está dentro del li, lo extraemos y lo reinsertamos en el contenedor principal.
  if ($video_li.find("#add_video").length) {
      $("#add_video").detach().appendTo($("#property_video_form"));
  }
  $.ajax('/property/delete_property_video?property_id=8002445&video_pk=' + video_pk)
  .done(function() {
    showToast(`Borraste un video`);
    $video_li.remove();
  });
}

function delete_video_dialogue(video_pk) {
  var message = $('<p />', { text: '' }),
      reason_text = $('<span />', { text: 'Esta seguro que desea borrar este video? ' }),
      ok = $('<button />', {
                text: 'Ok',
                'class': 'twobtnpopup',
                click: function() { 
                  delete_video(video_pk);
                  var video_count = $(".item_video_uploaded").length;
                  if (video_count == 1) {
                     reappend_form({
                      slow: false,
                      reopen: true});
                     }
                }
              }),
      cancel = $('<button />', {
                text: 'Cancel',
                click: function() {}
              });

  dialogue(message.add(reason_text).add(ok).add(cancel), "¿Estás seguro?");
}

function update_video() {
  if (validate_video_data()) {
    var data = {
      'property_id': 8002445,
      'video_pk': $("#video_pk").val(),
      'title': $("#video_title").val(),
      'video_id': $('#video_id').val(),
      'provider': $("#video_provider").val(),
      'description': $("#video_description").val()
    };
    $.ajax({
      'url': '/property/update_property_video',
      'type': 'POST',
      'data': data
    }).done(function(request) {
      eval("video_info = " + request);
      showToast(`Actualizaste un video`)
      reappend_form({reopen: false,slow: false});
      var video_html = "";
      video_html += "<div class='prop_videohead'>";
        video_html += "<div class='prop_videotitle'>" + video_info['title'] + "</div>";
        
        video_html += "<div class='prop_videoactions' onclick='delete_video_dialogue(" + video_info['id'] + ")'><i class='icon-eliminar'></i></div>";
        video_html += "<div class='prop_videoactions' onclick='update_video_dialogue(" + video_info['id'] + ")'><i class='icon-editar'></i></div>";
        
        video_html += "<a class='prop_videoactions' href='" + video_info['url'] + "' target='_blank'><i class='fa fa-play-circle' style='font-size:20px'></i></a>";
        video_html += "</div>";
        video_html += "<div class='prop_videodata'>Proveedor: " + video_info['provider'] + " | Video id: " + video_info["video_id"] + "</div>";
        video_html += "<div class='prop_videodesc'>" + video_info['description'] + "</div>";
        $("#property_video_" + video_info['id']).html(video_html);
    });
  }
}

function update_video_dialogue(video_pk) {
  $("#btnAddVideo").val("Actualizar")
  $("#btnAddVideo").removeClass("disabled");
  $("#video_title").val("");
  $('#video_id').val("");
  $("#video_provider").val("");
  $("#video_description").val("");
  $("#video_pk").val("");

  $.ajax('/property/get_property_video?property_id=8002445&video_pk=' + video_pk)
  .done(function(request) {
    eval("update_video_info = " + request);
    $("#video_title").val(update_video_info["title"]);
    $('#video_id').val(update_video_info["video_id"]);
    $("#video_provider").val(update_video_info["provider_id"]);
    $("#video_description").val(update_video_info["description"]);
    $("#video_pk").val(video_pk);
    let video_full_url = update_video_info["video_id"];
    if(update_video_info['provider'] != OTHERS_PROVIDER_NAME) {
      video_full_url = multimedia_provider_data[update_video_info['provider_id']]["url"].replace("%s", update_video_info["video_id"]);
    } 
    $("#video_url_input").val(video_full_url);
    matchProviderId(update_video_info["provider_id"]);
  });

  display_video_form(video_pk);
  scrollToAnchor("property_video_" + video_pk);
}

$(document).ready(function() {
  $("#btnAddVideo").addClass("disabled");
  $("#addnewvideo").click(function() {
  reappend_form();
  });

  $(".close_icon_form").click(function() {
    $("#add_video").slideUp("slow");
    $("#addnewvideo").show();
  });

  $("#video_url_input").change(function() {
    let input_value = $("#video_url_input").val();
    let provider_id = get_prover_id_by_url(input_value);  
    matchProviderId(provider_id);
    get_video_id(input_value);
    if(input_value !== "") {
      $(".video_proveedor_name").fadeIn();
      $("#btnAddVideo").removeClass("disabled");      
    } else {
      $(".video_proveedor_name").hide();
      $("#btnAddVideo").addClass("disabled");
    }
  });

  $("#video_url_input").keyup(function() {
    if ($("#url_input_text_error").css('display') !== "none") {
      $("#url_input_text_error").hide();
      $("#url_video_suggestion").show();
      $("#video_url_input").removeClass("input-video-error");
    }
  });

  $("#video_title").keyup(function() {
    if ($("#title_input_text_error").css('display') !== "none") {
      $("#title_input_text_error").hide();
      $("#video_title").removeClass("input-video-error");
    }
  });
});

function matchProviderId(id) {
  if (!id) {
    id = Object.entries(multimedia_provider_data)
    .find(([, provider]) => (provider.name == OTHERS_PROVIDER_NAME))[0];
  }
  let provider = multimedia_provider_data[id];
  let provider_logo_url = STATIC_URL + provider["logo"]; 
  let provider_url = provider["url"].replace("%s", "");
  let provider_placeholder = provider["placeholder"];
  let provider_help = provider["help"];
  let provider_name = provider["name"];
  $("#video_provider").val(id);
  $("#multimedia_url_provider").text(provider_url);
  $("#video_url_input").attr("placeholder", provider_placeholder);
  $("#provider_help").attr("href", provider_help);
  $("#proveedor_name").text(provider_name);
  $("#video_provider_logo").attr("src", provider_logo_url);
  if (provider_name !== OTHERS_PROVIDER_NAME) {
    $("#video_provider_logo").show();
  } else {
    $("#video_provider_logo").hide();
  }
}

function get_video_id(input_url) {
  const provider_id = $("#video_provider").val();
  const provider = multimedia_provider_data[provider_id];

  if (!provider) {
    $("#video_id").val(input_url);
    return;
  }

  const alternatives = provider.alter || [];
  const all_urls_to_check = [provider.url, ...alternatives];

  let video_id = input_url;

  for (let base of all_urls_to_check) {
    const base_clean = base.replace('%s', '');
    if (base_clean !== "" && input_url.includes(base_clean)) {
      video_id = input_url.split(base_clean)[1];
      break;
    }
  }

  $("#video_id").val(video_id || input_url);
}

function scrollToAnchor(aid) {
  var aTag = $("#" + aid);
  $('html,body').animate({ scrollTop: aTag.offset().top }, 'slow');
}

function get_prover_id_by_url(url) {
  try {
    const normalizedUrl = url.toLowerCase().replace(/:\/\//, "://");

    for (const [id, provider] of Object.entries(multimedia_provider_data)) {
      if (provider.name === OTHERS_PROVIDER_NAME) continue;

      const baseUrl = provider.url.replace('%s', '').toLowerCase().replace(/:\/\//, "://");

      // Match contra URL base principal
      if (normalizedUrl.includes(baseUrl)) return id;

      // Match contra alternativas
      if (provider.alter && Array.isArray(provider.alter)) {
        for (const alt of provider.alter) {
          const altNormalized = alt.replace('%s', '').toLowerCase().replace(/:\/\//, "://");
          if (normalizedUrl.includes(altNormalized)) return id;
        }
      }
    }

    return null;
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("Error in get_prover_id_by_url:", e);
    return null;
  }
}

<script>

    // Initialize the jQuery File Upload widget:    
    $('#fileuploadfiles').fileupload({dropZone: $('#fileuploadfiles')});

    // Load existing files:
    $.getJSON($('#fileuploadfiles form').prop('action') + '&get_files=true', function (files) {
        var fu = $('#fileuploadfiles').data('fileupload');
        fu._adjustMaxNumberOfFiles(-files.length);
        fu._renderDownload(files)
            .appendTo($('#fileuploadfiles .files'))
            .fadeIn(function () {
                // Fix for IE7 and lower:
                $(this).show();
            });
            var files = document.querySelectorAll('.template-download');
            if (files?.length > 0) {
                document.getElementById('without_files_text').style.display = 'none';
            }
    });
    $('#fileuploadfiles .files a:not([target^=_blank])').live('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        $('<iframe style="display:none;"></iframe>')
            .prop('src', this.href)
            .appendTo('body');
    });

});

$(".preview").disableSelection();

</script>

<script>

  function changeTabPortals(tab) {
    let tabsContentIds = [
      "property_portals-portal", 
      "property_portals-social",
      "property_portals_websites", 
      "property_portals-networks"
    ];

    if (tab < 1 || tab > tabsContentIds.length) {
        return;
    }

    let $tabsPortalsItems = $(".tab-portals-item");
    let $selected = $tabsPortalsItems.eq(tab - 1);
  
    if ($selected.hasClass("selected")) {
        return;
    }

    let $prevSelected = $tabsPortalsItems.filter(".selected");
    $prevSelected.removeClass("selected");
    $selected.addClass("selected");  
    
  
    let newTabContentId = tabsContentIds[tab - 1];
    let visibleContentId = tabsContentIds.find(id => $(`#${id}`).is(':visible'));

    $(`#${newTabContentId}`).show();
    $(`#${visibleContentId}`).hide();

    if (tab == 1) {
      $(".publication_title_box").show();
      $("#info_company_no_portals").show();
      $("#zp_banner_container").show();
    }
    else {
      $(".publication_title_box").hide();

      $("#zp_banner_container").hide();
    }
  }

                        <% 
                            var isValidUrl = false;
                            if (url && url.trim() !== '') {
                                var urlWithoutProtocol = url.replace(/^https?:\/\//, '');
                                var urlParts = urlWithoutProtocol.split('/');
                                var hasPath = urlParts.length > 1 && urlParts[1] !== '';
                                var hasQueryOrHash = url.indexOf('?') !== -1 || url.indexOf('#') !== -1;
                                isValidUrl = hasPath || hasQueryOrHash;

                                    <% } %>
                                <% }else if(publication.get('portal_id') == 26){ %>
                                    <% if (index == 0){ %>

                                    <% }else if (index == 1){ %>
                                        <i class="isologo isologo-clarin"><img src="https://static.tokkobroker.com/static/img/appexchange/portales/inmuebles-iso.svg?20260505230046" alt="Inmuebles Clarín"></i>
                                    <% }else{ %>
                                        <i class="isologo isologo-buscainmueble"><img src="https://static.tokkobroker.com/static/img/appexchange/portales/buscainmueble-iso.svg?20260505230046" alt="Buscainmueble"></i>
                                    <% } %>
                                <% }else{ %>
                                    <i class="fa fa-eye"></i>
                                <% } %>
                            </a>
                        <% } %>
                    <% }) %>

                <div class="portals-dash-results-alertsitem tip"
                    oldtitle='
                        <% if (publication.get("quality")["quality_percentage"] < 100) { %>
                            <div style="text-align: left; padding:3px;">

            <% } %>
