<script>
const MELI_IDS = new Set(['1', '3', '10'])
const FROM_PROPERTY = '1' == '1'
let SELECTED_PORTAL_ID;
let donaChart;

function fillPerformanceTag(res){
  let performance_tag = document.getElementById('performance-tag')
  let performance_level = res.stats.performance.toLowerCase()
  if(performance_level != "sin dato"){
    let performance_class = "performance-" + performance_level;
    performance_tag.classList.add(performance_class);
    performance_tag.innerText = "Performance" + " " + res.stats.performance;
    if(performance_level == "alto"){
        performance_tag.dataset.originalTitle = "El aviso tiene un rendimiento más alto que el promedio de avisos similares de otros colegas, tomando en cuenta su exposición, visualizaciones e interesados."
    }else if(performance_level == "medio"){
        performance_tag.dataset.originalTitle = "El aviso tiene un rendimiento semejante al promedio de avisos similares de otros colegas, tomando en cuenta su exposición, visualizaciones e interesados." 
    }else{
        performance_tag.dataset.originalTitle = "El aviso tiene un rendimiento más bajo que el promedio de avisos similares de otros colegas, tomando en cuenta su exposición, visualizaciones e interesados." 
    }
  }else{
    performance_tag.classList.add("performance-empty")
    performance_tag.innerText = "Sin desempeño"
    performance_tag.dataset.originalTitle = "No contamos con estadísticas para realizar comparaciones porque tu aviso no fue publicado o fue publicado hace menos de 30 días y/o no hay otros avisos similares."
  }
}

function cleanPerformanceTag(){
  let performance_tag = document.getElementById('performance-tag')
  performance_tag.classList = "performance-tag heading-6"
  performance_tag.innerText = ""
}

function fillThreeTopics(res){
  if(!MELI_IDS.has(SELECTED_PORTAL_ID)){
    let exposure_number = document.getElementById('exposure-topic')
    exposure_number.innerText = res.stats.exposure.total
  }  

  let views_number = document.getElementById('views-topic')
  views_number.innerText = res.stats.views.total

  let interested_contacts_total_number = document.getElementById('contacts-topic')
  interested_contacts_total_number.innerText = res.stats.interested.total

  let sum_whatsapp_form = document.getElementById('contacts-subtotal')
  sum_whatsapp_form.innerText = res.stats.interested.form_contacts + res.stats.interested.whatsapp_contacts

  let saw_info_number = document.getElementById('contacts-saw-info')
  saw_info_number.innerText = res.stats.interested.seen_phone_contacts
}

const sentence_start = "Tu publicación tuvo "
const views_word = " visualizaciones"
const contacts_word = " interesados "
const views_finish = "sobre el total de exposición en resultados"
const contacts_finish = "sobre el total de visualizaciones"

function fillFunnelNumbers(res){
  if(!MELI_IDS.has(SELECTED_PORTAL_ID)){
    let funnel_first_number = document.getElementById('funnel-first-number')
    funnel_first_number.innerText = res.stats.exposure.view
  }
  let funnel_second_number = document.getElementById('funnel-second-number')
  funnel_second_number.innerText = res.stats.views.interested

  // tooltips texts / different for MELI or OpenNavent
  if(!MELI_IDS.has(SELECTED_PORTAL_ID)){
    document.querySelector('.funnel-title .icon-info').dataset.originalTitle = "Porcentaje de interesados tomando como base las visualizaciones y la exposición del aviso"

    let funnel_exposure_section = document.querySelector('.funnel-section.funnel-top')
    funnel_exposure_section.dataset.originalTitle = "La publicación tuvo una exposición total de " + res.stats.exposure.total

    let funnel_views_section = document.querySelector('.funnel-section.funnel-middle')
    funnel_views_section.dataset.originalTitle = sentence_start + res.stats.views.total + views_word + ` (${res.stats.exposure.view}) `+ views_finish

  }else{
    document.querySelector('.funnel-title .icon-info').dataset.originalTitle = "Porcentaje de interesados tomando como base las visualizaciones del aviso"
    let funnel_views_section = document.querySelector('.funnel-section.funnel-middle')
    funnel_views_section.dataset.originalTitle = sentence_start + res.stats.views.total + views_word
  }

  let funnel_interested_section = document.querySelector('.funnel-section.funnel-bottom')
  funnel_interested_section.dataset.originalTitle = sentence_start + res.stats.interested.total + contacts_word + ` (${res.stats.views.interested}) `+ contacts_finish

}

function fillDoughnutContactsChart(res){
  drawContactsDoughnutChart( res.stats.interested.form_contacts, res.stats.interested.whatsapp_contacts, res.stats.interested.seen_phone_contacts)
  
  let background_number = document.getElementById('doughnut-total')
  background_number.innerText = res.stats.interested.total
}

function cleanDoughnutContactsChart(){
  if(donaChart != undefined){
    donaChart.destroy();
    let background_number = document.getElementById('doughnut-total')
    background_number.innerText = ""
  }
}

function fillComparativeSubtitle(pub_data){

  let category = document.getElementById('comparative-subt-category')
  category.innerText = pub_data.category

  let operation = document.getElementById('comparative-subt-operation')
  operation.innerText = pub_data.operation.split(' ')[0]

  let location = document.getElementById('comparative-subt-location')
  location.innerText = pub_data.location
}

function fillComparativeTable(res){
  let first_row_left = document.getElementById('first-row-left')
  first_row_left.innerText = res.stats.exposure.segment

  let first_row_right = document.getElementById('first-row-right')
  first_row_right.innerText = res.stats.exposure.total

  let second_row_left = document.getElementById('second-row-left')
  second_row_left.innerText = res.stats.views.segment
  
  let second_row_right = document.getElementById('second-row-right')
  second_row_right.innerText = res.stats.views.total

  let third_row_left = document.getElementById('third-row-left')
  third_row_left.innerText = res.stats.exposure.view_segment
  
  let third_row_right = document.getElementById('third-row-right')
  third_row_right.innerText = res.stats.exposure.view

  let fourth_row_left = document.getElementById('fourth-row-left')
  let fourth_row_right = document.getElementById('fourth-row-right')
  fourth_row_left.innerText = res.stats.interested.segment
  fourth_row_right.innerText = res.stats.interested.total

  let fifth_row_left = document.getElementById('fifth-row-left')
  let fifth_row_right = document.getElementById('fifth-row-right')
  fifth_row_left.innerText = res.stats.views.interested_segment
  fifth_row_right.innerText = res.stats.views.interested
}

function cleanStatisticsNumbers(){
  document.querySelectorAll('#pub-stats-container .fill-data').forEach(el => el.innerText = "")
}

function drawContactsDoughnutChart(by_form, by_wsp, by_phone){
  let dona = document.getElementById('grafico-dona');
  let graph_data = [by_form, by_wsp, by_phone]
  let graph_colors = ['#4B80F3', '#9BBAFD', '#E5EDFA']
  let total = by_form + by_wsp + by_phone

  if(!MELI_IDS.has(SELECTED_PORTAL_ID)){
    graph_colors = ['#FF800B', '#FFA048', '#FFCFA3']
  }
  if(total == 0){
    graph_colors = ['#EFF3F5']
    graph_data = [1]
  }

  donaChart = new Chart(dona, {
    type: 'doughnut',
    data: {
      labels: ["Completaron el formulario", "Contactaron por WhatsApp", "Vieron tus datos"],
      datasets: [
        {
          data: graph_data,
          backgroundColor: graph_colors,
        }
      ]
    },
    options: {
        elements: {
            arc: {
                borderWidth: 0,
            }
        },
      animation: {
        onComplete: function() {
            document.querySelector('.stats-page .loader').style.display = "none"
            document.querySelector('#optional-table-row').style.display = ''
            document.querySelector('#publication-stats').style.display = ''
            document.querySelector('#publication-comparation').style.display = ''
        },
      },
      layout: {
        padding: {
          bottom: 44 
        }
      },
      responsive: true,
      maintainAspectRatio: false,
      plugins:{
        legend:{
          display: true,
          position: 'left',
          labels:{
            boxWidth: 29,
            boxHeight: 11,
            font:{
              family: 'Nunito Sans',
              size: 10.5
            }
          },
          onClick: null,
        },
        tooltip: {
          bodyFont: {
            size: 13
          },
          callbacks: {
            label: (context) => {
                if(total == 0){
                    return "Sin interesados"
                }
              return context.formattedValue + ' ' + context.label
            }
          },
          displayColors: false
        }
      }  
    },
  });
}

function loadPublicationStatistics(portal_id, pub_id, pub_data){
    document.querySelector('.stats-page .loader').style.display = ""
    document.querySelector('.stats-page .error-msg').style.display = "none"
    document.querySelector('#optional-table-row').style.display = 'none'
    document.querySelector('#publication-stats').style.display = 'none'
    document.querySelector('#publication-comparation').style.display = 'none'

    $.ajax({
        type: 'GET',
        url: `/portals/${portal_id}/publication/${pub_id}/stats_detail/`,
        success: function(res){
            SELECTED_PORTAL_ID = portal_id
            let stats_page = document.getElementById('pub-stats-container')
            stats_page.classList.remove('blue', 'orange')
            if(!MELI_IDS.has(SELECTED_PORTAL_ID)){
                stats_page.classList.add('orange')
            }else{
                stats_page.classList.add('blue')
            }

            if(!MELI_IDS.has(SELECTED_PORTAL_ID)){
                fillPerformanceTag(res)
                fillComparativeSubtitle(pub_data)
                fillComparativeTable(res)
            }
            fillThreeTopics(res)
            fillFunnelNumbers(res)
            
            if(!FROM_PROPERTY){
                let original_row = document.getElementById('pdash_row_'+pub_id)

                let row_category = document.getElementById('optional-row-category')
                row_category.innerText = original_row.querySelector('.pdash-category').innerText.trim()

                let row_price = document.getElementById('optional-row-price')
                row_price.innerText = original_row.querySelector('.pdash-operation').innerText.trim()

                let row_location = document.getElementById('optional-row-location')
                row_location.innerText = original_row.querySelector('.pdash-location').innerText.trim()

                let row_type = document.getElementById('optional-row-publication-type')
                row_type.innerText = original_row.querySelector('.pdash-starred').innerText.trim().toUpperCase() //que puede venir acá?

                let row_url = document.getElementById('optional-row-url')
                row_url.innerHTML = original_row.querySelector('.pdash-url').innerHTML 

                if(!MELI_IDS.has(SELECTED_PORTAL_ID) && original_row.querySelector('.pdash-pano') ){
                    let row_panoramic = document.getElementById('optional-row-panoramic')
                    row_panoramic.innerHTML = original_row.querySelector('.pdash-pano').innerHTML
                }
                showElement('#optional-table-row')
            }else{
                hideElement('#optional-table-row')
            }   
            
            fillDoughnutContactsChart(res);
        },
        error: function(){
            document.querySelector('.stats-page .loader').style.display = "none"
            document.querySelector('.stats-page .error-msg').style.display = ""
            if(document.querySelector('.stats-page').classList.contains('modal-version')){
                document.querySelector(' #pub-stats-close-modal').style.display = ""
                document.querySelector(' #pub-stats-go-back').style.display = "none"
            }else{
                document.querySelector(' #pub-stats-close-modal').style.display = "none"
                document.querySelector(' #pub-stats-go-back').style.display = ""
            }
        }})
}

function cleanPublicationStatistics(){
    if(!MELI_IDS.has(SELECTED_PORTAL_ID)) cleanPerformanceTag();
    cleanDoughnutContactsChart();
    cleanStatisticsNumbers();
}

function openPublicationStatsModal(portal_id, publication_id, pub_data){
  loadPublicationStatistics(portal_id, publication_id, pub_data)
  showElement('#property_portals .modal-overlay')
  document.querySelector("body").style.overflowY = "hidden"
  document.querySelector('.stats-page').style.display=""
  document.querySelector('.stats-page').style.height=""
  document.querySelector('#property_portals .modal-overlay').addEventListener('click', () => closePublicationStatsModal())
  document.querySelector('#property_portals .stats-page').addEventListener('click', function(e){
    e.stopPropagation();
  })

  window.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
    if (e.key == "Escape") {
        closePublicationStatsModal();
    }
  });
}

function closePublicationStatsModal(){
  document.querySelector('#property_portals .modal-overlay').removeEventListener('click', () => closePublicationStatsModal())
  document.querySelector('#property_portals .stats-page').removeEventListener('click', function(e){
    e.stopPropagation();
  })
  window.removeEventListener('keydown', function(e) { 
    if (e.key == "Escape") {
        closePublicationStatsModal();
    }
  });
  document.querySelector('.stats-page').style.display="none"
  document.querySelector('.stats-page').style.height="0px"
  hideElement('#property_portals .modal-overlay')
  document.querySelector("body").style.overflowY = "scroll"
  cleanPublicationStatistics()
}

</script>

  function _hidePuntosLoader() {

    }

  function _onPuntosComponentReady(mount, puntosElement, done) {
    _teardownPuntosLoadListener();
    var doneCalled = false;
    function runDone() {
      if (doneCalled) {
        return;
      }
      doneCalled = true;
      _teardownPuntosLoadListener();
      done();
    }
    if (!puntosElement) {
      setTimeout(function() { runDone(); }, 0);
      return;
    }
    var t = window.setTimeout(function() { runDone(); }, 12000);
    if (window.ResizeObserver) {
      var ro = new window.ResizeObserver(function() {
        if (puntosElement.offsetHeight > 72) {
          window.clearTimeout(t);
          runDone();
        }
      });
      ro.observe(puntosElement);
      if (puntosElement.offsetHeight > 72) {
        window.clearTimeout(t);
        runDone();
        return;
      }
      _puntosLoadTeardown = function() {
        ro.disconnect();
        window.clearTimeout(t);
      };
      return;
    }
    var poll = window.setInterval(function() {
      if (puntosElement.offsetHeight > 72) {
        window.clearTimeout(t);
        window.clearInterval(poll);
        runDone();
      }
    }, 150);
    _puntosLoadTeardown = function() {
      window.clearInterval(poll);
      window.clearTimeout(t);
    };
  }

  /**
   * Removes the previous puntos-ap script element and loads a fresh copy.
   * Re-executing the script forces Angular to re-bootstrap the component
   * against the new <puntos-ap> element in the DOM. The browser serves the

    mount.innerHTML = '';
    _teardownPuntosLoadListener();
    _showPuntosLoader();
    var el = document.createElement('puntos-ap');

    function renderToastMessage(instagramStatus) {

            1: `Publicaste la propiedad en Instagram`,
            2: `Hubo un error en la publicación, reintentá en unos minutos`
        }

        const message = possibleMessages[instagramStatus]

        const toastOptions = {}
        if (instagramStatus === 2) {
            toastOptions.variant = 'error'
            toastOptions.time = 10000
        }

        showToast(message, toastOptions)
    }

    function setViewOnPublications() {
        const entityType = "property";
        const propertyDiffusionTabSelector = '#tab5'
        const developmentDiffusionTabSelector = '#tab6'

        }

    function sanitizeInstagramStatus() {
        const url = new URL(window.location.href);
        url.searchParams.delete('instagram_status');
        window.history.pushState({}, '', url);
    }

    function handleInstagramStatus() {
        const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search)
        const instagramStatus = parseInt(urlParams.get('instagram_status'))
        const options = [1, 2]
        if (!options.includes(instagramStatus)) return

        sanitizeInstagramStatus()
        renderToastMessage(instagramStatus)
        setTimeout(function() {
            setViewOnPublications()
        }, 750)
    }

    $(document).ready(function() {
        handleInstagramStatus()
    })
</script>

<script>
    const publicationStatus = {
        NOT_PUBLISHED: 1,
        PUBLISHED: 2,
        DOWN: 3, // only used in the backend for internal management
        DELETED: 4,
        ARCHIVED: 5,
    }

    const postType = {
        single: 'Única',
        carrousel: 'Carrusel'
    }

    const statusText = {
        1: 'Sin publicar',
        2: 'Visible',
        3: '',
        4: 'Borrados',
        5: 'Archivado',
    }

    const statusClass = {
        1: 'not-pubished',
        2: 'visible',
        3: 'down',
        4: 'deleted',
        5: 'archived',
    }

    function showTableSkeletons() {
        $('.instagram_table_skeletons_wrapper').css('display', 'flex')
    }

    function hideTableSkeletons() {
        $('.instagram_table_skeletons_wrapper').css('display', 'none')
    }

    function showEmptyStateMessage() {
        $('.portal_card_publications').css('display', 'none');

        const portalCardEmpty = $("#instagram_li .portal_card_empty");

        if (entity_have_files) {
            const message = entityType === 'property'
                ? 'Esta propiedad no fue publicada en esta cuenta de Instagram'
                : 'Este emprendimiento no fue publicado en esta cuenta de Instagram';
            portalCardEmpty.css('display', 'block').text(message);
        } else {
            $('#instagram_li .cta_publish').prop('disabled', true);
            portalCardEmpty.css('display', 'none');
        }
    }

    function showTableLayout() {
        $('.instagram_publications_table_body').empty()
        $('#instagram_li .portal_card_publications').css('display', 'flex')
    }

    function getPublicationTypeContent(publication) {
        if (publication.status.id !== publicationStatus.PUBLISHED) return '-'
        return postType[publication.detail.media_type.toLowerCase().includes('carousel') ? 'carrousel' : 'single']
    }

    function getPublicationStatusContent(publication) {
        return `
            <p class="instagram_status instagram_status_${statusClass[publication.status.id]}">
                ${statusText[publication.status.id]}
            </p>
        `
    }

    function getPublicationInsights(publication) {
        const publicationEmptyInsights = `<p class="instagram_no_interactions">Sin interacciones disponibles</p>`

        const publicationFulfilledInsights = `
            <div class="instagram_statistics">
                <div class="instagram_statistics_item">
                    <img class="instagram_publication_icon" src="https://static.tokkobroker.com/static/img/igmegusta.svg?20260505230046" height="16" width="16" />
                    <p> ${publication.insights.likes} </p>
                </div>
                <div class="instagram_statistics_item">
                    <img class="instagram_publication_icon" src="https://static.tokkobroker.com/static/img/igcomentarios.svg?20260505230046" height="16" width="16" />
                    <p> ${publication.insights.comments} </p>
                </div>
                <div class="instagram_statistics_item">
                    <img class="instagram_publication_icon" src="https://static.tokkobroker.com/static/img/igenviar.svg?20260505230046" height="16" width="16" />
                    <p> ${publication.insights.shares} </p>
                </div>
                <div class="instagram_statistics_item">
                    <img class="instagram_publication_icon" src="https://static.tokkobroker.com/static/img/igguardar.svg?20260505230046" height="16" width="16" />
                    <p> ${publication.insights.saved} </p>
                </div>
            </div>
        `

        return publication.status.id === publicationStatus.PUBLISHED
            ? publicationFulfilledInsights
            : publicationEmptyInsights
    }

    function getPublicationActionButton(publication) {
        if ("True" === "False") {
            return ''
        }

        const publishedActionContent = `
            <a class="instagram_action_button" href="${publication.detail?.permalink}" target="_blank">
                Ver publicación
            </a>
        `
        const nonPublishedActionContent = `
            <a class="instagram_action_button" onclick="openInstagramDeleteRecordModal(${publication.id})">
                Eliminar registro
            </a>
        `

        return publication.status.id === publicationStatus.PUBLISHED
            ? publishedActionContent
            : nonPublishedActionContent
    }

    function showTableContent() {
        listOfPublications.forEach((publication, index) => {
            const row = `
                <div class="instagram_publications_table_row">
                    <div class="instagram_publications_table_body_item">
                        ${publication.priority || '-'}
                    </div>

                    <div class="instagram_publications_table_body_item">
                        ${getPublicationTypeContent(publication)}
                    </div>

                    <div class="instagram_publications_table_body_item">
                        ${publication.created_at}
                    </div>

                    <div class="instagram_publications_table_body_item">
                        ${getPublicationStatusContent(publication)}
                    </div>

                    <div class="instagram_publications_table_body_item">
                        ${getPublicationInsights(publication)}
                    </div>
                    
                    <div class="instagram_publications_table_body_item">
                        ${getPublicationActionButton(publication)}
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;

            $('.instagram_publications_table_body').append(row);
        });

        const skeletonsToHide = [1, 2]
        skeletonsToHide.forEach(skeleton => {
            const row = `<div style="display: none;" class="instagram_loading_more_skeletons_wrapper"><span></span></div>`
            $('.instagram_publications_table_body').append(row);
        })
    }

    function renderPublicationsTable() {
        const tableBody = $('.instagram_publications_table_body');
        tableBody.empty();

        if (listOfPublications?.length > 0) {
            showTableLayout();
            showTableContent();
            $('#instagram_li .cta_publish')
                .prop('disabled', !entity_have_files)
                .css('display', 'block')
                .css('opacity', 1)

            return;
        }

        showEmptyStateMessage()
    }

    async function initializeTable() {
        showTableSkeletons()

        try {
            if (!instagram_status.connected) return
            
            listOfPublications = await getInstagramPublications()
            renderPublicationsTable()
        } catch (error) {
            console.log(error)
        } finally {
            hideTableSkeletons()
        }
    }

    let tableIntervalId = setInterval(function() {
        if (!instagram_status.logging) {
          clearInterval(tableIntervalId)
          initializeTable()
        }
    }, 250);
</script>

    const inputs = ['#seo_title', '#seo_keywords', '#seo_description'];

    inputs.forEach(function(input) {
        var maxLength = $(input).attr('maxlength');
        var currentLength = $(input).val()?.length;
        var lengthIndicator = $(input).siblings('.length_indicator');
        if(currentLength > 0) {
            lengthIndicator.text(currentLength + '/' + maxLength);
        }
        $(input).on('input', function() {
            var value = $(this).val().trim();
            if (value.length > maxLength) {
                $(this).val(value.substring(0, maxLength));
            }
            lengthIndicator.text(value.length + '/' + maxLength);
        });
        
        $(input).on('blur', function(e) {
            if (e.originalEvent || e.relatedTarget) {
                save($(this).attr('id'), $(this).val().trim());
            }
        });
    });

<script>
    const hover_on_table_leads = () =>  {
        $("#table_contacts_leads tbody tr").hover(
            function hoverTrIn() {
                let trID = $(this).attr('id');
                if (!$("#"+trID+" td input").is(':checked')) {
                    $("#"+trID+" td:first-child").css("border-left", "1px solid #485C66")
                    $("#"+trID+" td:last-child").css("border-right", "1px solid #485C66")
                    $("#"+trID+" td").css("border-top", "1px solid #485C66")
                    $("#"+trID+" td").css("border-bottom", "1px solid #485C66")
                }
                $("#"+trID+" .icon").css("opacity", "1")
                $("#"+trID+" .icon").css("color", "#6F838D")
            },
            function hoverTrOut() {
                let trID = $(this).attr('id');
                if (!$("#"+trID+" td input").is(':checked')) {
                    $("#"+trID+" td:first-child").css("border-left", "1px solid #F0F0F0")
                    $("#"+trID+" td:last-child").css("border-right", "1px solid #F0F0F0")
                    $("#"+trID+" td").css("border-top", "1px solid #F0F0F0")
                    $("#"+trID+" td").css("border-bottom", "1px solid #F0F0F0")
                }
                $("#"+trID+" .icon").css("opacity", "0")
                $("#"+trID+" .icon").css("color", "")
            }
        )
    }

    let contacts_list_leads = [];
    const show_actions_on_selection_leads = () =>  {
        $('.property_contacts_leads_row').on('input', function() {
            if ($(this).is(':checked')) {
                !contacts_list_leads.includes($(this).val()) && contacts_list_leads.push($(this).val());
                let trID = $(this).attr('id');
                $("#"+trID+" td:first-child").css("border-left", "1px solid #C9D1D5")
                $("#"+trID+" td:last-child").css("border-right", "1px solid #C9D1D5")
                $("#"+trID+" td").css("border-top", "1px solid #C9D1D5")
                $("#"+trID+" td").css("border-bottom", "1px solid #C9D1D5")
            } else {
                contacts_list_leads = contacts_list_leads.filter((element) => element != $(this).val());
                let trID = $(this).attr('id');

    $("#all_contacts_leads").on("click", function(){

                contact_total_leads_pages = result.paginator.total_pages

<script>
    let potential_has_before_page = true
    let tags_flags = true
    let visibleTags = 0
    let hasLocationSame = false
    let countLocation = 0

    const hover_on_table_potential = () =>  {
        $(".card-potential-interested").hover(
            function hoverTrIn() {
                let trID = $(this).attr('id');
                if (!$("#"+trID+" td input").is(':checked')) {
                    $("#"+trID+" td:first-child").css("border-left", "1px solid #485C66")
                    $("#"+trID+" td:last-child").css("border-right", "1px solid #485C66")
                    $("#"+trID+" td").css("border-top", "1px solid #485C66")
                    $("#"+trID+" td").css("border-bottom", "1px solid #485C66")
                    $("#tags-"+trID+" td").css("border-left", "1px solid #485C66")
                    $("#tags-"+trID+" td").css("border-right", "1px solid #485C66")
                    $("#tags-"+trID+" td").css("border-bottom", "1px solid #485C66")
                }
                $("#"+trID+" .btn-actions").removeClass("d-none")
                $("#"+trID+" .status-sent-potential").hide()
                $("#"+trID+" .icon").css("opacity", "1")
            },
            function hoverTrOut() {
                let trID = $(this).attr('id');
                if (!$("#"+trID+" td input").is(':checked')) {
                    $("#"+trID+" td:first-child").css("border-left", "1px solid #F0F0F0")
                    $("#"+trID+" td:last-child").css("border-right", "1px solid #F0F0F0")
                    $("#"+trID+" td").css("border-top", "1px solid #F0F0F0")
                    $("#"+trID+" td").css("border-bottom", "1px solid #F0F0F0")
                    $("#tags-"+trID+" td").css("border-left", "1px solid #F0F0F0")
                    $("#tags-"+trID+" td").css("border-right", "1px solid #F0F0F0")
                    $("#tags-"+trID+" td").css("border-bottom", "1px solid #F0F0F0")
                }
                $("#"+trID+" .btn-actions").addClass("d-none")
                $("#"+trID+" .status-sent-potential").show()
                $("#"+trID+" .icon").css("opacity", "0")
            }
        )
    }

    let contacts_list_potential = [];
    let repeated_contacts_list_potential = [];
    const show_actions_on_selection_potential = () =>  {
        $('.property_contacts_potential_row').on('input', function() {
            if ($(this).is(':checked')) {
                !contacts_list_potential.includes($(this).val()) ? contacts_list_potential.push($(this).val()) : repeated_contacts_list_potential.push($(this).val());
                let trID = $(this).attr('id');
                $("#"+trID+" td:first-child").css("border-left", "1px solid #C9D1D5")
                $("#"+trID+" td:last-child").css("border-right", "1px solid #C9D1D5")
                $("#"+trID+" td").css("border-top", "1px solid #C9D1D5")
                $("#"+trID+" td").css("border-bottom", "1px solid #C9D1D5")
                $("#tags-"+trID+" td").css("border-left", "1px solid #C9D1D5")
                $("#tags-"+trID+" td").css("border-right", "1px solid #C9D1D5")
                $("#tags-"+trID+" td").css("border-bottom", "1px solid #C9D1D5")
            } else {
                if (repeated_contacts_list_potential.includes($(this).val())){
                    repeated_contacts_list_potential = repeated_contacts_list_potential.filter((element) => element != $(this).val())
                }else{
                    contacts_list_potential = contacts_list_potential.filter((element) => element != $(this).val())
                }
                let trID = $(this).attr('id');
                $("#"+trID+" td:first-child").css("border-left", "1px solid #F0F0F0")
                $("#"+trID+" td:last-child").css("border-right", "1px solid #F0F0F0")
                $("#"+trID+" td").css("border-top", "1px solid #F0F0F0")
                $("#"+trID+" td").css("border-bottom", "1px solid #F0F0F0")
                $("#tags-"+trID+" td").css("border-left", "1px solid #F0F0F0")
                $("#tags-"+trID+" td").css("border-right", "1px solid #F0F0F0")
                $("#tags-"+trID+" td").css("border-bottom", "1px solid #F0F0F0")
            }
            contacts_list_potential.length && $('#bottom-bar-items-count-potential').html(`
                <div style="font-size:16px; margin-right:5px">${contacts_list_potential.length}</div>
                contactos seleccionados
            `)
            let width = $("#property_contacts")[0].clientWidth
            $("#property_contacts_actions_potential").css("width", width )
            $("#items-limits-potential").css("width", width )
            contacts_list_potential.length > 1 ? $("#property_contacts_actions_potential").show() : $("#property_contacts_actions_potential").hide()
            selected_contacts_limit_validator()
        });
    }

    const selected_contacts_limit_validator = () => {
        if (contacts_list_potential.length > limit_contacts) {
            //$('#bottom-bar-items-count-potential').hide();
            $("#items-limits-potential").show();
            $(".send_mail_button").hide();
            $("#icon-alert").show()
        }
        else{
            $('#bottom-bar-items-count-potential').show();
            $("#items-limits-potential").hide();
            $(".send_mail_button").show();
            $("#icon-alert").hide()
        }
    }

    const clean_rows_selection_potential_table = () => {
        $("input:checkbox[name=potential_contact_row]").each(function() {
            $(this).prop('checked', false)
            let trID = $(this).attr('id');
            $("#"+trID+" td:first-child").css("border-left", "1px solid #F0F0F0")
            $("#"+trID+" td:last-child").css("border-right", "1px solid #F0F0F0")
            $("#"+trID+" td").css("border-top", "1px solid #F0F0F0")
            $("#"+trID+" td").css("border-bottom", "1px solid #F0F0F0")
            $("#tags-"+trID+" td").css("border-left", "1px solid #F0F0F0")
            $("#tags-"+trID+" td").css("border-right", "1px solid #F0F0F0")
            $("#tags-"+trID+" td").css("border-bottom", "1px solid #F0F0F0")
        });
        contacts_list_potential = [];
        $("#property_contacts_actions_potential").hide()
        $("#items-limits-potential").hide();
        $("#all_contacts_potential").prop('checked',false)
    }

    $("#all_contacts_potential").on("click", function(){
        if ($("#all_contacts_potential").prop('checked') == true) {
            $("input:checkbox[name=potential_contact_row]").each(function() {
                row_can_view = $(this).data('canview')
                if(!row_can_view){return}
                $(this).prop('checked', true)
                !contacts_list_potential.includes($(this).val()) ? contacts_list_potential.push($(this).val()) : repeated_contacts_list_potential.push($(this).val());
                let trID = $(this).attr('id');
                $("#"+trID+" td:first-child").css("border-left", "1px solid #C9D1D5")
                $("#"+trID+" td:last-child").css("border-right", "1px solid #C9D1D5")
                $("#"+trID+" td").css("border-top", "1px solid #C9D1D5")
                $("#"+trID+" td").css("border-bottom", "1px solid #C9D1D5")
                $("#tags-"+trID+" td").css("border-left", "1px solid #C9D1D5")
                $("#tags-"+trID+" td").css("border-right", "1px solid #C9D1D5")
                $("#tags-"+trID+" td").css("border-bottom", "1px solid #C9D1D5")
            });
        } else {
            $("input:checkbox[name=potential_contact_row]").each(function() {
                row_can_view = $(this).data('canview')
                if(!row_can_view){return}
                $(this).prop('checked', false)
                contacts_list_potential = contacts_list_potential.filter((element) => element != $(this).val());
                let trID = $(this).attr('id');
                $("#"+trID+" td:first-child").css("border-left", "1px solid #F0F0F0")
                $("#"+trID+" td:last-child").css("border-right", "1px solid #F0F0F0")
                $("#"+trID+" td").css("border-top", "1px solid #F0F0F0")
                $("#"+trID+" td").css("border-bottom", "1px solid #F0F0F0")
                $("#tags-"+trID+" td").css("border-left", "1px solid #F0F0F0")
                $("#tags-"+trID+" td").css("border-right", "1px solid #F0F0F0")
                $("#tags-"+trID+" td").css("border-bottom", "1px solid #F0F0F0")
            });
        }
        let width = $("#property_contacts")[0].clientWidth
        $("#property_contacts_actions_potential").css("width", width )
        $("#items-limits-potential").css("width", width )
        contacts_list_potential.length > 0 ? $("#property_contacts_actions_potential").show() : $("#property_contacts_actions_potential").hide()
        contacts_list_potential.length && $('#bottom-bar-items-count-potential').html(`
            <div style="font-size:16px; margin-right:5px">${contacts_list_potential.length}</div>
            <div>contactos seleccionados</div>
        `)
        selected_contacts_limit_validator()
    })

    let filter_agents_potential = []
    let paginator_potential = false
    let loading_potential_clients = false
    const get_rows_for_potential_table = () => {
        if (loading_potential_clients){return}
        order_by_potential = "filters_score"
        order_direction = "desc"
        contact_potential_page = 2
        noMoreElements = false
        loading_potential_clients = true
        var jqxhr = $.ajax(`/contact/get_potencial_customers?property_id=8002445&page=1`)
            .done(function(result){
                loading_potential_clients = false
                potentialCustomerActive = true
                rows_data = result.contacts
                agents_for_filter = result.agents
                status_for_filter = result.status
                contact_total_potential_pages = result.page_data.num_pages
                potential_has_next_page = result.page_data.has_next
                agentsFilterBehavior(agents_for_filter)
                $("#table_contacts_potential").show();
                $("#table_contacts_potential tbody").html('')
                if ( rows_data.length == 0){
                    $(".property_contacts_no_results_potential").show();
                    $(".container-filters").hide();
                    $("#count-interested").hide();
                    $("#table_contacts_potential").hide();
                    $("#order-dropdown-container").hide();
                    $("#pagination_contacts_potential").hide();
                }
                else{
                    $(".property_contacts_no_results_potential").hide()
                    $("#count-interested").show();
                    $(".container-filters").show();
                    $("#table_contacts_potential").show();
                    create_potential_table(rows_data)
                    contacts_change_filters(1);
                    $("#count-interested").html(`${result.total_count} ${getContactsHeaderText(result.total_count)}`)
                    $("#order-dropdown-container").show();
                }
                if (!paginator_potential && contact_total_potential_pages > 1 ) {
                    $("#pagination_contacts_potential").show();
                    createPaginator('pagination_contacts_potential', contact_total_potential_pages, potential_has_next_page)
                    paginator_potential = true
                }
            });
    }

    const create_potential_table = (list_rows, loadMore) => {
        // RESET TABLE OR APPEND IF LOADMORE
        !loadMore && $("#table_contacts_potential tbody").html('');
        let text_email = `Enviar email a `
        let text_wa = `Enviar WhatsApp a `
        let text_liked = `Destacar propiedad para `
        let last_contact = ""
        let text_go_search = `Ir a la búsqueda`
        let text_by = `Por`
        let text_property_sent = `Enviada`
        let text_property_starred = `Destacada`
        let text_property_sent_and_starred = `Enviada y destacada`
        list_rows.forEach(row => {
                text_property_status = row.sent_prop & row.is_starred ? text_property_sent_and_starred : 
                                    row.sent_prop ? text_property_sent : text_property_starred
                tags_flags = true
                rowHTML=`
                    <tr id=${row.search.id} class="card-potential-interested">
                        <td>
                            <input type="checkbox" name="potential_contact_row" class="property_contacts_potential_row" id="${row.search.id}" value="${row.id}" data-canview="${row.can_view}" ${row.can_view ? "enabled" : "disabled"} /></td>
                        <td>
                            <div class="box-contact-agent-status">
                                <div class="agent-contact">
                                    <div style="display:flex;">
                                        <a class="contact-name-text" href="/contact/${row.id}" target="_blank">
                                            ${row.name == '' ?
                                                `
                                                    <span>Sin nombre</span>
                                                `
                                                :
                                                `
                                                    <span>${row.name}</span>
                                                `
                                            }
                                        </a>
                                        <div class="box-status-leads">
                                            <div id="statusLeads" class="lead-status-state-potential" style="background-color:${addOpacity(row.lead_status.background_color)};color:${adjustReadableColor(row.lead_status.color, row.lead_status.background_color)}">${row.lead_status.name}</div>
                                            <div class="tooltip-leadstatus-potential" role="tooltip-leadstatus-potential">${row.lead_status.name}
                                                <div class="potential-contact-tooltip-arrow"></div>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="agent-name-text">
                                        <i class="icon-agente"></i>
                                        ${row.agent.full_name == '' ?
                                            `
                                                <span>Sin nombre</span>
                                            `
                                            :
                                            `
                                                <span>${row.agent.full_name}</span>
                                            `
                                        }
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </td>
                        <td>
                            <div class="box-time">
                                <i class="icon-reloj"></i>
                                <div class="time">
                                    <div class="time-date">${row.last_interaction_time}</div>
                                    <div class="time-hours">${row.last_interaction_hour.includes(":") ? row.last_interaction_hour + "hs" : row.last_interaction_hour}</div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </td>
                        <td>
                            <div class="saved-status">${text_by} ${row.search.created_by.full_name}</div>
                            <div class="saved-time">${row.search.created_at.includes(":") ? row.search.created_at + "hs" : row.search.created_at}</div>
                        </td>
                        <td style="text-align:center">
                            <div style="display:flex; justify-content: center;">
                                ${row.can_view ?
                                    `
                                        ${row.sent_prop | row.is_starred ?
                                        `
                                        <div  class="table-status-sent status-sent-potential">${text_property_status}</div>
                                        <div class="btn-actions d-none">
                                            <div class="emailPotential">
                                                <div onclick="new_show_mail_form({id:${row.id}, name:'${row.name}'}, [8002445], false, false)" class="icon icon-email icon-hided" onmouseover="iconHidedHoverIn(this)" onmouseout="iconHidedHoverOut(this)" style="opacity:0"></div>
                                                <div class="tooltip-btnemail-potential" role="tooltip-btnemail-potential">${text_email}${row.name}
                                                    <div class="potential-contact-tooltip-arrow"></div>
                                                </div>
                                            </div>
                                            <div class="waPotential">
                                                <div onclick="new_show_whatsapp_form({id:${row.id}, name:'${row.name}', cellphone:'${row.cellphone}'}, [8002445], is_from_outer_net=false, is_development=false);" class="icon icon-whatsapp icon-hided" onmouseover="iconHidedHoverIn(this)" onmouseout="iconHidedHoverOut(this)" style="opacity:0"></div>
                                                    <div class="tooltip-btnwa-potential" role="tooltip-btnwa-potential">${text_wa}${row.name}
                                                        <div class="potential-contact-tooltip-arrow"></div>
                                                    </div>
                                            </div>
                                            <div class="likePotential">
                                                <div id="btn-destaque_${row.search.id}" class="icon icon-destaque icon-hided" onmouseover="iconHidedHoverIn(this)" onmouseout="iconHidedHoverOut(this)" onclick="openModalConfirmationStarProperty(null,8002445,${row.id})" style="opacity:0; font-size:18px"></div>
                                                <div class="tooltip-btnlike-potential" role="tooltip-btnlike-potential">${text_liked}${row.name}
                                                    <div class="potential-contact-tooltip-arrow"></div>
                                                </div>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                        `
                                        :
                                        `
                                        <div class="emailPotential">
                                            <div onclick="new_show_mail_form({id:${row.id}, name:'${row.name}'}, [8002445], false, false)" class="icon icon-email icon-hided" onmouseover="iconHidedHoverIn(this)" onmouseout="iconHidedHoverOut(this)" style="opacity:0"></div>
                                            <div class="tooltip-btnemail-potential" role="tooltip-btnemail-potential">${text_email}${row.name}
                                                <div class="potential-contact-tooltip-arrow"></div>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                        <div class="waPotential">
                                            <div onclick="new_show_whatsapp_form({id:${row.id}, name:'${row.name}', cellphone:'${row.cellphone}'}, [8002445], is_from_outer_net=false, is_development=false);" class="icon icon-whatsapp icon-hided" onmouseover="iconHidedHoverIn(this)" onmouseout="iconHidedHoverOut(this)" style="opacity:0"></div>
                                                <div class="tooltip-btnwa-potential" role="tooltip-btnwa-potential">${text_wa}${row.name}
                                                    <div class="potential-contact-tooltip-arrow"></div>
                                                </div>
                                        </div>
                                        <div class="likePotential">
                                            <div id="btn-destaque_${row.search.id}" class="icon icon-destaque icon-hided" onmouseover="iconHidedHoverIn(this)" onmouseout="iconHidedHoverOut(this)" onclick="openModalConfirmationStarProperty(null,8002445,${row.id})" style="opacity:0; font-size:18px"></div>

                                        </div>

                    <tr id="tags-${row.search.id}" class="container-tags">

        createTooltipPooper('.likePotential','.tooltip-btnlike-potential')
        createTooltipPooper('.sorted-contacts-potential', '.tooltip-sortedcontacts-potential')
        createTooltipPooper('.sorted-interaction-potential', '.tooltip-interaction-potential')
    }

    let contact_potential_page = 2

    let order_by_direction_potential = false
    let order_direction = "desc"

    const toggleContactsPotential = (td) => {
        const icon = td.querySelector('.icon-dropdown');

        icon.style.opacity = 1;
        changeOthersIconsSorted(icon, tooltip)
        checkIconSortedAndPutText(icon, tooltip)

        order_by_direction_potential = !order_by_direction_potential
        $("#order-selected-element").html("Nombre del contacto")
        potentialFilter();
    }

    const toggleAgentsPotential = () => {
        order_by_potential = "agent_name"
        order_by_direction_potential = !order_by_direction_potential
        potentialFilter();
    }

    const toggleInteractionsPotential = (td) => {
        const icon = td.querySelector('.icon-dropdown');
        const tooltip = td.querySelector('.tooltip-interaction-potential');
        icon.classList.toggle('interested-rotate');
        icon.style.opacity = 1;
        changeOthersIconsSorted(icon, tooltip)
        checkIconSortedAndPutText(icon, tooltip)
        order_by_potential = "deleted_at"
        order_by_direction_potential = !order_by_direction_potential
        $("#order-selected-element").html("Última interacción")
        potentialFilter();
    }

    function url_maker(url_string, elements_id){
        if (elements_id.length != 0){
            return url_string + elements_id.join(url_string)
        }
        return ""
    }

    const potentialFilter = (loadMore = false) => {
        contact_potential_page = 1
        noMoreElements = false
        $('#potential_spinner').show();
        $(".property_contacts_no_results").hide()
        createTableSkeleton("#table_contacts_potential tbody");
        cleanAllSelectedRows();
        $(".property_contacts_no_results").hide()
        //$("#table_contacts_potential tbody").hide();
        if (order_by_direction_potential){ order_direction = "asc" } else { order_direction = "desc" }
        let jqxhr = $.ajax(`/contact/get_potencial_customers?property_id=8002445&page=${contact_potential_page}&order_by=${order_by_potential}&order=${order_direction}${url_maker("&agents=", selected_agents_for_filter)}${url_maker("&last_interaction=", selected_times_for_filter)}${url_maker("&leads_status=", selected_status_for_filter)}&input=${input_filter}`)

                rows_data = result.contacts
                contact_total_potential_pages = result.page_data.num_pages
                rows_data.length > 0 && $("#table_contacts_potential tbody").show();
                contact_total_potential_pages > 1 ? $("#pagination_contacts_potential").show() : $("#pagination_contacts_potential").hide()
                create_potential_table(rows_data, loadMore)
                contact_potential_page = 2
                if (!result.page_data.has_next){
                    noMoreElements = true
                }
                result.total_count == 0 && $(".property_contacts_no_results").show()
                $("#count-interested").html(`${result.total_count} ${getContactsHeaderText(result.total_count)}`)
        })
    }

    const toggleSearchTags = (id) => {
        $("#potential-client-see-search-" + id).toggle();
        $("#potential-client-hide-search-" + id).toggle();
        $("#tags-" + id).toggle();

    var potentialCustomerActive = false

    function loadMoreElements(page){

                data=result;
                if (!data.page_data.has_next){

                }

                loading = false;
                $("#count-interested").html(`${result.total_count} ${getContactsHeaderText(result.total_count)}`)
            })
    }
    function renderSearchs (row_id, search) {
        $("#search-tags-container-"+search.id).append(`
            <div class="searchs-name-interested">${search.name}</div>
        `)
        let cont = 0
        let totalTags = 0
        let tagLocations = 0
        hasLocationSame = false
        for (tag in search.search_params){
            locationContainsAll = false
            let containerHTML = ``
            if (typeof search.search_params[tag] == "string" && search.search_params[tag] != "undefined" && search.search_params[tag] != ""){
                totalTags += 1
                if (tags_flags == true){
                    cont += 1
                    $("#search-tags-container-"+search.id).append(`
                        <div id="tag-${search.id}-${cont}" class="potential-customers-tag-container">${search.search_params[tag]}</div>
                    `)
                    handlerTags(search.id)
                }
            }
            else if (typeof search.search_params[tag] == "object" && search.search_params[tag].length > 0){
                for (elem in search.search_params[tag]){
                    totalTags += 1
                    if (tags_flags == true){
                        if (tag == 'location'){
                            if(hasLocationSame){
                                countLocation += 1
                            }
                            _location = property_location.split(' | ')
                            _location = _location.map(element => {return element.trimEnd()})
                            _location.forEach(element => {
                            if (search.search_params[tag].includes(element)){
                                locationContainsAll = true
                            }
                            });
                            if(locationContainsAll && !hasLocationSame){
                                $("#search-tags-container-"+search.id).append(`
                                    <div id="tag-locations-${search.id}-${cont}" class="potential-customers-tag-container">${property_location}</div>
                                `)
                                hasLocationSame = true
                            }
                            else if (!hasLocationSame){
                                $("#search-tags-container-"+search.id).append(`
                                    <div id="tag-locations-${search.id}-${cont}" class="potential-customers-tag-container">${search.search_params[tag][elem]}</div>
                                `)
                            }
                        }
                        else{
                            if (tag.includes("without")){
                                prefix = "Sin"
                            }else if (tag.includes("with")){
                                prefix = "Con"
                            }else{
                                prefix = ""
                            }
                            cont += 1
                            $("#search-tags-container-"+search.id).append(`
                                <div id="tag-${search.id}-${cont}" class="potential-customers-tag-container">${prefix} ${search.search_params[tag][elem]}</div>
                            `)
                            handlerTags(search.id)
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (countLocation > 0){
                    let tagLocation = document.getElementById('tag-locations-'+search.id+"-"+cont)
                    let content = tagLocation.innerHTML
                    tagLocation.innerHTML = content + " +" + countLocation
                    tagLocations = countLocation
                }
                countLocation = 0
                }
            else if (typeof search.search_params[tag] == "object"){
                for (elem in search.search_params[tag]){
                    totalTags += 1
                    if (tags_flags == true){
                        cont += 1
                        $("#search-tags-container-"+search.id).append(`
                            <div id="tag-${search.id}-${cont}" class="potential-customers-tag-container">${search.search_params[tag][elem]}</div>
                        `)
                        handlerTags(search.id)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        const container = document.getElementById("search-tags-container-"+search.id);
        const tags = container.querySelectorAll(".potential-customers-tag-container").length;
        if (totalTags != (tags + tagLocations)){
            let tagsHide =  totalTags - tags
            $("#search-tags-container-"+search.id).append(`
                <div id="tag-${search.id}-quantity-removed" class="potential-customers-tag-container">+${tagsHide}</div>
            `)
        }
    }
    function handlerTags (id) {
        const container = document.getElementById("search-tags-container-"+id);
        const tags = container.querySelectorAll(".potential-customers-tag-container");
        let boxWidth = 0
        if ($(".box-searchs").innerWidth() > 0){
            boxWidth = $(".box-searchs").innerWidth() - 300
        }
        else{
            boxWidth = $(".property_longbox").innerWidth() - 300
        }
        let totalWidth = 0;
        let count = 0
        let tagRemoved = 0
        visibleTags = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < tags.length; i++) {
            const width = container.offsetWidth
            count += 1
            if (width <= boxWidth && tags_flags == true) {
                visibleTags++;
            }
            else if (tags_flags == true){
                $("#tag-"+id+"-"+count).remove();
                tags_flags = false
            }
        }
    }
</script>

        var timer = 0;
        return function() {
          var context = this, args = arguments;
          clearTimeout(timer);
          timer = setTimeout(function () {
            callback.apply(context, args);
          }, ms || 0);
        };

            });

    const createPaginator = (paginationElement, totalPages, nextPage) =>{
        const currentPage = 1;

        const paginationContainer = document.getElementById(paginationElement);
        const numPages = {
            total_page: totalPages
        };
        const hasNextPage = nextPage;
        //const hasPreviousPage = paginationData.page_data.has_previous;

        const ul = document.createElement("ul");
        ul.classList.add("pagination-sm", "search_results_paginator", "pagination");

        const firstLi = document.createElement("li");
        firstLi.classList.add("page-item", "first", "disabled");
        const firstLink = document.createElement("div");
        firstLink.classList.add("page-link");
        firstLi.addEventListener("click", () => changePage(paginationElement, 1));
        firstLink.innerText = "Primera";
        firstLi.appendChild(firstLink);
        ul.appendChild(firstLi);

        const prevLi = document.createElement("li");
        prevLi.classList.add("page-item", "prev", "disabled");
        const prevLink = document.createElement("div");
        prevLink.classList.add("page-link");
        prevLink.innerText = "Anterior";
        prevLi.addEventListener("click", () => previusPage());
        prevLi.appendChild(prevLink);
        ul.appendChild(prevLi);

        // Páginas numeradas
        for (let i = 1; i <= numPages.total_page; i++) {
            const li = document.createElement("li");
            li.classList.add("page-item");
            const link = document.createElement("div");
            link.classList.add("page-link");
            link.innerText = i;
            li.addEventListener("click", () => changePage(paginationElement, i));
            if (i === currentPage) {
                li.classList.add("active");
            }
            li.appendChild(link);
            ul.appendChild(li);
        }

        const nextLi = document.createElement("li");
        nextLi.classList.add("page-item", "next");
        if (!hasNextPage) {
            nextLi.classList.add("disabled");
        }
        const nextLink = document.createElement("div");
        nextLink.classList.add("page-link");
        nextLink.innerText = "Siguiente";
        nextLi.addEventListener("click", () => changePage(paginationElement, currentPage + 1));
        nextLi.appendChild(nextLink);
        ul.appendChild(nextLi);

        const lastLi = document.createElement("li");
        lastLi.classList.add("page-item", "last");
        if (!hasNextPage) {
            lastLi.classList.add("disabled");
        }
        const lastLink = document.createElement("div");
        lastLink.classList.add("page-link");
        lastLink.innerText = "Última";
        lastLi.addEventListener("click", () => changePage(paginationElement, numPages.total_page));
        lastLi.appendChild(lastLink);
        ul.appendChild(lastLi);

        // Se agrega el paginador al contenedor
        paginationContainer.appendChild(ul);
    }

    function adjustReadableColor(textColorHex, backgroundColorHex) {
        var backgroundColor = tinycolor(backgroundColorHex).setAlpha(0.2);
        var textColor = tinycolor(textColorHex);
        var contrast = tinycolor.readability(textColor, backgroundColor);
        var legibilityThreshold = 4.5;

        if (contrast < legibilityThreshold) {
            var adjustedTextColor = textColor.darken(20);
            return adjustedTextColor.toHexString();
        } else {
            return textColor.toHexString();
        }
    }

        Alert('No tenés autorización para cambiar el agente de este contacto', function(){}, 'Advertencia!');
    }
    if(unify_form_data.status=="select_two_contacts"){
        Alert('Debe seleccionar al menos un contacto', function(){}, 'Advertencia!');
    }

}

function unify_contacts(fav){
var all_checked_validate = true;
var real_contact_data = {};
    for(var a=0;a<unify_form_data.conflicts.length;a++){
        if($("input[name='contact_"+unify_form_data.conflicts[a].field+"']:checked").val() == undefined){
            all_checked_validate = false;
        }else{
            console.log(unify_form_data.conflicts[a].field)
            real_contact_data[unify_form_data.conflicts[a].field] = $("input[name='contact_"+unify_form_data.conflicts[a].field+"']:checked").val();
        }
    }
    console.log(real_contact_data)
    if(all_checked_validate == true){
        var jqxhr = $.ajax( "/contacts/join?contact_data=" + JSON.stringify(real_contact_data) + "&contacts_ids=" + JSON.stringify(new_chks_contact))
            .done(function(result){
                eval("var data =" + result);
                unify_form_data = data;
                unify_form(fav);
                $('.qtip.ui-tooltip').qtip('hide');
                    ajax_unify_counter++;
                });
    }else{
        Alert('Marcar todos', function(){}, 'Advertencia!');
    }
}

function unify_cnt(chks_contact,fav){
	new_chks_contact = chks_contact
    if(new_chks_contact.length == 2){
        ajax_unify_counter = 0;
        var jqxhr = $.ajax( "/contacts/join?contacts_ids=" + JSON.stringify(new_chks_contact))
                        .done(function(result){
                            eval("var data =" + result);
                            unify_form_data = data;
                            unify_form(fav);
                        })
    }else{
        Alert('Debe seleccionar solo 2 contactos', function(){}, 'Advertencia!');
    }
}

function remove_contact_mail(elem){
    event.stopPropagation();
    var currElemId = elem.parentElement.getAttribute("data-uid");
    var emailForm = document.getElementById('email_form');
    var container = emailForm.querySelector('.to-elements-container');
    var firstContactId = container.firstElementChild.getAttribute('data-uid');

    var currentContainer = elem.parentElement.parentElement
    var currentContainerId = currentContainer.getAttribute("id");

    var currentCase = '';
    if(currentContainerId == "cc-elements-container"){
        currentCase = 'cc';
        elem.parentElement.remove();
        showHiddenContact(currElemId)
        detectWrapCC()
    } else {
        currentCase = 'to';
        elem.parentElement.remove();
        detectWrapTo(currentContainer)
    }

    if(currElemId == firstContactId && currElemId != null){
        getContactRelations()
        var ccContainer = document.getElementById('cc-elements-container');
        var contactList = ccContainer.getElementsByTagName("send-prop-contact");

        for(var i = contactList.length -1; i > -1; i--)
        {
            contactList[i].remove();
        }
        detectWrapCC()
    }
    checkNumberOfMails(currentCase, currentContainer);
    removeMsgErrorEmail();
}

function remove_contact_whatsapp(elem){
    event.stopPropagation();

    var currElemId = $(elem).parent().data("uid")
    var firstContactId = $(".to-elements-container").children().data("uid")

    var currentContainer = $(elem).parent().parent().attr("id")

    if(currentContainer == "to-elements-container"){
        $(elem).parent().remove();
        detectWrapTo()
    }else{
        $(elem).parent().remove();
        showHiddenContact(currElemId)
        detectWrapCC()
    }

    if(currElemId == firstContactId){
        getContactRelations()
        $("#cc-elements-container div").each(function(){ $(this).remove() })
        detectWrapCC()
    }
    checkNumberOfWhatsappNumbers()
    $("#chk_whatsapp_validate_error").hide();
    $("#chk_whatsapp_revalidate").hide();
    $("#chk_whatsapp_revalidate_ok").hide();
    $("#whatsapp_send_button").addClass("btn");
    $("#whatsapp_send_button").removeClass("btn-disabled");
    enabled_button_send_wa()
}

function contrast_color(hex) {
    if (hex.indexOf("#") === 0) {
    hex = hex.slice(1);
    }
    // convert 3-digit hex to 6-digits.
    if (hex.length === 3) {
    hex = hex[0] + hex[0] + hex[1] + hex[1] + hex[2] + hex[2];
    }
    if (hex.length !== 6) {
    throw new Error("Invalid HEX color.");
    }
    var r = parseInt(hex.slice(0, 2), 16),
    g = parseInt(hex.slice(2, 4), 16),
    b = parseInt(hex.slice(4, 6), 16);

    return r * 0.299 + g * 0.587 + b * 0.114 > 186 ? "#000000" : "#FFFFFF";
}

function getStatusLetters(status) {
    let result = "";
    let words = status.split(" ").filter(function (c) {
        return c.length > 2;
    });

    if (words) {
        result = `${words[0][0].toUpperCase()}${
            words.length > 1
            ? words[1][0].toUpperCase()
            : ''
        }`;
    }

    return result;
}

function debounce(func, wait, immediate) {
    var timeout;
    return function() {
        var context = this, args = arguments;
        clearTimeout(timeout);
        timeout = setTimeout(function() {
            timeout = null;
            if (!immediate) func.apply(context, args);
        }, wait);
        if (immediate && !timeout) func.apply(context, args);
    };
}

function assemble_receiver_contact(element, is_cc=false){
    let new_contact = {};
    if(element.hasAttribute('data-email') && element.hasAttribute('data-uid') && element.getAttribute('data-uid') >= 0){
        new_contact = {
            contact_id: Number(element.getAttribute('data-uid')),
            emails:[element.getAttribute('data-email')]
        };
    }else{
        let chk_cont = element.getElementsByClassName('subnav-content');
        let mails = []
        if(chk_cont.length > 0){
            for(let chkbox_input of chk_cont[0].querySelectorAll('input')){
                if(chkbox_input.checked){
                    mails.push(chkbox_input.value)
                }
            }
            if(mails.length > 0 ){
                new_contact = {
                    contact_id: Number(element.getAttribute('data-uid')),
                    emails: mails
                };
            }
        }
    }
    if(new_contact != {} && is_cc) new_contact['is_cc'] = true;

    return new_contact
}

function create_recipients_list(){
    let valid_to_contacts =  document.querySelectorAll('#email_form .to-elements-container .send-prop-contact:not(.invalid)');
    let valid_cc_contacts =  document.querySelectorAll('#cc-elements-container .send-prop-contact:not(.invalid)');
    let send_to = []
    let promises = []

    for( let cc_element of valid_cc_contacts.values()){
        if(cc_element.dataset["uid"] < 0){
                let new_mail = cc_element.getAttribute('data-email')
                let new_recipient = {
                    emails: [new_mail],
                    is_cc: true
                }
                send_to.push(new_recipient);

        }else{
            let contact = assemble_receiver_contact(cc_element, is_cc=true);
            if (contact != {}) send_to.push(contact);
        }
    }

    return new Promise( async (resolve, reject) => {

        for(let element of valid_to_contacts.values()){
            if(element.dataset["uid"] < 0){
                let new_mail = element.getAttribute('data-email')

                try{
                    const responseNewMail = await fetch(MAIL_ALREADY_USED+new_mail)
                    const parsedResult = await responseNewMail.json()

                    let isAlreadyUsed = parsedResult.length > 0

                    if(!isAlreadyUsed){
                        promises.push(create_new_contact(new_mail)
                            .then(result => {
                                send_to.push(result);
                            })
                            .catch(err => console.error(err))
                        );
                    }else{
                          parsedResult.forEach((contactInfo) => {

                            let new_recipient = {
                                emails: [],
                                is_cc: true,
                                contact_id:contactInfo.contact_id,
                            }

                            new_recipient.emails.push(contactInfo.email)

                            if(send_to.length > 0){
                                var finded = send_to.find(contact => contact.contact_id === contactInfo.contact_id)
                            }

                            if(!finded){
                                send_to.push(new_recipient)
                            }
                        })
                    }
                } catch(err){
                    console.log(err)
                }
            }else{
                let contact = assemble_receiver_contact(element);
                if (contact != {}) send_to.push(contact);
            }
        }

        if(promises.length > 0){
            Promise.allSettled(promises).then(() => {
                resolve(send_to)
            })
        }else{
            resolve(send_to);
        }
    });
}

function create_new_contact(new_mail){
    let new_contact = {};
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        $.ajax(ADD_CONTACT_URL+new_mail+"&quickadd=true")
            .done(function(res){
                new_contact = {
                    contact_id: Number(res),
                    emails:[new_mail]
                };
                resolve(new_contact);
            })
            .fail(function(){
                alert(`Error trying to create new contact with mail: ${new_mail}`)
                reject(new_contact);
        })
    });
}
