            const to_review = data.to_review || [];
            const today_visible_tasks = today.slice(0, MAX_TASKS_TO_DISPLAY);
            const to_review_visible_tasks = to_review.slice(
                0,
                Math.max(MAX_TASKS_TO_DISPLAY - today_visible_tasks.length)
            );
            hadInitialData = hadInitialData || today_visible_tasks.length > 0 || to_review_visible_tasks.length > 0;
            render_tasks(today_visible_tasks, to_review_visible_tasks);
        })
        .catch(error => {
            console.log(error)
            render_tasks([], []);
        });
    }

    function update_task_status(task_id, status) {
        return fetch(`/api3/schedule/calendar_task/${task_id}/`, {
            method: 'PATCH',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({ status: status })
        });
    }

    function undo_complete_task(task_id) {
        const TASK_PENDING_STATUS = 0;

        update_task_status(task_id, TASK_PENDING_STATUS)
        .then((response) => {
            if (!response.ok) {
                throw new Error('Error undoing task completion');
            }

            return get_rightbar_tasks();
        })
        .catch((error) => {
            console.log(error);
            showToast(`Ocurrió un error. Intenta nuevamente más tarde.`, { variant: 'error' });
        });
    }

    function complete_task(task_id, is_overdue) {
        const $task_item = $('.tasks_widget_item[data-task-id="' + task_id + '"]');
        const TASK_COMPLETED_STATUS = 1;

        $task_item.addClass('tasks_widget_item_completed');
        clearTimeout(completeTaskTimeouts[task_id]);

        completeTaskTimeouts[task_id] = setTimeout(function () {
            if (completeTaskRequests[task_id]) {
                return;
            }

            completeTaskRequests[task_id] = true;

            update_task_status(task_id, TASK_COMPLETED_STATUS)
            .then((response) => {
                if (!response.ok) {
                    throw new Error('Error completing task');
                }

                mixpanel_track('platform_tasks_complete', extra_info={
                    overdue: is_overdue,
                    'completion-module': 'rightbar'
                });

                return get_rightbar_tasks();
            })
            .then(() => {
                showToast(`Completaste una tarea`, {
                    buttonText: `Deshacer`,
                    buttonClass: 'buttonActionToast--undo',
                    buttonCallback: function () {
                        undo_complete_task(task_id);
                    },
                    time: 2500
                });
            })
            .catch((error) => {
                console.log(error);
                $task_item.removeClass('tasks_widget_item_completed');
                showToast(`Ocurrió un error. Intenta nuevamente más tarde.`, { variant: 'error' });
            })
            .then(() => {
                delete completeTaskRequests[task_id];
                delete completeTaskTimeouts[task_id];
            });
        }, COMPLETE_TASK_DEBOUNCE_MS);
    }

    function get_task_html(task, is_overdue = false) {
        return `
            <div class="tasks_widget_item" data-task-id="${task.id}">
                <div class="tasks_widget_radio" onclick="complete_task(${task.id}, ${is_overdue})">
                    <i class="tasks_widget_check_icon icon-aceptar"></i>
                </div>
                <div class="tasks_widget_item_content">
                    <div class="tasks_widget_item_header">
                        <div class="tasks_widget_item_title">${escape_html(task.title)}</div>
                        <span class="${is_overdue ? "tasks_widget_item_time_overdue" : "tasks_widget_item_time"}">
                            ${is_overdue
                                ? `<i class="tasks_widget_meta_icon icon-reloj"></i>`
                                : ''
                            }
                            ${escape_html(task.time_display)}
                        </span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="tasks_widget_meta_list">
                        ${task.property_address ?
                            `<div class="tasks_widget_meta_item" onclick="open_property_display(${task.property.id})">
                                <i class="tasks_widget_meta_icon icon-propiedades"></i>
                                <div class="tasks_widget_meta_text">${escape_html(task.property_address)}</div>
                            </div>`
                            : ''
                        }

                        ${task && task.contacts && task.contacts.length > 0 ?
                            `<a class="tasks_widget_meta_item" target="_blank" href="/contact/${task.contacts[0].id}">
                                <i class="tasks_widget_meta_icon icon-contactos"></i>
                                <div class="tasks_widget_meta_text">${escape_html(task.contacts[0].name)}</div>
                            </a>`
                            : ''
                        }
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        `;
    }

    function get_tasks_section_html(label, tasks, is_overdue = false) {
        if (!tasks.length) {
            return "";
        }

        let items = [];

        for (let i = 0; i < tasks.length; i++) {
            items.push(get_task_html(tasks[i], is_overdue));
        }

        return `
            <div class="tasks_widget_section_label">${label}</div>
            <div class="tasks_widget_list">
                ${items.join("")}
            </div>
        `;
    }

    function get_no_pending_tasks() {
        return `
            <div class="tasks_widget_empty_state">
                <div class="tasks_widget_empty_state_illustration">
                    <img src="https://static.tokkobroker.com/static/img/thumb.svg" alt="No hay tareas pendientes">
                </div>
                <div class="tasks_widget_empty_state_text">
                    No hay tareas pendientes
                </div>
            </div>
        `;
    }

    function render_tasks(today_tasks, to_review_tasks) {
        let content = "";

        if (contact) {
            var task_word_today = today_tasks.length === 1 ? 'tarea' : 'tareas';
            var today_tasks_text = interpolate_gettext(
                '%(count)s %(task_word)s para %(name)s',
                {
                    count: today_tasks.length,
                    task_word: task_word_today,
                    name: escape_html(contact.name)
                }
            );
            var to_review_tasks_text = interpolate_gettext(
                '%(count)s vencidas para %(name)s',
                {
                    count: to_review_tasks.length,
                    name: escape_html(contact.name)
                }
            );

            content += get_tasks_section_html(today_tasks_text, today_tasks);
            content += get_tasks_section_html(to_review_tasks_text, to_review_tasks, true);
        } else if (property) {
            var task_word_prop = today_tasks.length === 1 ? 'tarea' : 'tareas';
            var today_tasks_text_prop = interpolate_gettext(
                '%(count)s %(task_word)s para %(address)s',
                {
                    count: today_tasks.length,
                    task_word: task_word_prop,
                    address: escape_html(property.address)
                }
            );
            var to_review_tasks_text_prop = interpolate_gettext(
                '%(count)s vencidas para %(address)s',
                {
                    count: to_review_tasks.length,
                    address: escape_html(property.address)
                }
            );

            content += get_tasks_section_html(today_tasks_text_prop, today_tasks);
            content += get_tasks_section_html(to_review_tasks_text_prop, to_review_tasks, true);
        } else {
            content += get_tasks_section_html(`Hoy`, today_tasks);
            content += get_tasks_section_html(`Para revisar`, to_review_tasks, true);
        }

        if (!content) {
            content = hadInitialData ? get_no_pending_tasks() : '';
        }

        $("#tasks .tasks_widget_body").html(content);

        if (content) {
            $('#tasks .tasks_widget_body').css('margin-top', '12px');
            $("#tasks .tasks_widget_body").append(get_rightbar_footer());
        }
    }

    get_rightbar_tasks()

    $("#tasks").on("click", "#newtask", function () {
        openTasksModal();
    });
</script>

function validate_mail(mail){
    var filter = /[\w-\.]{1,}@([\w-]{1,}\.)*([\w-]{1,}\.)[\w-]{2,4}/;

    if((filter.test(mail)) && (mail.split(" ").length == 1) && mail.split("@").length == 2)
        return true;
    else
        return false;
}

function validate_url(url){
    var filter = /^(ht|f)tps?:\/\/\w+([\.\-\w]+)?\.([a-z]{2,4})(:\d{2,5})?(\/.*)?$/i
    if(filter.test(url.trim())){
        if(url.indexOf("$id$") > 0){
            return true;
        }
        else{
            return "absent_id"
        }
    }
    else{
        return "incorrect_format";
    }
}
